verses.kjv: And the LORD called unto Moses, and spake unto him out of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,
verses.modern: The LORD called Moses and spoke to him from the tent of meeting, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man of you bring an offering unto the LORD, ye shall bring your offering of the cattle, even of the herd, and of the flock.
verses.modern: 'Speak to the children of Israel and say to them, When any one of You brings an offering to the LORD, You shall bring Your offering of livestock, from the herd or from the flock.

verses.kjv: If his offering be a burnt sacrifice of the herd, let him offer a male without blemish: he shall offer it of his own voluntary will at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD.
verses.modern: If His offering is a burnt offering from the herd, He shall offer a male without blemish. He shall bring it to the entrance of the tent of meeting, that He may be accepted before the LORD.

verses.kjv: And he shall put his hand upon the head of the burnt offering; and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.
verses.modern: He shall lay His hand on the head of the burnt offering. It shall be accepted for Him to make atonement for Him.

verses.kjv: And he shall kill the bullock before the LORD: and the priests, Aaron's sons, shall bring the blood, and sprinkle the blood round about upon the altar that is by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.modern: Then He shall kill the bull before the LORD, and Aaron's sons the priests shall bring the blood and throw the blood against the sides of the altar that is at the entrance of the tent of meeting.

verses.kjv: And he shall flay the burnt offering, and cut it into his pieces.
verses.modern: Then He shall flay the burnt offering and cut it into pieces,

verses.kjv: And the sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire upon the altar, and lay the wood in order upon the fire:
verses.modern: the sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire on the altar and arrange wood on the fire.

verses.kjv: And the priests, Aaron's sons, shall lay the parts, the head, and the fat, in order upon the wood that is on the fire which is upon the altar:
verses.modern: Aaron's sons the priests shall arrange the pieces, the head, and the fat, on the wood that is on the fire on the altar;

verses.kjv: But his inwards and his legs shall he wash in water: and the priest shall burn all on the altar, to be a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.modern: but its entrails and its legs He shall wash with water. And the priest shall burn all of it on the altar, as a burnt offering, a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto the LORD.

verses.kjv: And if his offering be of the flocks, namely, of the sheep, or of the goats, for a burnt sacrifice; he shall bring it a male without blemish.
verses.modern: If His gift for a burnt offering is from the flock, from the sheep or goats, He shall bring a male without blemish,

verses.kjv: And he shall kill it on the side of the altar northward before the LORD: and the priests, Aaron's sons, shall sprinkle his blood round about upon the altar.
verses.modern: he shall kill it on the north side of the altar before the LORD, and Aaron's sons the priests shall throw its blood against the sides of the altar.

verses.kjv: And he shall cut it into his pieces, with his head and his fat: and the priest shall lay them in order on the wood that is on the fire which is upon the altar:
verses.modern: he shall cut it into pieces, with its head and its fat, and the priest shall arrange them on the wood that is on the fire on the altar,

verses.kjv: But he shall wash the inwards and the legs with water: and the priest shall bring it all, and burn it upon the altar: it is a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.modern: but the entrails and the legs He shall wash with water. And the priest shall offer all of it and burn it on the altar; it is a burnt offering, a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto the LORD.

verses.kjv: And if the burnt sacrifice for his offering to the LORD be of fowls, then he shall bring his offering of turtledoves, or of young pigeons.
verses.modern: If His offering to the LORD is a burnt offering of birds, then He shall bring His offering of turtledoves or pigeons.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall bring it unto the altar, and wring off his head, and burn it on the altar; and the blood thereof shall be wrung out at the side of the altar:
verses.modern: the priest shall bring it to the altar and wring off its head and burn it on the altar. Its blood shall be drained out on the side of the altar.

verses.kjv: And he shall pluck away his crop with his feathers, and cast it beside the altar on the east part, by the place of the ashes:
verses.modern: He shall remove its crop with its contents and cast it beside the altar on the east side, in the place for ashes.

verses.kjv: And he shall cleave it with the wings thereof, but shall not divide it asunder: and the priest shall burn it upon the altar, upon the wood that is upon the fire: it is a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.modern: He shall tear it open by its wings, but shall not sever it completely. And the priest shall burn it on the altar, on the wood that is on the fire. It is a burnt offering, a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto the LORD.

chapters.summary: The LORD gives instructions for the burnt offering. An unblemished male from the herd, flock, or a bird is to be killed, its blood thrown against the altar, and the whole animal burned as a sweet savour to the LORD.

verses.kjv: And when any will offer a meat offering unto the LORD, his offering shall be of fine flour; and he shall pour oil upon it, and put frankincense thereon:
verses.modern: When anyone brings a grain offering as an offering to the LORD, His offering shall be of fine flour. He shall pour oil on it and put frankincense on it

verses.kjv: And he shall bring it to Aaron's sons the priests: and he shall take thereout his handful of the flour thereof, and of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense thereof; and the priest shall burn the memorial of it upon the altar, to be an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD:
verses.modern: bring it to Aaron's sons the priests. And he shall take from it a handful of the fine flour and oil, with all of its frankincense, and the priest shall burn this as its memorial portion on the altar, a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto the LORD.

verses.kjv: And the remnant of the meat offering shall be Aaron's and his sons': it is a thing most holy of the offerings of the LORD made by fire.
verses.modern: But the rest of the grain offering shall be for Aaron and his sons; it is a most holy part of the LORD's offerings made by fire.

verses.kjv: And if thou bring an oblation of a meat offering baken in the oven, it shall be unleavened cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, or unleavened wafers anointed with oil.
verses.modern: When You bring a grain offering baked in the oven as an offering, it shall be unleavened loaves of fine flour mixed with oil or unleavened wafers smeared with oil.

verses.kjv: And if thy oblation be a meat offering baken in a pan, it shall be of fine flour unleavened, mingled with oil.
verses.modern: if Your offering is a grain offering baked on a griddle, it shall be of fine flour unleavened, mixed with oil.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt part it in pieces, and pour oil thereon: it is a meat offering.
verses.modern: You shall break it in pieces and pour oil on it; it is a grain offering.

verses.kjv: And if thy oblation be a meat offering baken in the fryingpan, it shall be made of fine flour with oil.
verses.modern: if Your offering is a grain offering cooked in a pan, it shall be made of fine flour with oil.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt bring the meat offering that is made of these things unto the LORD: and when it is presented unto the priest, he shall bring it unto the altar.
verses.modern: you shall bring the grain offering that is made of these things to the LORD, and when it is presented to the priest, he shall bring it to the altar.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall take from the meat offering a memorial thereof, and shall burn it upon the altar: it is an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.modern: the priest shall take from the grain offering its memorial portion and burn this on the altar, a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto the LORD.

verses.kjv: And that which is left of the meat offering shall be Aaron's and his sons': it is a thing most holy of the offerings of the LORD made by fire.
verses.modern: But the rest of the grain offering shall be for Aaron and his sons; it is a most holy part of the LORD's offerings made by fire.

verses.kjv: No meat offering, which ye shall bring unto the LORD, shall be made with leaven: for ye shall burn no leaven, nor any honey, in any offering of the LORD made by fire.
verses.modern: No grain offering that You bring to the LORD shall be made with leaven, for You shall burn no leaven nor any honey as a offering made by fire to the LORD.

verses.kjv: As for the oblation of the firstfruits, ye shall offer them unto the LORD: but they shall not be burnt on the altar for a sweet savour.
verses.modern: As an offering of firstfruits You may bring them to the LORD. But they shall not be offered on the altar for a sweet savour.

verses.kjv: And every oblation of thy meat offering shalt thou season with salt; neither shalt thou suffer the salt of the covenant of thy God to be lacking from thy meat offering: with all thine offerings thou shalt offer salt.
verses.modern: You shall season all Your grain offerings with salt. You shall not let the salt of the covenant with Your God be missing from Your grain offering; with all Your offerings You shall offer salt.

verses.kjv: And if thou offer a meat offering of thy firstfruits unto the LORD, thou shalt offer for the meat offering of thy firstfruits green ears of corn dried by the fire, even corn beaten out of full ears.
verses.modern: If You offer a grain offering of firstfruits to the LORD, You shall offer for the grain offering of Your firstfruits fresh ears, roasted with fire, crushed new grain.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt put oil upon it, and lay frankincense thereon: it is a meat offering.
verses.modern: you shall put oil on it and lay frankincense on it; it is a grain offering.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall burn the memorial of it, part of the beaten corn thereof, and part of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense thereof: it is an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.modern: the priest shall burn as its memorial portion some of the crushed grain and some of the oil with all of its frankincense; it is a offering made by fire to the LORD.

chapters.summary: The LORD gives instructions for the grain offering. Fine flour mixed with oil and frankincense is brought to the priest, who burns a portion on the altar; the rest belongs to Aaron and his sons.

verses.kjv: And if his oblation be a sacrifice of peace offering, if he offer it of the herd; whether it be a male or female, he shall offer it without blemish before the LORD.
verses.modern: If His offering is a sacrifice of peace offering, if He offers an animal from the herd, male or female, He shall offer it without blemish before the LORD.

verses.kjv: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his offering, and kill it at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron's sons the priests shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about.
verses.modern: he shall lay his hand on the head of his offering and kill it at the entrance of the tent of meeting, and Aaron's sons the priests shall throw the blood against the sides of the altar.

verses.kjv: And he shall offer of the sacrifice of the peace offering an offering made by fire unto the LORD; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,
verses.modern: from the sacrifice of the peace offering, as a offering made by fire to the LORD, He shall offer the fat covering the entrails and all the fat that is on the entrails,

verses.kjv: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.
verses.modern: the two kidneys with the fat that is on them at the loins, and the long lobe of the liver that He shall remove with the kidneys.

verses.kjv: And Aaron's sons shall burn it on the altar upon the burnt sacrifice, which is upon the wood that is on the fire: it is an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.modern: Then Aaron's sons shall burn it on the altar on top of the burnt offering, which is on the wood on the fire; it is a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto the LORD.

verses.kjv: And if his offering for a sacrifice of peace offering unto the LORD be of the flock; male or female, he shall offer it without blemish.
verses.modern: If His offering for a sacrifice of peace offering to the LORD is an animal from the flock, male or female, He shall offer it without blemish.

verses.kjv: If he offer a lamb for his offering, then shall he offer it before the LORD.
verses.modern: If He offers a lamb for His offering, then He shall offer it before the LORD,

verses.kjv: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his offering, and kill it before the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron's sons shall sprinkle the blood thereof round about upon the altar.
verses.modern: lay his hand on the head of his offering, and kill it in front of the tent of meeting. Aaron's sons shall throw its blood against the sides of the altar.

verses.kjv: And he shall offer of the sacrifice of the peace offering an offering made by fire unto the LORD; the fat thereof, and the whole rump, it shall he take off hard by the backbone; and the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,
verses.modern: Then from the sacrifice of the peace offering He shall offer as a offering made by fire to the LORD its fat; He shall remove the whole fat tail, cut off close to the backbone, and the fat that covers the entrails and all the fat that is on the entrails

verses.kjv: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.
verses.modern: the two kidneys with the fat that is on them at the loins and the long lobe of the liver that He shall remove with the kidneys.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall burn it upon the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.modern: the priest shall burn it on the altar as a offering made by fire to the LORD.

verses.kjv: And if his offering be a goat, then he shall offer it before the LORD.
verses.modern: If His offering is a goat, then He shall offer it before the LORD

verses.kjv: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of it, and kill it before the tabernacle of the congregation: and the sons of Aaron shall sprinkle the blood thereof upon the altar round about.
verses.modern: lay his hand on its head and kill it in front of the tent of meeting, and the sons of Aaron shall throw its blood against the sides of the altar.

verses.kjv: And he shall offer thereof his offering, even an offering made by fire unto the LORD; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,
verses.modern: Then He shall offer from it, as His offering for a offering made by fire to the LORD, the fat covering the entrails and all the fat that is on the entrails

verses.kjv: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.
verses.modern: the two kidneys with the fat that is on them at the loins and the long lobe of the liver that He shall remove with the kidneys.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire for a sweet savour: all the fat is the LORD's.
verses.modern: the priest shall burn them on the altar as a offering made by fire with a sweet savour. All fat is the LORD's.

verses.kjv: It shall be a perpetual statute for your generations throughout all your dwellings, that ye eat neither fat nor blood.
verses.modern: It shall be a statute forever throughout Your generations, in all Your dwelling places, that You eat neither fat nor blood.'

chapters.summary: The LORD gives instructions for the peace offering. The worshipper lays his hand on the animal's head and kills it at the entrance of the tent of meeting; the fat and kidneys are burned on the altar, and Israel is forbidden to eat fat or blood.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a soul shall sin through ignorance against any of the commandments of the LORD concerning things which ought not to be done, and shall do against any of them:
verses.modern: 'Speak to the children of Israel, saying, If anyone sins unintentionally in any of the LORD's commandments about things not to be done, and does any one of them,

verses.kjv: If the priest that is anointed do sin according to the sin of the people; then let him bring for his sin, which he hath sinned, a young bullock without blemish unto the LORD for a sin offering.
verses.modern: if it is the anointed priest who sins, thus bringing guilt on the people, then he shall offer for the sin that he has committed a bull from the herd without blemish to the LORD for a sin offering.

verses.kjv: And he shall bring the bullock unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD; and shall lay his hand upon the bullock's head, and kill the bullock before the LORD.
verses.modern: He shall bring the bull to the entrance of the tent of meeting before the LORD and lay His hand on the head of the bull and kill the bull before the LORD.

verses.kjv: And the priest that is anointed shall take of the bullock's blood, and bring it to the tabernacle of the congregation:
verses.modern: the anointed priest shall take some of the blood of the bull and bring it into the tent of meeting,

verses.kjv: And the priest shall dip his finger in the blood, and sprinkle of the blood seven times before the LORD, before the vail of the sanctuary.
verses.modern: the priest shall dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle part of the blood seven times before the LORD in front of the veil of the sanctuary.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall put some of the blood upon the horns of the altar of sweet incense before the LORD, which is in the tabernacle of the congregation; and shall pour all the blood of the bullock at the bottom of the altar of the burnt offering, which is at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.modern: the priest shall put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of fragrant incense before the LORD that is in the tent of meeting. All the rest of the blood of the bull He shall pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offering that is at the entrance of the tent of meeting.

verses.kjv: And he shall take off from it all the fat of the bullock for the sin offering; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,
verses.modern: all the fat of the bull of the sin offering He shall remove from it, the fat that covers the entrails and all the fat that is on the entrails

verses.kjv: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away,
verses.modern: the two kidneys with the fat that is on them at the loins and the long lobe of the liver that He shall remove with the kidneys

verses.kjv: As it was taken off from the bullock of the sacrifice of peace offerings: and the priest shall burn them upon the altar of the burnt offering.
verses.modern: (just as these are taken from the ox of the sacrifice of the peace offerings). The priest shall burn them on the altar of burnt offering.

verses.kjv: And the skin of the bullock, and all his flesh, with his head, and with his legs, and his inwards, and his dung,
verses.modern: But the skin of the bull and all its flesh, with its head, its legs, its entrails, and its dung —

verses.kjv: Even the whole bullock shall he carry forth without the camp unto a clean place, where the ashes are poured out, and burn him on the wood with fire: where the ashes are poured out shall he be burnt.
verses.modern: all the rest of the bull — he shall carry outside the camp to a clean place, to the ash heap, and shall burn it up on a fire of wood. On the ash heap it shall be burned up.

verses.kjv: And if the whole congregation of Israel sin through ignorance, and the thing be hid from the eyes of the assembly, and they have done somewhat against any of the commandments of the LORD concerning things which should not be done, and are guilty;
verses.modern: If the whole congregation of Israel sins unintentionally and the thing is hidden from the eyes of the assembly, if they do any one of the things that by the LORD's commandments ought not to be done, and they realize their guilt,

verses.kjv: When the sin, which they have sinned against it, is known, then the congregation shall offer a young bullock for the sin, and bring him before the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.modern: when the sin which they have committed becomes known, the assembly shall offer a bull from the herd for a sin offering and bring it in front of the tent of meeting.

verses.kjv: And the elders of the congregation shall lay their hands upon the head of the bullock before the LORD: and the bullock shall be killed before the LORD.
verses.modern: the elders of the congregation shall lay their hands on the head of the bull before the LORD, and the bull shall be killed before the LORD.

verses.kjv: And the priest that is anointed shall bring of the bullock's blood to the tabernacle of the congregation:
verses.modern: Then the anointed priest shall bring some of the blood of the bull into the tent of meeting,

verses.kjv: And the priest shall dip his finger in some of the blood, and sprinkle it seven times before the LORD, even before the vail.
verses.modern: the priest shall dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle it seven times before the LORD in front of the veil.

verses.kjv: And he shall put some of the blood upon the horns of the altar which is before the LORD, that is in the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall pour out all the blood at the bottom of the altar of the burnt offering, which is at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.modern: he shall put some of the blood on the horns of the altar that is in the tent of meeting before the LORD, and the rest of the blood He shall pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offering that is at the entrance of the tent of meeting.

verses.kjv: And he shall take all his fat from him, and burn it upon the altar.
verses.modern: all its fat He shall take from it and burn on the altar.

verses.kjv: And he shall do with the bullock as he did with the bullock for a sin offering, so shall he do with this: and the priest shall make an atonement for them, and it shall be forgiven them.
verses.modern: Thus shall he do with the bull. As he did with the bull of the sin offering, so shall he do with this. And the priest shall make atonement for them. They shall be forgiven.

verses.kjv: And he shall carry forth the bullock without the camp, and burn him as he burned the first bullock: it is a sin offering for the congregation.
verses.modern: he shall carry the bull outside the camp and burn it up as he burned the first bull; it is the sin offering for the assembly.

verses.kjv: When a ruler hath sinned, and done somewhat through ignorance against any of the commandments of the LORD his God concerning things which should not be done, and is guilty;
verses.modern: When a leader sins, doing unintentionally any one of all the things that by the commandments of the LORD His God ought not to be done, and realizes His guilt,

verses.kjv: Or if his sin, wherein he hath sinned, come to his knowledge; he shall bring his offering, a kid of the goats, a male without blemish:
verses.modern: or the sin which He has committed is made known to Him, He shall bring as His offering a goat, a male without blemish,

verses.kjv: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the goat, and kill it in the place where they kill the burnt offering before the LORD: it is a sin offering.
verses.modern: shall lay His hand on the head of the goat and kill it in the place where they kill the burnt offering before the LORD; it is a sin offering.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out his blood at the bottom of the altar of burnt offering.
verses.modern: Then the priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering and pour out the rest of its blood at the base of the altar of burnt offering.

verses.kjv: And he shall burn all his fat upon the altar, as the fat of the sacrifice of peace offerings: and the priest shall make an atonement for him as concerning his sin, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.modern: all its fat he shall burn on the altar, like the fat of the sacrifice of peace offerings. So the priest shall make atonement for him for his sin. He shall be forgiven.

verses.kjv: And if any one of the common people sin through ignorance, while he doeth somewhat against any of the commandments of the LORD concerning things which ought not to be done, and be guilty;
verses.modern: If anyone of the common people sins unintentionally in doing any one of the things that by the LORD's commandments ought not to be done, and realizes His guilt,

verses.kjv: Or if his sin, which he hath sinned, come to his knowledge: then he shall bring his offering, a kid of the goats, a female without blemish, for his sin which he hath sinned.
verses.modern: or the sin which He has committed is made known to Him, He shall bring for His offering a goat, a female without blemish, for His sin which He has committed.

verses.kjv: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering, and slay the sin offering in the place of the burnt offering.
verses.modern: he shall lay His hand on the head of the sin offering and kill the sin offering in the place of burnt offering.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall take of the blood thereof with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out all the blood thereof at the bottom of the altar.
verses.modern: the priest shall take some of its blood with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering and pour out all the rest of its blood at the base of the altar.

verses.kjv: And he shall take away all the fat thereof, as the fat is taken away from off the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall burn it upon the altar for a sweet savour unto the LORD; and the priest shall make an atonement for him, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.modern: all its fat He shall remove, as the fat is removed from the peace offerings, and the priest shall burn it on the altar for a sweet savour unto the LORD. And the priest shall make atonement for him. He shall be forgiven.

verses.kjv: And if he bring a lamb for a sin offering, he shall bring it a female without blemish.
verses.modern: If He brings a lamb as His offering for a sin offering, He shall bring a female without blemish

verses.kjv: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering, and slay it for a sin offering in the place where they kill the burnt offering.
verses.modern: lay His hand on the head of the sin offering and kill it for a sin offering in the place where they kill the burnt offering.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out all the blood thereof at the bottom of the altar:
verses.modern: Then the priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering and pour out all the rest of its blood at the base of the altar.

verses.kjv: And he shall take away all the fat thereof, as the fat of the lamb is taken away from the sacrifice of the peace offerings; and the priest shall burn them upon the altar, according to the offerings made by fire unto the LORD: and the priest shall make an atonement for his sin that he hath committed, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.modern: all its fat He shall remove as the fat of the lamb is removed from the sacrifice of peace offerings, and the priest shall burn it on the altar, on top of the LORD's offerings made by fire. And the priest shall make atonement for him for the sin which He has committed. He shall be forgiven.

chapters.summary: The LORD gives instructions for the sin offering to cover unintentional sins. Different sacrifices are required depending on who sinned -- the anointed priest brings a bull, the whole congregation a bull, a ruler a male goat, and a common person a female goat or lamb.

verses.kjv: And if a soul sin, and hear the voice of swearing, and is a witness, whether he hath seen or known of it; if he do not utter it, then he shall bear his iniquity.
verses.modern: If anyone sins in that he hears a public adjuration to testify, and though He is a witness, whether He has seen or come to know the matter, yet does not speak, He shall bear His iniquity;

verses.kjv: Or if a soul touch any unclean thing, whether it be a carcase of an unclean beast, or a carcase of unclean cattle, or the carcase of unclean creeping things, and if it be hidden from him; he also shall be unclean, and guilty.
verses.modern: or if anyone touches an unclean thing, whether a carcass of an unclean wild animal or a carcass of unclean livestock or a carcass of unclean swarming things. and if it be hidden from Him, He also shall be unclean and guilty.

verses.kjv: Or if he touch the uncleanness of man, whatsoever uncleanness it be that a man shall be defiled withal, and it be hid from him; when he knoweth of it, then he shall be guilty.
verses.modern: or if He touches human uncleanness, of whatever sort the uncleanness may be with which one becomes unclean. It is hidden from Him, when He comes to know it, and realizes His guilt;

verses.kjv: Or if a soul swear, pronouncing with his lips to do evil, or to do good, whatsoever it be that a man shall pronounce with an oath, and it be hid from him; when he knoweth of it, then he shall be guilty in one of these.
verses.modern: or if anyone utters with his lips a rash oath to do evil or to do good, any sort of rash oath that people swear. It is hidden from Him, when He comes to know it. He realizes His guilt in any of these;

verses.kjv: And it shall be, when he shall be guilty in one of these things, that he shall confess that he hath sinned in that thing:
verses.modern: when He realizes His guilt in any of these and confesses the sin He has committed,

verses.kjv: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the LORD for his sin which he hath sinned, a female from the flock, a lamb or a kid of the goats, for a sin offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for him concerning his sin.
verses.modern: he shall bring to the LORD as His compensation for the sin that He has committed, a female from the flock, a lamb or a goat, for a sin offering. And the priest shall make atonement for him for his sin.

verses.kjv: And if he be not able to bring a lamb, then he shall bring for his trespass, which he hath committed, two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, unto the LORD; one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering.
verses.modern: But if He cannot afford a lamb, then He shall bring to the LORD as His compensation for the sin that He has committed two turtledoves or two pigeons, one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering.

verses.kjv: And he shall bring them unto the priest, who shall offer that which is for the sin offering first, and wring off his head from his neck, but shall not divide it asunder:
verses.modern: He shall bring them to the priest, who shall offer first the one for the sin offering. He shall wring its head from its neck, but shall not sever it completely,

verses.kjv: And he shall sprinkle of the blood of the sin offering upon the side of the altar; and the rest of the blood shall be wrung out at the bottom of the altar: it is a sin offering.
verses.modern: he shall sprinkle some of the blood of the sin offering on the side of the altar, while the rest of the blood shall be drained out at the base of the altar; it is a sin offering.

verses.kjv: And he shall offer the second for a burnt offering, according to the manner: and the priest shall make an atonement for him for his sin which he hath sinned, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.modern: Then he shall offer the second for a burnt offering according to the rule. And the priest shall make atonement for him for the sin that he has committed. He shall be forgiven.

verses.kjv: But if he be not able to bring two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, then he that sinned shall bring for his offering the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a sin offering; he shall put no oil upon it, neither shall he put any frankincense thereon: for it is a sin offering.
verses.modern: But if he cannot afford two turtledoves or two pigeons, then he shall bring as his offering for the sin that he has committed a tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a sin offering. He shall put no oil on it and shall put no frankincense on it, for it is a sin offering.

verses.kjv: Then shall he bring it to the priest, and the priest shall take his handful of it, even a memorial thereof, and burn it on the altar, according to the offerings made by fire unto the LORD: it is a sin offering.
verses.modern: he shall bring it to the priest, and the priest shall take a handful of it as its memorial portion and burn this on the altar, on the LORD's offerings made by fire; it is a sin offering.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall make an atonement for him as touching his sin that he hath sinned in one of these, and it shall be forgiven him: and the remnant shall be the priest's, as a meat offering.
verses.modern: Thus the priest shall make atonement for him for the sin which he has committed in any one of these things. He shall be forgiven. And the remainder shall be for the priest, as in the grain offering.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: If a soul commit a trespass, and sin through ignorance, in the holy things of the LORD; then he shall bring for his trespass unto the LORD a ram without blemish out of the flocks, with thy estimation by shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for a trespass offering:
verses.modern: 'If anyone commits a breach of faith and sins unintentionally in any of the holy things of the LORD, He shall bring to the LORD as His compensation, a ram without blemish out of the flock, valued in silver shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, for a guilt offering.

verses.kjv: And he shall make amends for the harm that he hath done in the holy thing, and shall add the fifth part thereto, and give it unto the priest: and the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.modern: He shall also make restitution for what he has done wrong in the holy thing and shall add a fifth to it and give it to the priest. And the priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the guilt offering. He shall be forgiven.

verses.kjv: And if a soul sin, and commit any of these things which are forbidden to be done by the commandments of the LORD; though he wist it not, yet is he guilty, and shall bear his iniquity.
verses.modern: If anyone sins, doing any of the things that by the LORD's commandments ought not to be done, though He did not know it, then realizes His guilt, He shall bear His iniquity.

verses.kjv: And he shall bring a ram without blemish out of the flock, with thy estimation, for a trespass offering, unto the priest: and the priest shall make an atonement for him concerning his ignorance wherein he erred and wist it not, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.modern: He shall bring to the priest a ram without blemish out of the flock, or its equivalent, for a guilt offering, and the priest shall make atonement for him for the mistake that he made unintentionally. He shall be forgiven.

verses.kjv: It is a trespass offering: he hath certainly trespassed against the LORD.
verses.modern: It is a guilt offering; He has indeed incurred guilt before the LORD.'

chapters.summary: The LORD gives laws concerning guilt offerings for specific sins: failing to testify, touching unclean things, and rash oaths. Provision is made for the poor to bring birds or even flour instead of a lamb, and a ram is required for trespasses against the LORD's holy things.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: If a soul sin, and commit a trespass against the LORD, and lie unto his neighbour in that which was delivered him to keep, or in fellowship, or in a thing taken away by violence, or hath deceived his neighbour;
verses.modern: 'If anyone sins and commits a breach of faith against the LORD by deceiving His neighbor in a matter of deposit or security, or through robbery, or if He has oppressed His neighbor

verses.kjv: Or have found that which was lost, and lieth concerning it, and sweareth falsely; in any of all these that a man doeth, sinning therein:
verses.modern: or has found something lost and lied about it, swearing falsely — in any of all the things that people do and sin thereby —

verses.kjv: Then it shall be, because he hath sinned, and is guilty, that he shall restore that which he took violently away, or the thing which he hath deceitfully gotten, or that which was delivered him to keep, or the lost thing which he found,
verses.modern: if He has sinned and has realized His guilt and will restore what He took by robbery or what He got by oppression or the deposit that was committed to Him or the lost thing that He found

verses.kjv: Or all that about which he hath sworn falsely; he shall even restore it in the principal, and shall add the fifth part more thereto, and give it unto him to whom it appertaineth, in the day of his trespass offering.
verses.modern: or anything about which He has sworn falsely, He shall restore it in full and shall add a fifth to it, and give it to Him to whom it belongs on the day He realizes His guilt.

verses.kjv: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the LORD, a ram without blemish out of the flock, with thy estimation, for a trespass offering, unto the priest:
verses.modern: he shall bring to the priest as his compensation to the LORD a ram without blemish out of the flock, or its equivalent, for a guilt offering.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall make an atonement for him before the LORD: and it shall be forgiven him for any thing of all that he hath done in trespassing therein.
verses.modern: the priest shall make atonement for him before the LORD. He shall be forgiven for any of the things that one may do and thereby become guilty.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Command Aaron and his sons, saying, This is the law of the burnt offering: It is the burnt offering, because of the burning upon the altar all night unto the morning, and the fire of the altar shall be burning in it.
verses.modern: 'Command Aaron and his sons, saying, This is the law of the burnt offering. The burnt offering shall be on the hearth on the altar all night until the morning, and the fire of the altar shall be kept burning on it.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall put on his linen garment, and his linen breeches shall he put upon his flesh, and take up the ashes which the fire hath consumed with the burnt offering on the altar, and he shall put them beside the altar.
verses.modern: the priest shall put on his linen garment and put his linen undergarment on his body. He shall take up the ashes to which the fire has reduced the burnt offering on the altar and put them beside the altar.

verses.kjv: And he shall put off his garments, and put on other garments, and carry forth the ashes without the camp unto a clean place.
verses.modern: Then he shall take off his garments and put on other garments and carry the ashes outside the camp to a clean place.

verses.kjv: And the fire upon the altar shall be burning in it; it shall not be put out: and the priest shall burn wood on it every morning, and lay the burnt offering in order upon it; and he shall burn thereon the fat of the peace offerings.
verses.modern: The fire on the altar shall be kept burning on it; it shall not go out. The priest shall burn wood on it every morning. He shall arrange the burnt offering on it and shall burn on it the fat of the peace offerings.

verses.kjv: The fire shall ever be burning upon the altar; it shall never go out.
verses.modern: Fire shall be kept burning on the altar continually; it shall not go out.

verses.kjv: And this is the law of the meat offering: the sons of Aaron shall offer it before the LORD, before the altar.
verses.modern: this is the law of the grain offering. The sons of Aaron shall offer it before the LORD in front of the altar.

verses.kjv: And he shall take of it his handful, of the flour of the meat offering, and of the oil thereof, and all the frankincense which is upon the meat offering, and shall burn it upon the altar for a sweet savour, even the memorial of it, unto the LORD.
verses.modern: one shall take from it a handful of the fine flour of the grain offering and of its oil and all of the frankincense that is on the grain offering, and shall burn this as its memorial portion on the altar, a sweet savour unto the LORD.

verses.kjv: And the remainder thereof shall Aaron and his sons eat: with unleavened bread shall it be eaten in the holy place; in the court of the tabernacle of the congregation they shall eat it.
verses.modern: the rest of it Aaron and his sons shall eat. It shall be eaten unleavened in a holy place. In the court of the tent of meeting they shall eat it.

verses.kjv: It shall not be baken with leaven. I have given it unto them for their portion of my offerings made by fire; it is most holy, as is the sin offering, and as the trespass offering.
verses.modern: It shall not be baked with leaven. I have given it as their portion of my offerings made by fire. It is a thing most holy, like the sin offering and the guilt offering.

verses.kjv: All the males among the children of Aaron shall eat of it. It shall be a statute for ever in your generations concerning the offerings of the LORD made by fire: every one that toucheth them shall be holy.
verses.modern: Every male among the children of Aaron may eat of it, as decreed forever throughout Your generations, from the LORD's offerings made by fire. Whatever touches them shall become holy.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: This is the offering of Aaron and of his sons, which they shall offer unto the LORD in the day when he is anointed; the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a meat offering perpetual, half of it in the morning, and half thereof at night.
verses.modern: 'This is the offering that Aaron and his sons shall offer to the LORD on the day when He is anointed: a tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a regular grain offering, half of it in the morning and half in the evening.

verses.kjv: In a pan it shall be made with oil; and when it is baken, thou shalt bring it in: and the baken pieces of the meat offering shalt thou offer for a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.modern: It shall be made with oil on a griddle. You shall bring it well mixed, in baked pieces like a grain offering, and offer it for a sweet savour unto the LORD.

verses.kjv: And the priest of his sons that is anointed in his stead shall offer it: it is a statute for ever unto the LORD; it shall be wholly burnt.
verses.modern: The priest from among Aaron's sons, who is anointed to succeed him, shall offer it to the LORD as decreed forever. The whole of it shall be burned.

verses.kjv: For every meat offering for the priest shall be wholly burnt: it shall not be eaten.
verses.modern: Every grain offering of a priest shall be wholly burned. It shall not be eaten.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, saying, This is the law of the sin offering: In the place where the burnt offering is killed shall the sin offering be killed before the LORD: it is most holy.
verses.modern: 'Speak to Aaron and his sons, saying, This is the law of the sin offering. In the place where the burnt offering is killed shall the sin offering be killed before the LORD; it is most holy.

verses.kjv: The priest that offereth it for sin shall eat it: in the holy place shall it be eaten, in the court of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.modern: The priest who offers it for sin shall eat it. In a holy place it shall be eaten, in the court of the tent of meeting.

verses.kjv: Whatsoever shall touch the flesh thereof shall be holy: and when there is sprinkled of the blood thereof upon any garment, thou shalt wash that whereon it was sprinkled in the holy place.
verses.modern: Whatever touches its flesh shall be holy, and when any of its blood is splashed on a garment, you shall wash that on which it was splashed in a holy place.

verses.kjv: But the earthen vessel wherein it is sodden shall be broken: and if it be sodden in a brasen pot, it shall be both scoured, and rinsed in water.
verses.modern: the earthenware vessel in which it is boiled shall be broken. But if it is boiled in a bronze vessel, that shall be scoured and rinsed in water.

verses.kjv: All the males among the priests shall eat thereof: it is most holy.
verses.modern: Every male among the priests may eat of it; it is most holy.

verses.kjv: And no sin offering, whereof any of the blood is brought into the tabernacle of the congregation to reconcile withal in the holy place, shall be eaten: it shall be burnt in the fire.
verses.modern: But no sin offering shall be eaten from which any blood is brought into the tent of meeting to make atonement in the Holy Place; it shall be burned up with fire.'

chapters.summary: The LORD gives laws requiring restitution plus a fifth for sins of dishonesty against a neighbor. He then gives the priests detailed instructions for maintaining the perpetual fire on the altar and for properly handling the burnt offering, grain offering, and sin offering.

verses.kjv: Likewise this is the law of the trespass offering: it is most holy.
verses.modern: This is the law of the guilt offering. It is most holy.

verses.kjv: In the place where they kill the burnt offering shall they kill the trespass offering: and the blood thereof shall he sprinkle round about upon the altar.
verses.modern: In the place where they kill the burnt offering they shall kill the guilt offering, and its blood shall be thrown against the sides of the altar.

verses.kjv: And he shall offer of it all the fat thereof; the rump, and the fat that covereth the inwards,
verses.modern: all its fat shall be offered, the fat tail, the fat that covers the entrails,

verses.kjv: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the flanks, and the caul that is above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away:
verses.modern: the two kidneys with the fat that is on them at the loins, and the long lobe of the liver that He shall remove with the kidneys.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar for an offering made by fire unto the LORD: it is a trespass offering.
verses.modern: The priest shall burn them on the altar as a offering made by fire to the LORD; it is a guilt offering.

verses.kjv: Every male among the priests shall eat thereof: it shall be eaten in the holy place: it is most holy.
verses.modern: Every male among the priests may eat of it. It shall be eaten in a holy place. It is most holy.

verses.kjv: As the sin offering is, so is the trespass offering: there is one law for them: the priest that maketh atonement therewith shall have it.
verses.modern: The guilt offering is just like the sin offering; there is one law for them. The priest who makes atonement with it shall have it.

verses.kjv: And the priest that offereth any man's burnt offering, even the priest shall have to himself the skin of the burnt offering which he hath offered.
verses.modern: the priest who offers any man's burnt offering shall have for himself the skin of the burnt offering that he has offered.

verses.kjv: And all the meat offering that is baken in the oven, and all that is dressed in the fryingpan, and in the pan, shall be the priest's that offereth it.
verses.modern: every grain offering baked in the oven and all that is prepared on a pan or a griddle shall belong to the priest who offers it.

verses.kjv: And every meat offering, mingled with oil, and dry, shall all the sons of Aaron have, one as much as another.
verses.modern: every grain offering, mixed with oil or dry, shall be shared equally among all the sons of Aaron.

verses.kjv: And this is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which he shall offer unto the LORD.
verses.modern: this is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings that one may offer to the LORD.

verses.kjv: If he offer it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mingled with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and cakes mingled with oil, of fine flour, fried.
verses.modern: If He offers it for a thanksgiving, then He shall offer with the thanksgiving sacrifice unleavened loaves mixed with oil, unleavened wafers smeared with oil, and loaves of fine flour well mixed with oil.

verses.kjv: Besides the cakes, he shall offer for his offering leavened bread with the sacrifice of thanksgiving of his peace offerings.
verses.modern: With the sacrifice of His peace offerings for thanksgiving He shall bring His offering with loaves of leavened bread.

verses.kjv: And of it he shall offer one out of the whole oblation for an heave offering unto the LORD, and it shall be the priest's that sprinkleth the blood of the peace offerings.
verses.modern: from it He shall offer one loaf from each offering, as a gift to the LORD. It shall belong to the priest who throws the blood of the peace offerings.

verses.kjv: And the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten the same day that it is offered; he shall not leave any of it until the morning.
verses.modern: the flesh of the sacrifice of His peace offering for thanksgiving shall be eaten on the day of His offering. He shall not leave any of it until the morning.

verses.kjv: But if the sacrifice of his offering be a vow, or a voluntary offering, it shall be eaten the same day that he offereth his sacrifice: and on the morrow also the remainder of it shall be eaten:
verses.modern: But if the sacrifice of His offering is a vow or a freewill offering, it shall be eaten on the day that He offers His sacrifice, and on the next day what remains of it shall be eaten.

verses.kjv: But the remainder of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burnt with fire.
verses.modern: But what remains of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burned up with fire.

verses.kjv: And if any of the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings be eaten at all on the third day, it shall not be accepted, neither shall it be imputed unto him that offereth it: it shall be an abomination, and the soul that eateth of it shall bear his iniquity.
verses.modern: If any of the flesh of the sacrifice of His peace offering is eaten on the third day, He who offers it shall not be accepted, neither shall it be credited to Him. It is tainted. He who eats of it shall bear his iniquity.

verses.kjv: And the flesh that toucheth any unclean thing shall not be eaten; it shall be burnt with fire: and as for the flesh, all that be clean shall eat thereof.
verses.modern: Flesh that touches any unclean thing shall not be eaten. It shall be burned up with fire. All who are clean may eat flesh,

verses.kjv: But the soul that eateth of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, that pertain unto the LORD, having his uncleanness upon him, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.
verses.modern: but the person who eats of the flesh of the sacrifice of the LORD's peace offerings while He is unclean, that person shall be cut off from His people.

verses.kjv: Moreover the soul that shall touch any unclean thing, as the uncleanness of man, or any unclean beast, or any abominable unclean thing, and eat of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which pertain unto the LORD, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.
verses.modern: if anyone touches an unclean thing, whether human uncleanness or an unclean beast or any unclean detestable creature, and then eats some flesh from the sacrifice of the LORD's peace offerings, that person shall be cut off from His people.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Ye shall eat no manner of fat, of ox, or of sheep, or of goat.
verses.modern: 'Speak to the children of Israel, saying, You shall eat no fat, of ox or sheep or goat.

verses.kjv: And the fat of the beast that dieth of itself, and the fat of that which is torn with beasts, may be used in any other use: but ye shall in no wise eat of it.
verses.modern: The fat of an animal that dies of itself and the fat of one that is torn by beasts may be put to any other use, but on no account shall You eat it.

verses.kjv: For whosoever eateth the fat of the beast, of which men offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD, even the soul that eateth it shall be cut off from his people.
verses.modern: For every person who eats of the fat of an animal of which a offering made by fire may be made to the LORD shall be cut off from His people.

verses.kjv: Moreover ye shall eat no manner of blood, whether it be of fowl or of beast, in any of your dwellings.
verses.modern: Moreover, You shall eat no blood whatever, whether of fowl or of animal, in any of Your dwelling places.

verses.kjv: Whatsoever soul it be that eateth any manner of blood, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.
verses.modern: Whoever eats any blood, that person shall be cut off from His people.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, He that offereth the sacrifice of his peace offerings unto the LORD shall bring his oblation unto the LORD of the sacrifice of his peace offerings.
verses.modern: 'Speak to the children of Israel, saying, Whoever offers the sacrifice of his peace offerings to the LORD shall bring His offering to the LORD from the sacrifice of His peace offerings.

verses.kjv: His own hands shall bring the offerings of the LORD made by fire, the fat with the breast, it shall he bring, that the breast may be waved for a wave offering before the LORD.
verses.modern: His own hands shall bring the LORD's offerings made by fire. He shall bring the fat with the breast, that the breast may be waved as a wave offering before the LORD.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall burn the fat upon the altar: but the breast shall be Aaron's and his sons'.
verses.modern: The priest shall burn the fat on the altar, but the breast shall be for Aaron and his sons.

verses.kjv: And the right shoulder shall ye give unto the priest for an heave offering of the sacrifices of your peace offerings.
verses.modern: the right thigh you shall give to the priest as a contribution from the sacrifice of your peace offerings.

verses.kjv: He among the sons of Aaron, that offereth the blood of the peace offerings, and the fat, shall have the right shoulder for his part.
verses.modern: Whoever among the sons of Aaron offers the blood of the peace offerings and the fat shall have the right thigh for a portion.

verses.kjv: For the wave breast and the heave shoulder have I taken of the children of Israel from off the sacrifices of their peace offerings, and have given them unto Aaron the priest and unto his sons by a statute for ever from among the children of Israel.
verses.modern: For the breast that is waved and the thigh that is contributed I have taken from the children of Israel, out of the sacrifices of their peace offerings, and have given them to Aaron the priest and to his sons, as a perpetual due from the children of Israel.

verses.kjv: This is the portion of the anointing of Aaron, and of the anointing of his sons, out of the offerings of the LORD made by fire, in the day when he presented them to minister unto the LORD in the priest's office;
verses.modern: This is the portion of Aaron and of his sons from the LORD's offerings made by fire, from the day they were presented to serve as priests of the LORD.

verses.kjv: Which the LORD commanded to be given them of the children of Israel, in the day that he anointed them, by a statute for ever throughout their generations.
verses.modern: The LORD commanded this to be given them by the children of Israel, from the day that He anointed them. It is a perpetual due throughout their generations.

verses.kjv: This is the law of the burnt offering, of the meat offering, and of the sin offering, and of the trespass offering, and of the consecrations, and of the sacrifice of the peace offerings;
verses.modern: This is the law of the burnt offering, of the grain offering, of the sin offering, of the guilt offering, of the ordination offering, and of the peace offering,

verses.kjv: Which the LORD commanded Moses in mount Sinai, in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their oblations unto the LORD, in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.modern: which the LORD commanded Moses on Mount Sinai, on the day that he commanded the children of Israel to bring their offerings to the LORD, in the wilderness of Sinai.

chapters.summary: The LORD completes the laws of the offerings, detailing how the guilt offering and peace offering are to be handled. He forbids eating fat or blood under penalty of being cut off, and assigns the breast and right thigh of the peace offering to the priests as their perpetual portion.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments, and the anointing oil, and a bullock for the sin offering, and two rams, and a basket of unleavened bread;
verses.modern: 'Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments and the anointing oil and the bull of the sin offering and the two rams and the basket of unleavened bread.

verses.kjv: And gather thou all the congregation together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.modern: assemble all the congregation at the entrance of the tent of meeting.'

verses.kjv: And Moses did as the LORD commanded him; and the assembly was gathered together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.modern: Moses did as the LORD commanded Him, and the congregation was assembled at the entrance of the tent of meeting.

verses.kjv: And Moses said unto the congregation, This is the thing which the LORD commanded to be done.
verses.modern: Moses said to the congregation, 'This is the thing that the LORD has commanded to be done.'

verses.kjv: And Moses brought Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water.
verses.modern: Moses brought Aaron and his sons and washed them with water.

verses.kjv: And he put upon him the coat, and girded him with the girdle, and clothed him with the robe, and put the ephod upon him, and he girded him with the curious girdle of the ephod, and bound it unto him therewith.
verses.modern: he put the coat on him and tied the sash around his waist and clothed him with the robe and put the ephod on him and tied the skillfully woven band of the ephod around him, binding it to him with the band.

verses.kjv: And he put the breastplate upon him: also he put in the breastplate the Urim and the Thummim.
verses.modern: he placed the breastpiece on him, and in the breastpiece he put the Urim and the Thummim.

verses.kjv: And he put the mitre upon his head; also upon the mitre, even upon his forefront, did he put the golden plate, the holy crown; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.modern: he set the turban on His head, and on the turban, in front, He set the golden plate, the holy crown, as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.kjv: And Moses took the anointing oil, and anointed the tabernacle and all that was therein, and sanctified them.
verses.modern: Then Moses took the anointing oil and anointed the tabernacle and all that was in it, and consecrated them.

verses.kjv: And he sprinkled thereof upon the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all his vessels, both the laver and his foot, to sanctify them.
verses.modern: he sprinkled some of it on the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all its utensils and the basin and its stand, to consecrate them.

verses.kjv: And he poured of the anointing oil upon Aaron's head, and anointed him, to sanctify him.
verses.modern: he poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron's head and anointed him to consecrate him.

verses.kjv: And Moses brought Aaron's sons, and put coats upon them, and girded them with girdles, and put bonnets upon them; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.modern: Moses brought Aaron's sons and clothed them with coats and tied sashes around their waists and bound caps on them, as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.kjv: And he brought the bullock for the sin offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the bullock for the sin offering.
verses.modern: Then he brought the bull of the sin offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the bull of the sin offering.

verses.kjv: And he slew it; and Moses took the blood, and put it upon the horns of the altar round about with his finger, and purified the altar, and poured the blood at the bottom of the altar, and sanctified it, to make reconciliation upon it.
verses.modern: he killed it, and Moses took the blood, and with his finger put it on the horns of the altar around it and purified the altar and poured out the blood at the base of the altar and consecrated it to make atonement for it.

verses.kjv: And he took all the fat that was upon the inwards, and the caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and Moses burned it upon the altar.
verses.modern: he took all the fat that was on the entrails and the long lobe of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat, and Moses burned them on the altar.

verses.kjv: But the bullock, and his hide, his flesh, and his dung, he burnt with fire without the camp; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.modern: But the bull and its skin and its flesh and its dung He burned up with fire outside the camp, as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.kjv: And he brought the ram for the burnt offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.
verses.modern: Then he presented the ram of the burnt offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram.

verses.kjv: And he killed it; and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.
verses.modern: he killed it, and Moses threw the blood against the sides of the altar.

verses.kjv: And he cut the ram into pieces; and Moses burnt the head, and the pieces, and the fat.
verses.modern: He cut the ram into pieces, and Moses burned the head and the pieces and the fat.

verses.kjv: And he washed the inwards and the legs in water; and Moses burnt the whole ram upon the altar: it was a burnt sacrifice for a sweet savour, and an offering made by fire unto the LORD; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.modern: He washed the entrails and the legs with water, and Moses burned the whole ram on the altar. It was a burnt offering with a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto the LORD, as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.kjv: And he brought the other ram, the ram of consecration: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.
verses.modern: Then he presented the other ram, the ram of ordination, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram.

verses.kjv: And he slew it; and Moses took of the blood of it, and put it upon the tip of Aaron's right ear, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot.
verses.modern: he killed it, and Moses took some of its blood and put it on the lobe of Aaron's right ear and on the thumb of his right hand and on the big toe of his right foot.

verses.kjv: And he brought Aaron's sons, and Moses put of the blood upon the tip of their right ear, and upon the thumbs of their right hands, and upon the great toes of their right feet: and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.
verses.modern: Then he presented Aaron's sons, and Moses put some of the blood on the lobes of their right ears and on the thumbs of their right hands and on the big toes of their right feet. And Moses threw the blood against the sides of the altar.

verses.kjv: And he took the fat, and the rump, and all the fat that was upon the inwards, and the caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and the right shoulder:
verses.modern: Then he took the fat and the fat tail and all the fat that was on the entrails and the long lobe of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat and the right thigh,

verses.kjv: And out of the basket of unleavened bread, that was before the LORD, he took one unleavened cake, and a cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and put them on the fat, and upon the right shoulder:
verses.modern: out of the basket of unleavened bread that was before the LORD He took one unleavened loaf and one loaf of bread with oil and one wafer and placed them on the pieces of fat and on the right thigh.

verses.kjv: And he put all upon Aaron's hands, and upon his sons' hands, and waved them for a wave offering before the LORD.
verses.modern: he put all these in the hands of Aaron and in the hands of his sons and waved them as a wave offering before the LORD.

verses.kjv: And Moses took them from off their hands, and burnt them on the altar upon the burnt offering: they were consecrations for a sweet savour: it is an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.modern: Then Moses took them from their hands and burned them on the altar with the burnt offering. This was an ordination offering with a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto the LORD.

verses.kjv: And Moses took the breast, and waved it for a wave offering before the LORD: for of the ram of consecration it was Moses' part; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.modern: Moses took the breast and waved it for a wave offering before the LORD. It was Moses' portion of the ram of ordination, as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.kjv: And Moses took of the anointing oil, and of the blood which was upon the altar, and sprinkled it upon Aaron, and upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon his sons' garments with him; and sanctified Aaron, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons' garments with him.
verses.modern: Then Moses took some of the anointing oil and of the blood that was on the altar and sprinkled it on Aaron and his garments, and also on his sons and his sons' garments. So he consecrated Aaron and his garments, and his sons and his sons' garments with him.

verses.kjv: And Moses said unto Aaron and to his sons, Boil the flesh at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and there eat it with the bread that is in the basket of consecrations, as I commanded, saying, Aaron and his sons shall eat it.
verses.modern: Moses said to Aaron and his sons, 'Boil the flesh at the entrance of the tent of meeting, and there eat it and the bread that is in the basket of ordination offerings, as I commanded, saying, Aaron and his sons shall eat it.

verses.kjv: And that which remaineth of the flesh and of the bread shall ye burn with fire.
verses.modern: what remains of the flesh and the bread you shall burn up with fire.

verses.kjv: And ye shall not go out of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation in seven days, until the days of your consecration be at an end: for seven days shall he consecrate you.
verses.modern: you shall not go outside the entrance of the tent of meeting for seven days, until the days of your ordination are completed, for it will take seven days to ordain you.

verses.kjv: As he hath done this day, so the LORD hath commanded to do, to make an atonement for you.
verses.modern: As has been done today, the LORD has commanded to be done to make atonement for You.

verses.kjv: Therefore shall ye abide at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation day and night seven days, and keep the charge of the LORD, that ye die not: for so I am commanded.
verses.modern: At the entrance of the tent of meeting You shall remain day and night for seven days, performing what the LORD has charged, so that You do not die, for so I have been commanded.'

verses.kjv: So Aaron and his sons did all things which the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.
verses.modern: Aaron and his sons did all the things that the LORD commanded by Moses.

chapters.summary: Moses consecrates Aaron and his sons as priests before the whole congregation. He washes them, clothes Aaron in the priestly garments, anoints the tabernacle and altar with oil, and offers a bull and two rams for their ordination over seven days.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass on the eighth day, that Moses called Aaron and his sons, and the elders of Israel;
verses.modern: On the eighth day Moses called Aaron and his sons and the elders of Israel,

verses.kjv: And he said unto Aaron, Take thee a young calf for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering, without blemish, and offer them before the LORD.
verses.modern: he said to Aaron, 'Take for yourself a bull calf for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering, both without blemish, and offer them before the LORD.

verses.kjv: And unto the children of Israel thou shalt speak, saying, Take ye a kid of the goats for a sin offering; and a calf and a lamb, both of the first year, without blemish, for a burnt offering;
verses.modern: say to the children of Israel, Take a male goat for a sin offering, and a calf and a lamb, both a year old without blemish, for a burnt offering,

verses.kjv: Also a bullock and a ram for peace offerings, to sacrifice before the LORD; and a meat offering mingled with oil: for to day the LORD will appear unto you.
verses.modern: an ox and a ram for peace offerings, to sacrifice before the LORD, and a grain offering mixed with oil, for today the LORD will appear to You.'

verses.kjv: And they brought that which Moses commanded before the tabernacle of the congregation: and all the congregation drew near and stood before the LORD.
verses.modern: they brought what Moses commanded in front of the tent of meeting. All the congregation drew near and stood before the LORD.

verses.kjv: And Moses said, This is the thing which the LORD commanded that ye should do: and the glory of the LORD shall appear unto you.
verses.modern: Moses said, 'This is the thing that the LORD commanded You to do, that the glory of the LORD may appear to You.'

verses.kjv: And Moses said unto Aaron, Go unto the altar, and offer thy sin offering, and thy burnt offering, and make an atonement for thyself, and for the people: and offer the offering of the people, and make an atonement for them; as the LORD commanded.
verses.modern: Then Moses said to Aaron, 'Draw near to the altar and offer your sin offering and your burnt offering and make atonement for yourself and for the people, and bring the offering of the people and make atonement for them, as the LORD has commanded.'

verses.kjv: Aaron therefore went unto the altar, and slew the calf of the sin offering, which was for himself.
verses.modern: So Aaron drew near to the altar and killed the calf of the sin offering, which was for himself.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Aaron brought the blood unto him: and he dipped his finger in the blood, and put it upon the horns of the altar, and poured out the blood at the bottom of the altar:
verses.modern: the sons of Aaron presented the blood to him. He dipped his finger in the blood and put it on the horns of the altar and poured out the blood at the base of the altar.

verses.kjv: But the fat, and the kidneys, and the caul above the liver of the sin offering, he burnt upon the altar; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.modern: But the fat and the kidneys and the long lobe of the liver from the sin offering He burned on the altar, as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.kjv: And the flesh and the hide he burnt with fire without the camp.
verses.modern: The flesh and the skin He burned up with fire outside the camp.

verses.kjv: And he slew the burnt offering; and Aaron's sons presented unto him the blood, which he sprinkled round about upon the altar.
verses.modern: Then he killed the burnt offering, and Aaron's sons handed him the blood. He threw it against the sides of the altar.

verses.kjv: And they presented the burnt offering unto him, with the pieces thereof, and the head: and he burnt them upon the altar.
verses.modern: they handed the burnt offering to him, piece by piece, and the head. He burned them on the altar.

verses.kjv: And he did wash the inwards and the legs, and burnt them upon the burnt offering on the altar.
verses.modern: he washed the entrails and the legs and burned them with the burnt offering on the altar.

verses.kjv: And he brought the people's offering, and took the goat, which was the sin offering for the people, and slew it, and offered it for sin, as the first.
verses.modern: Then he presented the people's offering and took the goat of the sin offering that was for the people and killed it and offered it as a sin offering, like the first one.

verses.kjv: And he brought the burnt offering, and offered it according to the manner.
verses.modern: he presented the burnt offering and offered it according to the rule.

verses.kjv: And he brought the meat offering, and took an handful thereof, and burnt it upon the altar, beside the burnt sacrifice of the morning.
verses.modern: he presented the grain offering, took a handful of it, and burned it on the altar, besides the burnt offering of the morning.

verses.kjv: He slew also the bullock and the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings, which was for the people: and Aaron's sons presented unto him the blood, which he sprinkled upon the altar round about,
verses.modern: Then he killed the ox and the ram, the sacrifice of peace offerings for the people. And Aaron's sons handed him the blood. He threw it against the sides of the altar.

verses.kjv: And the fat of the bullock and of the ram, the rump, and that which covereth the inwards, and the kidneys, and the caul above the liver:
verses.modern: But the fat pieces of the ox and of the ram, the fat tail and that which covers the entrails and the kidneys and the long lobe of the liver —

verses.kjv: And they put the fat upon the breasts, and he burnt the fat upon the altar:
verses.modern: they put the fat pieces on the breasts. He burned the fat pieces on the altar,

verses.kjv: And the breasts and the right shoulder Aaron waved for a wave offering before the LORD; as Moses commanded.
verses.modern: but the breasts and the right thigh Aaron waved for a wave offering before the LORD, as Moses commanded.

verses.kjv: And Aaron lifted up his hand toward the people, and blessed them, and came down from offering of the sin offering, and the burnt offering, and peace offerings.
verses.modern: Then Aaron lifted up his hands toward the people and blessed them. He came down from offering the sin offering and the burnt offering and the peace offerings.

verses.kjv: And Moses and Aaron went into the tabernacle of the congregation, and came out, and blessed the people: and the glory of the LORD appeared unto all the people.
verses.modern: Moses and Aaron went into the tent of meeting, and when they came out they blessed the people, and the glory of the LORD appeared to all the people.

verses.kjv: And there came a fire out from before the LORD, and consumed upon the altar the burnt offering and the fat: which when all the people saw, they shouted, and fell on their faces.
verses.modern: fire came out from before the LORD and consumed the burnt offering and the pieces of fat on the altar, and when all the people saw it, they shouted and fell on their faces.

chapters.summary: On the eighth day Aaron begins his priestly ministry, offering a sin offering and burnt offering for himself and the people. The glory of the LORD appeared to all the people, and fire came out from the LORD and consumed the offering on the altar.

verses.kjv: And Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, took either of them his censer, and put fire therein, and put incense thereon, and offered strange fire before the LORD, which he commanded them not.
verses.modern: Now Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, each took his censer and put fire in it and laid incense on it and offered unauthorized fire before the LORD, which He had not commanded them.

verses.kjv: And there went out fire from the LORD, and devoured them, and they died before the LORD.
verses.modern: fire came out from before the LORD and consumed them. They died before the LORD.

verses.kjv: Then Moses said unto Aaron, This is it that the LORD spake, saying, I will be sanctified in them that come nigh me, and before all the people I will be glorified. And Aaron held his peace.
verses.modern: Then Moses said to Aaron, 'This is what the LORD has said: Among those who are near me I will be sanctified, and before all the people I will be glorified.' And Aaron held his peace.

verses.kjv: And Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron, and said unto them, Come near, carry your brethren from before the sanctuary out of the camp.
verses.modern: Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron, and said to them, 'Come near; carry your brothers away from the front of the sanctuary and out of the camp.'

verses.kjv: So they went near, and carried them in their coats out of the camp; as Moses had said.
verses.modern: So they came near and carried them in their coats out of the camp, as Moses had said.
