verses.kjv: And Moses said unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons, Uncover not your heads, neither rend your clothes; lest ye die, and lest wrath come upon all the people: but let your brethren, the whole house of Israel, bewail the burning which the LORD hath kindled.
verses.modern: Moses said to Aaron and to Eleazar and Ithamar his sons, 'Do not let the hair of your heads hang loose, and do not tear your clothes, lest You die, and wrath come upon all the congregation. But let Your brothers, the whole house of Israel, bewail the burning that the LORD has kindled.

verses.kjv: And ye shall not go out from the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, lest ye die: for the anointing oil of the LORD is upon you. And they did according to the word of Moses.
verses.modern: do not go outside the entrance of the tent of meeting, lest You die, for the anointing oil of the LORD is upon You.' And they did according to the word of Moses.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Aaron, saying,
verses.modern: the LORD spoke to Aaron, saying,

verses.kjv: Do not drink wine nor strong drink, thou, nor thy sons with thee, when ye go into the tabernacle of the congregation, lest ye die: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations:
verses.modern: 'Drink no wine or strong drink, You or Your sons with You, when You go into the tent of meeting, lest You die. It shall be a statute forever throughout Your generations.

verses.kjv: And that ye may put difference between holy and unholy, and between unclean and clean;
verses.modern: You are to distinguish between the holy and the common, and between the unclean and the clean,

verses.kjv: And that ye may teach the children of Israel all the statutes which the LORD hath spoken unto them by the hand of Moses.
verses.modern: you are to teach the children of Israel all the statutes that the LORD has spoken to them by Moses.'

verses.kjv: And Moses spake unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons that were left, Take the meat offering that remaineth of the offerings of the LORD made by fire, and eat it without leaven beside the altar: for it is most holy:
verses.modern: Moses spoke to Aaron and to Eleazar and Ithamar, his surviving sons, 'Take the grain offering that is left of the LORD's offerings made by fire, and eat it unleavened beside the altar, for it is most holy.

verses.kjv: And ye shall eat it in the holy place, because it is thy due, and thy sons' due, of the sacrifices of the LORD made by fire: for so I am commanded.
verses.modern: You shall eat it in a holy place, because it is Your due and Your sons' due, from the LORD's offerings made by fire, for so I am commanded.

verses.kjv: And the wave breast and heave shoulder shall ye eat in a clean place; thou, and thy sons, and thy daughters with thee: for they be thy due, and thy sons' due, which are given out of the sacrifices of peace offerings of the children of Israel.
verses.modern: But the breast that is waved and the thigh that is contributed You shall eat in a clean place, You and Your sons and Your daughters with You, for they are given as Your due and Your sons' due from the sacrifices of the peace offerings of the children of Israel.

verses.kjv: The heave shoulder and the wave breast shall they bring with the offerings made by fire of the fat, to wave it for a wave offering before the LORD; and it shall be thine, and thy sons' with thee, by a statute for ever; as the LORD hath commanded.
verses.modern: The thigh that is contributed and the breast that is waved they shall bring with the offerings made by fire of the fat pieces, to wave for a wave offering before the LORD. It shall be Yours and Your sons' with You as a due forever, as the LORD has commanded.'

verses.kjv: And Moses diligently sought the goat of the sin offering, and, behold, it was burnt: and he was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar, the sons of Aaron which were left alive, saying,
verses.modern: Now Moses diligently inquired about the goat of the sin offering. It was burned up! And he was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar, the surviving sons of Aaron, saying,

verses.kjv: Wherefore have ye not eaten the sin offering in the holy place, seeing it is most holy, and God hath given it you to bear the iniquity of the congregation, to make atonement for them before the LORD?
verses.modern: 'Why have You not eaten the sin offering in the place of the sanctuary, since it is a thing most holy and has been given to You that You may bear the iniquity of the congregation, to make atonement for them before the LORD?

verses.kjv: Behold, the blood of it was not brought in within the holy place: ye should indeed have eaten it in the holy place, as I commanded.
verses.modern: its blood was not brought into the inner part of the sanctuary. You certainly ought to have eaten it in the sanctuary, as I commanded.'

verses.kjv: And Aaron said unto Moses, Behold, this day have they offered their sin offering and their burnt offering before the LORD; and such things have befallen me: and if I had eaten the sin offering to day, should it have been accepted in the sight of the LORD?
verses.modern: Aaron said to Moses, 'Today they have offered their sin offering and their burnt offering before the LORD, and yet such things as these have happened to me! If I had eaten the sin offering today, would the LORD have approved?'

verses.kjv: And when Moses heard that, he was content.
verses.modern: when Moses heard that, he approved.

chapters.summary: Nadab and Abihu offer unauthorized fire before the LORD, and fire from the LORD consumes them. Moses instructs Aaron not to mourn publicly, the LORD commands the priests not to drink wine when entering the tent of meeting, and Moses rebukes Eleazar and Ithamar for mishandling the sin offering.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying unto them,
verses.modern: The LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying to them,

verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, These are the beasts which ye shall eat among all the beasts that are on the earth:
verses.modern: 'Speak to the children of Israel, saying, These are the living things that You may eat among all the animals that are on the earth.

verses.kjv: Whatsoever parteth the hoof, and is clovenfooted, and cheweth the cud, among the beasts, that shall ye eat.
verses.modern: Whatever parts the hoof and is cloven-footed and chews the cud, among the animals, You may eat.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless these shall ye not eat of them that chew the cud, or of them that divide the hoof: as the camel, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.
verses.modern: Nevertheless, among those that chew the cud or part the hoof, You shall not eat these: the camel, because it chews the cud but does not part the hoof, is unclean to You.

verses.kjv: And the coney, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.
verses.modern: the rock badger, because it chews the cud but does not part the hoof, is unclean to You.

verses.kjv: And the hare, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.
verses.modern: the hare, because it chews the cud but does not part the hoof, is unclean to You.

verses.kjv: And the swine, though he divide the hoof, and be clovenfooted, yet he cheweth not the cud; he is unclean to you.
verses.modern: the pig, because it parts the hoof and is cloven-footed but does not chew the cud, is unclean to You.

verses.kjv: Of their flesh shall ye not eat, and their carcase shall ye not touch; they are unclean to you.
verses.modern: You shall not eat any of their flesh, and You shall not touch their carcasses; they are unclean to You.

verses.kjv: These shall ye eat of all that are in the waters: whatsoever hath fins and scales in the waters, in the seas, and in the rivers, them shall ye eat.
verses.modern: These You may eat, of all that are in the waters. Everything in the waters that has fins and scales, whether in the seas or in the rivers, You may eat.

verses.kjv: And all that have not fins and scales in the seas, and in the rivers, of all that move in the waters, and of any living thing which is in the waters, they shall be an abomination unto you:
verses.modern: But anything in the seas or the rivers that does not have fins and scales, of the swarming creatures in the waters and of the living creatures that are in the waters, is detestable to You.

verses.kjv: They shall be even an abomination unto you; ye shall not eat of their flesh, but ye shall have their carcases in abomination.
verses.modern: They shall remain detestable to You; You shall not eat any of their flesh, and You shall detest their carcasses.

verses.kjv: Whatsoever hath no fins nor scales in the waters, that shall be an abomination unto you.
verses.modern: Everything in the waters that does not have fins and scales is detestable to You.

verses.kjv: And these are they which ye shall have in abomination among the fowls; they shall not be eaten, they are an abomination: the eagle, and the ossifrage, and the ospray,
verses.modern: these You shall detest among the birds; they shall not be eaten; they are detestable: the eagle, the ossifrage, and the ospray,

verses.kjv: And the vulture, and the kite after his kind;
verses.modern: the vulture, and the kite after His kind,

verses.kjv: Every raven after his kind;
verses.modern: every raven of any kind,

verses.kjv: And the owl, and the night hawk, and the cuckow, and the hawk after his kind,
verses.modern: the owl, and the night hawk, and the cuckow, and the hawk after His kind,

verses.kjv: And the little owl, and the cormorant, and the great owl,
verses.modern: the little owl, and the cormorant, and the great owl,

verses.kjv: And the swan, and the pelican, and the gier eagle,
verses.modern: the swan, and the pelican, and the gier eagle,

verses.kjv: And the stork, the heron after her kind, and the lapwing, and the bat.
verses.modern: the stork, the heron after her kind, and the lapwing, and the bat.

verses.kjv: All fowls that creep, going upon all four, shall be an abomination unto you.
verses.modern: All winged insects that go on all fours are detestable to You.

verses.kjv: Yet these may ye eat of every flying creeping thing that goeth upon all four, which have legs above their feet, to leap withal upon the earth;
verses.modern: Yet among the winged insects that go on all fours You may eat those that have jointed legs above their feet, with which to hop on the ground.

verses.kjv: Even these of them ye may eat; the locust after his kind, and the bald locust after his kind, and the beetle after his kind, and the grasshopper after his kind.
verses.modern: Of them You may eat: the locust of any kind, the bald locust of any kind, the cricket of any kind, and the grasshopper of any kind.

verses.kjv: But all other flying creeping things, which have four feet, shall be an abomination unto you.
verses.modern: But all other winged insects that have four feet are detestable to You.

verses.kjv: And for these ye shall be unclean: whosoever toucheth the carcase of them shall be unclean until the even.
verses.modern: by these You shall become unclean. Whoever touches their carcass shall be unclean until the evening,

verses.kjv: And whosoever beareth ought of the carcase of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.
verses.modern: whoever carries any part of their carcass shall wash His clothes and be unclean until the evening.

verses.kjv: The carcases of every beast which divideth the hoof, and is not clovenfooted, nor cheweth the cud, are unclean unto you: every one that toucheth them shall be unclean.
verses.modern: Every animal that parts the hoof but is not cloven-footed or does not chew the cud is unclean to You. Everyone who touches them shall be unclean.

verses.kjv: And whatsoever goeth upon his paws, among all manner of beasts that go on all four, those are unclean unto you: whoso toucheth their carcase shall be unclean until the even.
verses.modern: all that walk on their paws, among the animals that go on all fours, are unclean to You. Whoever touches their carcass shall be unclean until the evening.

verses.kjv: And he that beareth the carcase of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: they are unclean unto you.
verses.modern: he who carries their carcass shall wash his clothes and be unclean until the evening; they are unclean to You.

verses.kjv: These also shall be unclean unto you among the creeping things that creep upon the earth; the weasel, and the mouse, and the tortoise after his kind,
verses.modern: these are unclean to You among the swarming things that swarm on the ground: the mole rat, the mouse, the great lizard of any kind,

verses.kjv: And the ferret, and the chameleon, and the lizard, and the snail, and the mole.
verses.modern: the gecko, the monitor lizard, the lizard, the sand lizard, and the chameleon.

verses.kjv: These are unclean to you among all that creep: whosoever doth touch them, when they be dead, shall be unclean until the even.
verses.modern: These are unclean to You among all that swarm. Whoever touches them when they are dead shall be unclean until the evening.

verses.kjv: And upon whatsoever any of them, when they are dead, doth fall, it shall be unclean; whether it be any vessel of wood, or raiment, or skin, or sack, whatsoever vessel it be, wherein any work is done, it must be put into water, and it shall be unclean until the even; so it shall be cleansed.
verses.modern: anything on which any of them falls when they are dead shall be unclean, whether it is an article of wood or a garment or a skin or a sack, any article that is used for any purpose. It must be put into water. It shall be unclean until the evening; then it shall be clean.

verses.kjv: And every earthen vessel, whereinto any of them falleth, whatsoever is in it shall be unclean; and ye shall break it.
verses.modern: if any of them falls into any earthenware vessel, all that is in it shall be unclean, and You shall break it.

verses.kjv: Of all meat which may be eaten, that on which such water cometh shall be unclean: and all drink that may be drunk in every such vessel shall be unclean.
verses.modern: Any food in it that could be eaten, on which water comes, shall be unclean. And all drink that could be drunk from every such vessel shall be unclean.

verses.kjv: And every thing whereupon any part of their carcase falleth shall be unclean; whether it be oven, or ranges for pots, they shall be broken down: for they are unclean, and shall be unclean unto you.
verses.modern: everything on which any part of their carcass falls shall be unclean. Whether oven or stove, it shall be broken in pieces. They are unclean and shall remain unclean to You.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless a fountain or pit, wherein there is plenty of water, shall be clean: but that which toucheth their carcase shall be unclean.
verses.modern: Nevertheless, a spring or a cistern holding water shall be clean, but whoever touches a carcass in them shall be unclean.

verses.kjv: And if any part of their carcase fall upon any sowing seed which is to be sown, it shall be clean.
verses.modern: if any part of their carcass falls upon any seed grain that is to be sown, it is clean.

verses.kjv: But if any water be put upon the seed, and any part of their carcase fall thereon, it shall be unclean unto you.
verses.modern: But if water is put on the seed and any part of their carcass falls on it, it is unclean to You.

verses.kjv: And if any beast, of which ye may eat, die; he that toucheth the carcase thereof shall be unclean until the even.
verses.modern: if any animal which You may eat dies, whoever touches its carcass shall be unclean until the evening,

verses.kjv: And he that eateth of the carcase of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: he also that beareth the carcase of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.
verses.modern: whoever eats of its carcass shall wash his clothes and be unclean until the evening. And whoever carries the carcass shall wash his clothes and be unclean until the evening.

verses.kjv: And every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth shall be an abomination; it shall not be eaten.
verses.modern: Every swarming thing that swarms on the ground is detestable; it shall not be eaten.

verses.kjv: Whatsoever goeth upon the belly, and whatsoever goeth upon all four, or whatsoever hath more feet among all creeping things that creep upon the earth, them ye shall not eat; for they are an abomination.
verses.modern: Whatever goes on its belly, and whatever goes on all fours, or whatever has many feet, any swarming thing that swarms on the ground, You shall not eat, for they are detestable.

verses.kjv: Ye shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing that creepeth, neither shall ye make yourselves unclean with them, that ye should be defiled thereby.
verses.modern: You shall not make yourselves detestable with any swarming thing that swarms, and You shall not defile yourselves with them, and become unclean through them.

verses.kjv: For I am the LORD your God: ye shall therefore sanctify yourselves, and ye shall be holy; for I am holy: neither shall ye defile yourselves with any manner of creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.
verses.modern: For I am the LORD Your God. Consecrate yourselves therefore, and be holy, for I am holy. You shall not defile yourselves with any swarming thing that crawls on the ground.

verses.kjv: For I am the LORD that bringeth you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: ye shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.
verses.modern: For I am the LORD Who brought You up out of the land of Egypt to be Your God. You shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.

verses.kjv: This is the law of the beasts, and of the fowl, and of every living creature that moveth in the waters, and of every creature that creepeth upon the earth:
verses.modern: This is the law about beast and bird and every living creature that moves through the waters and every creature that swarms on the ground,

verses.kjv: To make a difference between the unclean and the clean, and between the beast that may be eaten and the beast that may not be eaten.
verses.modern: to make a distinction between the unclean and the clean and between the living creature that may be eaten and the living creature that may not be eaten.'

chapters.summary: The LORD gives laws distinguishing clean from unclean animals. Land animals must chew the cud and have split hooves; water creatures must have fins and scales; specific birds and insects are listed as unclean. Israel is to be holy because the LORD is holy.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a woman have conceived seed, and born a man child: then she shall be unclean seven days; according to the days of the separation for her infirmity shall she be unclean.
verses.modern: 'Speak to the children of Israel, saying, If a woman conceives and bears a male child, then she shall be unclean seven days. As at the time of her menstrual impurity, she shall be unclean.

verses.kjv: And in the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.
verses.modern: on the eighth day the flesh of His foreskin shall be circumcised.

verses.kjv: And she shall then continue in the blood of her purifying three and thirty days; she shall touch no hallowed thing, nor come into the sanctuary, until the days of her purifying be fulfilled.
verses.modern: Then she shall continue for thirty-three days in the blood of her purifying. She shall not touch anything holy, nor come into the sanctuary, until the days of her purifying are completed.

verses.kjv: But if she bear a maid child, then she shall be unclean two weeks, as in her separation: and she shall continue in the blood of her purifying threescore and six days.
verses.modern: But if she bears a female child, then she shall be unclean for two weeks, as in her menstrual impurity. And she shall continue in the blood of her purifying for sixty-six days.

verses.kjv: And when the days of her purifying are fulfilled, for a son, or for a daughter, she shall bring a lamb of the first year for a burnt offering, and a young pigeon, or a turtledove, for a sin offering, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, unto the priest:
verses.modern: when the days of her purifying are completed, whether for a son or for a daughter, she shall bring to the priest at the entrance of the tent of meeting a lamb a year old for a burnt offering, and a pigeon or a turtledove for a sin offering.

verses.kjv: Who shall offer it before the LORD, and make an atonement for her; and she shall be cleansed from the issue of her blood. This is the law for her that hath born a male or a female.
verses.modern: he shall offer it before the LORD and make atonement for her. Then she shall be clean from the flow of her blood. This is the law for her who bears a child, either male or female.

verses.kjv: And if she be not able to bring a lamb, then she shall bring two turtles, or two young pigeons; the one for the burnt offering, and the other for a sin offering: and the priest shall make an atonement for her, and she shall be clean.
verses.modern: if she cannot afford a lamb, then she shall take two turtledoves or two pigeons, one for a burnt offering and the other for a sin offering. And the priest shall make atonement for her. She shall be clean.'

chapters.summary: The LORD gives laws concerning purification after childbirth. A woman is unclean seven days after bearing a son and fourteen days after a daughter, followed by additional days of purification, after which she brings a burnt offering and sin offering to the priest.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron, saying,
verses.modern: The LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,

verses.kjv: When a man shall have in the skin of his flesh a rising, a scab, or bright spot, and it be in the skin of his flesh like the plague of leprosy; then he shall be brought unto Aaron the priest, or unto one of his sons the priests:
verses.modern: 'When a person has on the skin of his body a swelling or an eruption or a spot. It turns into a case of leprous disease on the skin of his body, then he shall be brought to Aaron the priest or to one of his sons the priests,

verses.kjv: And the priest shall look on the plague in the skin of the flesh: and when the hair in the plague is turned white, and the plague in sight be deeper than the skin of his flesh, it is a plague of leprosy: and the priest shall look on him, and pronounce him unclean.
verses.modern: the priest shall examine the diseased area on the skin of his body. And if the hair in the diseased area has turned white and the disease appears to be deeper than the skin of his body, it is a case of leprous disease. When the priest has examined him, he shall pronounce him unclean.

verses.kjv: If the bright spot be white in the skin of his flesh, and in sight be not deeper than the skin, and the hair thereof be not turned white; then the priest shall shut up him that hath the plague seven days:
verses.modern: But if the spot is white in the skin of his body and appears no deeper than the skin, and the hair in it has not turned white, the priest shall shut up the diseased person for seven days.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall look on him the seventh day: and, behold, if the plague in his sight be at a stay, and the plague spread not in the skin; then the priest shall shut him up seven days more:
verses.modern: the priest shall examine him on the seventh day, and if in his eyes the disease has not spread in the skin, then the priest shall shut him up for another seven days.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall look on him again the seventh day: and, behold, if the plague be somewhat dark, and the plague spread not in the skin, the priest shall pronounce him clean: it is but a scab: and he shall wash his clothes, and be clean.
verses.modern: Then the priest shall examine him again on the seventh day, and if the diseased area has faded and the disease has not spread in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him clean; it is only an eruption. And he shall wash his clothes and be clean.

verses.kjv: But if the scab spread much abroad in the skin, after that he hath shewed himself to the priest for his cleansing, he shall be seen of the priest again:
verses.modern: But if the eruption spreads in the skin, after he has shown himself to the priest for his cleansing, he shall appear again before the priest.

verses.kjv: And if the priest see that, behold, the scab spreadeth in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a leprosy.
verses.modern: the priest shall look, and if the eruption has spread in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean; it is a leprous disease.

verses.kjv: When the plague of leprosy is in a man, then he shall be brought unto the priest;
verses.modern: When a man is afflicted with a leprous disease, he shall be brought to the priest,

verses.kjv: And the priest shall see him: and, behold, if the rising be white in the skin, and it have turned the hair white, and there be quick raw flesh in the rising;
verses.modern: the priest shall look. And if there is a white swelling in the skin that has turned the hair white, and there is raw flesh in the swelling,

verses.kjv: It is an old leprosy in the skin of his flesh, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean, and shall not shut him up: for he is unclean.
verses.modern: it is a chronic leprous disease in the skin of his body, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean. He shall not shut him up, for he is unclean.

verses.kjv: And if a leprosy break out abroad in the skin, and the leprosy cover all the skin of him that hath the plague from his head even to his foot, wheresoever the priest looketh;
verses.modern: if the leprous disease breaks out in the skin, so that the leprous disease covers all the skin of the diseased person from head to foot, as far as the priest can see,

verses.kjv: Then the priest shall consider: and, behold, if the leprosy have covered all his flesh, he shall pronounce him clean that hath the plague: it is all turned white: he is clean.
verses.modern: then the priest shall look, and if the leprous disease has covered all his body, he shall pronounce him clean of the disease; it has all turned white. He is clean.

verses.kjv: But when raw flesh appeareth in him, he shall be unclean.
verses.modern: But when raw flesh appears on him, he shall be unclean.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall see the raw flesh, and pronounce him to be unclean: for the raw flesh is unclean: it is a leprosy.
verses.modern: the priest shall examine the raw flesh and pronounce him unclean. Raw flesh is unclean, for it is a leprous disease.

verses.kjv: Or if the raw flesh turn again, and be changed unto white, he shall come unto the priest;
verses.modern: But if the raw flesh recovers and turns white again, then he shall come to the priest,

verses.kjv: And the priest shall see him: and, behold, if the plague be turned into white; then the priest shall pronounce him clean that hath the plague: he is clean.
verses.modern: the priest shall examine him, and if the disease has turned white, then the priest shall pronounce the diseased person clean; he is clean.

verses.kjv: The flesh also, in which, even in the skin thereof, was a boil, and is healed,
verses.modern: when there is in the skin of one's body a boil that has healed,

verses.kjv: And in the place of the boil there be a white rising, or a bright spot, white, and somewhat reddish, and it be shewed to the priest;
verses.modern: in the place of the boil there comes a white swelling or a reddish-white spot, then it shall be shown to the priest.

verses.kjv: And if, when the priest seeth it, behold, it be in sight lower than the skin, and the hair thereof be turned white; the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a plague of leprosy broken out of the boil.
verses.modern: the priest shall look, and if it appears deeper than the skin and its hair has turned white, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is a leprous disease that has broken out in the boil.

verses.kjv: But if the priest look on it, and, behold, there be no white hairs therein, and if it be not lower than the skin, but be somewhat dark; then the priest shall shut him up seven days:
verses.modern: But if the priest examines it and there is no white hair in it and it is not deeper than the skin, but has faded, then the priest shall shut him up seven days.

verses.kjv: And if it spread much abroad in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a plague.
verses.modern: if it spreads in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean; it is a disease.

verses.kjv: But if the bright spot stay in his place, and spread not, it is a burning boil; and the priest shall pronounce him clean.
verses.modern: But if the spot remains in one place and does not spread, it is the scar of the boil, and the priest shall pronounce him clean.

verses.kjv: Or if there be any flesh, in the skin whereof there is a hot burning, and the quick flesh that burneth have a white bright spot, somewhat reddish, or white;
verses.modern: Or, when the body has a burn on its skin and the raw flesh of the burn becomes a spot, reddish-white or white,

verses.kjv: Then the priest shall look upon it: and, behold, if the hair in the bright spot be turned white, and it be in sight deeper than the skin; it is a leprosy broken out of the burning: wherefore the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is the plague of leprosy.
verses.modern: the priest shall examine it, and if the hair in the spot has turned white and it appears deeper than the skin, then it is a leprous disease that has broken out in the burn. The priest shall pronounce him unclean; it is a leprous disease.

verses.kjv: But if the priest look on it, and, behold, there be no white hair in the bright spot, and it be no lower than the other skin, but be somewhat dark; then the priest shall shut him up seven days:
verses.modern: But if the priest examines it and there is no white hair in the spot and it is no deeper than the skin, but has faded, the priest shall shut him up seven days.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall look upon him the seventh day: and if it be spread much abroad in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is the plague of leprosy.
verses.modern: the priest shall examine him the seventh day. If it has spread in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean; it is a leprous disease.

verses.kjv: And if the bright spot stay in his place, and spread not in the skin, but it be somewhat dark; it is a rising of the burning, and the priest shall pronounce him clean: for it is an inflammation of the burning.
verses.modern: But if the spot remains in one place and has not spread in the skin, but has faded, it is a swelling from the burn, and the priest shall pronounce him clean, for it is the scar of the burn.

verses.kjv: If a man or woman have a plague upon the head or the beard;
verses.modern: When a man or woman has a disease on the head or the beard,

verses.kjv: Then the priest shall see the plague: and, behold, if it be in sight deeper than the skin; and there be in it a yellow thin hair; then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a dry scall, even a leprosy upon the head or beard.
verses.modern: the priest shall examine the disease. And if it appears deeper than the skin, and the hair in it is yellow and thin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is an itch, a leprous disease of the head or the beard.

verses.kjv: And if the priest look on the plague of the scall, and, behold, it be not in sight deeper than the skin, and that there is no black hair in it; then the priest shall shut up him that hath the plague of the scall seven days:
verses.modern: if the priest examines the itching disease and it appears no deeper than the skin and there is no black hair in it, then the priest shall shut up the person with the itching disease for seven days.

verses.kjv: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the plague: and, behold, if the scall spread not, and there be in it no yellow hair, and the scall be not in sight deeper than the skin;
verses.modern: on the seventh day the priest shall examine the itch, and if the itch has not spread, and there is no yellow hair in it, and the itch appears to be no deeper than the skin,

verses.kjv: He shall be shaven, but the scall shall he not shave; and the priest shall shut up him that hath the scall seven days more:
verses.modern: then he shall shave himself, but the itching area he shall not shave. And the priest shall shut up the person with the itch for another seven days.

verses.kjv: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the scall: and, behold, if the scall be not spread in the skin, nor be in sight deeper than the skin; then the priest shall pronounce him clean: and he shall wash his clothes, and be clean.
verses.modern: on the seventh day the priest shall examine the itch, and if the itch has not spread in the skin and appears to be no deeper than the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him clean. And he shall wash his clothes and be clean.

verses.kjv: But if the scall spread much in the skin after his cleansing;
verses.modern: But if the itch spreads in the skin after his cleansing,

verses.kjv: Then the priest shall look on him: and, behold, if the scall be spread in the skin, the priest shall not seek for yellow hair; he is unclean.
verses.modern: the priest shall examine him, and if the itch has spread in the skin, the priest need not seek for the yellow hair; he is unclean.

verses.kjv: But if the scall be in his sight at a stay, and that there is black hair grown up therein; the scall is healed, he is clean: and the priest shall pronounce him clean.
verses.modern: But if in his eyes the itch is unchanged and black hair has grown in it, the itch is healed. He is clean, and the priest shall pronounce him clean.

verses.kjv: If a man also or a woman have in the skin of their flesh bright spots, even white bright spots;
verses.modern: When a man or a woman has spots on the skin of the body, white spots,

verses.kjv: Then the priest shall look: and, behold, if the bright spots in the skin of their flesh be darkish white; it is a freckled spot that groweth in the skin; he is clean.
verses.modern: the priest shall look, and if the spots on the skin of the body are of a dull white, it is leukoderma that has broken out in the skin; he is clean.

verses.kjv: And the man whose hair is fallen off his head, he is bald; yet is he clean.
verses.modern: If a man's hair falls out from his head, he is bald; he is clean.

verses.kjv: And he that hath his hair fallen off from the part of his head toward his face, he is forehead bald: yet is he clean.
verses.modern: if a man's hair falls out from his forehead, he has baldness of the forehead; he is clean.

verses.kjv: And if there be in the bald head, or bald forehead, a white reddish sore; it is a leprosy sprung up in his bald head or his bald forehead.
verses.modern: But if there is on the bald head or the bald forehead a reddish-white diseased area, it is a leprous disease breaking out on his bald head or his bald forehead.

verses.kjv: Then the priest shall look upon it: and, behold, if the rising of the sore be white reddish in his bald head, or in his bald forehead, as the leprosy appeareth in the skin of the flesh;
verses.modern: Then the priest shall examine him, and if the diseased swelling is reddish-white on his bald head or his bald forehead, like the appearance of leprous disease in the skin of the body,

verses.kjv: He is a leprous man, he is unclean: the priest shall pronounce him utterly unclean; his plague is in his head.
verses.modern: he is a leprous man, he is unclean. The priest must pronounce him unclean; his disease is on his head.

verses.kjv: And the leper in whom the plague is, his clothes shall be rent, and his head bare, and he shall put a covering upon his upper lip, and shall cry, Unclean, unclean.
verses.modern: The leprous person who has the disease shall wear torn clothes and let the hair of his head hang loose. He shall cover his upper lip and cry out, Unclean, unclean.

verses.kjv: All the days wherein the plague shall be in him he shall be defiled; he is unclean: he shall dwell alone; without the camp shall his habitation be.
verses.modern: He shall remain unclean as long as he has the disease. He is unclean. He shall live alone. His dwelling shall be outside the camp.

verses.kjv: The garment also that the plague of leprosy is in, whether it be a woollen garment, or a linen garment;
verses.modern: When there is a case of leprous disease in a garment, whether a woolen or a linen garment,

verses.kjv: Whether it be in the warp, or woof; of linen, or of woollen; whether in a skin, or in any thing made of skin;
verses.modern: in warp or woof of linen or wool, or in a skin or in anything made of skin,

verses.kjv: And if the plague be greenish or reddish in the garment, or in the skin, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin; it is a plague of leprosy, and shall be shewed unto the priest:
verses.modern: if the disease is greenish or reddish in the garment, or in the skin or in the warp or the woof or in any article made of skin, it is a case of leprous disease. It shall be shown to the priest.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall look upon the plague, and shut up it that hath the plague seven days:
verses.modern: the priest shall examine the disease and shut up the diseased thing for seven days.

verses.kjv: And he shall look on the plague on the seventh day: if the plague be spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in a skin, or in any work that is made of skin; the plague is a fretting leprosy; it is unclean.
verses.modern: Then he shall examine the disease on the seventh day. If the disease has spread in the garment, in the warp or the woof, or in the skin, whatever be the use of the skin, the disease is a persistent leprous disease; it is unclean.

verses.kjv: He shall therefore burn that garment, whether warp or woof, in woollen or in linen, or any thing of skin, wherein the plague is: for it is a fretting leprosy; it shall be burnt in the fire.
verses.modern: he shall burn the garment, or the warp or the woof, the wool or the linen, or any article made of skin that is diseased, for it is a persistent leprous disease. It shall be burned in fire.

verses.kjv: And if the priest shall look, and, behold, the plague be not spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin;
verses.modern: if the priest examines, and if the disease has not spread in the garment, in warp or woof or in any article made of skin,

verses.kjv: Then the priest shall command that they wash the thing wherein the plague is, and he shall shut it up seven days more:
verses.modern: then the priest shall command that they wash the thing in which is the disease. He shall shut it up for another seven days.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall look on the plague, after that it is washed: and, behold, if the plague have not changed his colour, and the plague be not spread; it is unclean; thou shalt burn it in the fire; it is fret inward, whether it be bare within or without.
verses.modern: Then the priest shall examine the diseased thing after it has been washed. And if the diseased area has not changed color, though the disease has not spread, it is unclean. You shall burn it in fire, whether the rot is on the back or on the front.

verses.kjv: And if the priest look, and, behold, the plague be somewhat dark after the washing of it; then he shall rend it out of the garment, or out of the skin, or out of the warp, or out of the woof:
verses.modern: But if the priest examines, and if the diseased area has faded after it is washed, then he shall tear it out of the garment or the skin or the warp or the woof.

verses.kjv: And if it appear still in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin; it is a spreading plague: thou shalt burn that wherein the plague is with fire.
verses.modern: if it appears again in the garment, in warp or woof, or in any article made of skin, it is spreading. You shall burn with fire whatever has the disease.

verses.kjv: And the garment, either warp, or woof, or whatsoever thing of skin it be, which thou shalt wash, if the plague be departed from them, then it shall be washed the second time, and shall be clean.
verses.modern: But the garment, or warp or woof, or any article made of skin from which the disease departs when you have washed it, shall then be washed a second time, and be clean.

verses.kjv: This is the law of the plague of leprosy in a garment of woollen or linen, either in the warp, or woof, or any thing of skins, to pronounce it clean, or to pronounce it unclean.
verses.modern: This is the law for a case of leprous disease in a garment of wool or linen, either in warp or woof, or in any article made of skin, for pronouncing it clean or unclean.'

chapters.summary: The LORD gives the priests detailed instructions for diagnosing leprous disease in human skin. The priest examines swellings, eruptions, and spots, quarantining the person for observation; leprous disease is also to be identified in garments of wool, linen, or leather.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: This shall be the law of the leper in the day of his cleansing: He shall be brought unto the priest:
verses.modern: 'This shall be the law of the leprous person for the day of his cleansing. He shall be brought to the priest,

verses.kjv: And the priest shall go forth out of the camp; and the priest shall look, and, behold, if the plague of leprosy be healed in the leper;
verses.modern: the priest shall go out of the camp, and the priest shall look. Then, if the case of leprous disease is healed in the leprous person,

verses.kjv: Then shall the priest command to take for him that is to be cleansed two birds alive and clean, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop:
verses.modern: the priest shall command them to take for him who is to be cleansed two live clean birds and cedarwood and scarlet yarn and hyssop.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall command that one of the birds be killed in an earthen vessel over running water:
verses.modern: the priest shall command them to kill one of the birds in an earthenware vessel over fresh water.

verses.modern: He shall take the live bird with the cedarwood and the scarlet yarn and the hyssop, and dip them and the live bird in the blood of the bird that was killed over the fresh water.

verses.kjv: And he that is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes, and shave off all his hair, and wash himself in water, that he may be clean: and after that he shall come into the camp, and shall tarry abroad out of his tent seven days.
verses.modern: he who is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes and shave off all his hair and bathe himself in water. He shall be clean. And after that he may come into the camp, but shall live outside his tent seven days.

verses.kjv: But it shall be on the seventh day, that he shall shave all his hair off his head and his beard and his eyebrows, even all his hair he shall shave off: and he shall wash his clothes, also he shall wash his flesh in water, and he shall be clean.
verses.modern: on the seventh day he shall shave off all his hair from his head, his beard, and his eyebrows. He shall shave off all his hair, and then he shall wash his clothes and bathe his body in water. He shall be clean.

verses.kjv: And on the eighth day he shall take two he lambs without blemish, and one ewe lamb of the first year without blemish, and three tenth deals of fine flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, and one log of oil.
verses.modern: on the eighth day he shall take two male lambs without blemish, and one ewe lamb a year old without blemish, and a grain offering of three tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil, and one log of oil.

verses.kjv: And the priest that maketh him clean shall present the man that is to be made clean, and those things, before the LORD, at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:
verses.modern: the priest who cleanses him shall set the man who is to be cleansed and these things before the LORD, at the entrance of the tent of meeting.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall take one he lamb, and offer him for a trespass offering, and the log of oil, and wave them for a wave offering before the LORD:
verses.modern: the priest shall take one of the male lambs and offer it for a guilt offering, along with the log of oil, and wave them for a wave offering before the LORD.

verses.kjv: And he shall slay the lamb in the place where he shall kill the sin offering and the burnt offering, in the holy place: for as the sin offering is the priest's, so is the trespass offering: it is most holy:

verses.modern: Then the priest shall take some of the log of oil and pour it into the palm of his own left hand

verses.kjv: And the priest shall dip his right finger in the oil that is in his left hand, and shall sprinkle of the oil with his finger seven times before the LORD:
verses.modern: dip His right finger in the oil that is in His left hand and sprinkle some oil with His finger seven times before the LORD.

verses.kjv: And of the rest of the oil that is in his hand shall the priest put upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot, upon the blood of the trespass offering:
verses.modern: some of the oil that remains in his hand the priest shall put on the lobe of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed and on the thumb of his right hand and on the big toe of his right foot, on top of the blood of the guilt offering.

verses.kjv: And the remnant of the oil that is in the priest's hand he shall pour upon the head of him that is to be cleansed: and the priest shall make an atonement for him before the LORD.
verses.modern: the rest of the oil that is in the priest's hand he shall put on the head of him who is to be cleansed. Then the priest shall make atonement for him before the LORD.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall offer the sin offering, and make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed from his uncleanness; and afterward he shall kill the burnt offering:

verses.kjv: And the priest shall offer the burnt offering and the meat offering upon the altar: and the priest shall make an atonement for him, and he shall be clean.
verses.modern: the priest shall offer the burnt offering and the grain offering on the altar. Thus the priest shall make atonement for him. He shall be clean.

verses.kjv: And if he be poor, and cannot get so much; then he shall take one lamb for a trespass offering to be waved, to make an atonement for him, and one tenth deal of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering, and a log of oil;
verses.modern: But if he is poor and cannot afford so much, then he shall take one male lamb for a guilt offering to be waved, to make atonement for him, and a tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering, and a log of oil;

verses.kjv: And two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, such as he is able to get; and the one shall be a sin offering, and the other a burnt offering.
verses.modern: two turtledoves or two pigeons, whichever he can afford. The one shall be a sin offering and the other a burnt offering.

verses.kjv: And he shall bring them on the eighth day for his cleansing unto the priest, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, before the LORD.
verses.modern: on the eighth day He shall bring them for His cleansing to the priest, to the entrance of the tent of meeting, before the LORD.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall take the lamb of the trespass offering, and the log of oil, and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the LORD:
verses.modern: the priest shall take the lamb of the guilt offering and the log of oil, and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the LORD.

verses.kjv: And he shall kill the lamb of the trespass offering, and the priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering, and put it upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot:
verses.modern: he shall kill the lamb of the guilt offering. And the priest shall take some of the blood of the guilt offering and put it on the lobe of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed and on the thumb of his right hand and on the big toe of his right foot.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall pour of the oil into the palm of his own left hand:
verses.modern: the priest shall pour some of the oil into the palm of his own left hand,

verses.kjv: And the priest shall sprinkle with his right finger some of the oil that is in his left hand seven times before the LORD:
verses.modern: the priest shall sprinkle with his right finger some of the oil that is in His left hand seven times before the LORD.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall put of the oil that is in his hand upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot, upon the place of the blood of the trespass offering:
verses.modern: the priest shall put some of the oil that is in his hand on the lobe of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed and on the thumb of his right hand and on the big toe of his right foot, in the place where the blood of the guilt offering was put.

verses.kjv: And the rest of the oil that is in the priest's hand he shall put upon the head of him that is to be cleansed, to make an atonement for him before the LORD.
verses.modern: the rest of the oil that is in the priest's hand he shall put on the head of him who is to be cleansed, to make atonement for Him before the LORD.

verses.kjv: And he shall offer the one of the turtledoves, or of the young pigeons, such as he can get;
verses.modern: he shall offer, of the turtledoves or pigeons, whichever He can afford,

verses.kjv: Even such as he is able to get, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, with the meat offering: and the priest shall make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed before the LORD.
verses.modern: one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering, along with a grain offering. And the priest shall make atonement before the LORD for Him who is being cleansed.

verses.kjv: This is the law of him in whom is the plague of leprosy, whose hand is not able to get that which pertaineth to his cleansing.
verses.modern: This is the law for Him in whom is a case of leprous disease, who cannot afford the offerings for His cleansing.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.modern: The LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,

verses.kjv: When ye be come into the land of Canaan, which I give to you for a possession, and I put the plague of leprosy in a house of the land of your possession;
verses.modern: 'When You come into the land of Canaan, which I give You for a possession, and I put a case of leprous disease in a house in the land of Your possession,

verses.kjv: And he that owneth the house shall come and tell the priest, saying, It seemeth to me there is as it were a plague in the house:
verses.modern: then he who owns the house shall come and tell the priest, It seems to me there is some kind of disease in my house.

verses.kjv: Then the priest shall command that they empty the house, before the priest go into it to see the plague, that all that is in the house be not made unclean: and afterward the priest shall go in to see the house:
verses.modern: Then the priest shall command that they empty the house before the priest goes in to examine the disease, lest all that is in the house be declared unclean. And afterward the priest shall go in to examine the house.

verses.kjv: And he shall look on the plague, and, behold, if the plague be in the walls of the house with hollow strakes, greenish or reddish, which in sight are lower than the wall;
verses.modern: he shall examine the disease. And if the disease is in the walls of the house with greenish or reddish spots, and if it appears to be deeper than the surface,

verses.kjv: Then the priest shall go out of the house to the door of the house, and shut up the house seven days:
verses.modern: then the priest shall go out of the house to the door of the house and shut up the house for seven days.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall come again the seventh day, and shall look: and, behold, if the plague be spread in the walls of the house;
verses.modern: the priest shall come again on the seventh day, and look. If the disease has spread in the walls of the house,

verses.kjv: Then the priest shall command that they take away the stones in which the plague is, and they shall cast them into an unclean place without the city:
verses.modern: then the priest shall command that they take out the stones in which is the disease and throw them into an unclean place outside the city.

verses.kjv: And he shall cause the house to be scraped within round about, and they shall pour out the dust that they scrape off without the city into an unclean place:
verses.modern: he shall have the inside of the house scraped all around, and the plaster that they scrape off they shall pour into an unclean place outside the city.

verses.kjv: And they shall take other stones, and put them in the place of those stones; and he shall take other morter, and shall plaister the house.
verses.modern: Then they shall take other stones and put them in the place of those stones. He shall take other plaster and plaster the house.

verses.kjv: And if the plague come again, and break out in the house, after that he hath taken away the stones, and after he hath scraped the house, and after it is plaistered;
verses.modern: If the disease breaks out again in the house, after he has taken out the stones and scraped the house and plastered it,

verses.kjv: Then the priest shall come and look, and, behold, if the plague be spread in the house, it is a fretting leprosy in the house: it is unclean.
verses.modern: then the priest shall go and look. And if the disease has spread in the house, it is a persistent leprous disease in the house; it is unclean.

verses.kjv: And he shall break down the house, the stones of it, and the timber thereof, and all the morter of the house; and he shall carry them forth out of the city into an unclean place.
verses.modern: he shall break down the house, its stones and timber and all the plaster of the house. He shall carry them out of the city to an unclean place.

verses.kjv: Moreover he that goeth into the house all the while that it is shut up shall be unclean until the even.
verses.modern: Moreover, whoever enters the house while it is shut up shall be unclean until the evening.

verses.kjv: And he that lieth in the house shall wash his clothes; and he that eateth in the house shall wash his clothes.
verses.modern: whoever sleeps in the house shall wash his clothes, and whoever eats in the house shall wash his clothes.

verses.kjv: And if the priest shall come in, and look upon it, and, behold, the plague hath not spread in the house, after the house was plaistered: then the priest shall pronounce the house clean, because the plague is healed.
verses.modern: But if the priest comes and looks, and if the disease has not spread in the house after the house was plastered, then the priest shall pronounce the house clean, for the disease is healed.

verses.kjv: And he shall take to cleanse the house two birds, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop:
verses.modern: for the cleansing of the house he shall take two small birds, with cedarwood and scarlet yarn and hyssop,

verses.kjv: And he shall kill the one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water:
verses.modern: he shall kill one of the birds in an earthenware vessel over fresh water

verses.kjv: And he shall take the cedar wood, and the hyssop, and the scarlet, and the living bird, and dip them in the blood of the slain bird, and in the running water, and sprinkle the house seven times:
verses.modern: shall take the cedarwood and the hyssop and the scarlet yarn and the live bird, and dip them in the blood of the slain bird and in the fresh water, and sprinkle the house seven times.

verses.kjv: And he shall cleanse the house with the blood of the bird, and with the running water, and with the living bird, and with the cedar wood, and with the hyssop, and with the scarlet:
verses.modern: Thus he shall cleanse the house with the blood of the bird and with the fresh water and with the live bird and with the cedarwood and hyssop and scarlet yarn.

verses.kjv: But he shall let go the living bird out of the city into the open fields, and make an atonement for the house: and it shall be clean.
verses.modern: he shall let the live bird go out of the city into the open country. So he shall make atonement for the house. It shall be clean.

verses.kjv: This is the law for all manner of plague of leprosy, and scall,
verses.modern: This is the law for any case of leprous disease: for an itch,

verses.kjv: And for the leprosy of a garment, and of a house,
verses.modern: for leprous disease in a garment or in a house,

verses.kjv: And for a rising, and for a scab, and for a bright spot:
verses.modern: for a swelling or an eruption or a spot,

verses.kjv: To teach when it is unclean, and when it is clean: this is the law of leprosy.
verses.modern: to show when it is unclean and when it is clean. This is the law for leprous disease.'

chapters.summary: The LORD gives laws for the cleansing ritual of a healed leper, involving two birds, cedarwood, scarlet yarn, and hyssop. He also gives instructions for diagnosing and cleansing leprous disease in houses, including scraping, replastering, or demolishing the affected structure.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.modern: The LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When any man hath a running issue out of his flesh, because of his issue he is unclean.
verses.modern: 'Speak to the children of Israel and say to them, When any man has a discharge from His body, His discharge is unclean.

verses.kjv: And this shall be his uncleanness in his issue: whether his flesh run with his issue, or his flesh be stopped from his issue, it is his uncleanness.
verses.modern: this is the law of His uncleanness for a discharge: whether His body runs with His discharge, or His body is blocked up by His discharge, it is His uncleanness.

verses.kjv: Every bed, whereon he lieth that hath the issue, is unclean: and every thing, whereon he sitteth, shall be unclean.
verses.modern: Every bed on which the one with the discharge lies shall be unclean, and everything on which He sits shall be unclean.

verses.kjv: And whosoever toucheth his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.modern: anyone who touches his bed shall wash his clothes and bathe Himself in water and be unclean until the evening.

verses.kjv: And he that sitteth on any thing whereon he sat that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.modern: whoever sits on anything on which the one with the discharge has sat shall wash His clothes and bathe Himself in water and be unclean until the evening.

verses.kjv: And he that toucheth the flesh of him that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.modern: whoever touches the body of the one with the discharge shall wash His clothes and bathe Himself in water and be unclean until the evening.

verses.kjv: And if he that hath the issue spit upon him that is clean; then he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.modern: if the one with the discharge spits on someone who is clean, then he shall wash his clothes and bathe Himself in water and be unclean until the evening.

verses.kjv: And what saddle soever he rideth upon that hath the issue shall be unclean.
verses.modern: any saddle on which the one with the discharge rides shall be unclean.

verses.kjv: And whosoever toucheth any thing that was under him shall be unclean until the even: and he that beareth any of those things shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.modern: whoever touches anything that was under him shall be unclean until the evening. And whoever carries such things shall wash his clothes and bathe Himself in water and be unclean until the evening.

verses.kjv: And whomsoever he toucheth that hath the issue, and hath not rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.modern: Anyone whom the one with the discharge touches without having rinsed His hands in water shall wash His clothes and bathe Himself in water and be unclean until the evening.

verses.kjv: And the vessel of earth, that he toucheth which hath the issue, shall be broken: and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.
verses.modern: an earthenware vessel that the one with the discharge touches shall be broken, and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.

verses.kjv: And when he that hath an issue is cleansed of his issue; then he shall number to himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in running water, and shall be clean.
verses.modern: when the one with a discharge is cleansed of His discharge, then He shall count for Himself seven days for His cleansing, and wash His clothes. And He shall bathe His body in fresh water and shall be clean.

verses.kjv: And on the eighth day he shall take to him two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and come before the LORD unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and give them unto the priest:
verses.modern: on the eighth day He shall take to Himself two turtledoves or two pigeons and come before the LORD to the entrance of the tent of meeting and give them to the priest.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall offer them, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for him before the LORD for his issue.
verses.modern: the priest shall use them, one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering. And the priest shall make atonement for him before the LORD for His discharge.

verses.kjv: And if any man's seed of copulation go out from him, then he shall wash all his flesh in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.modern: If a man has an emission of semen, he shall bathe his whole body in water and be unclean until the evening.

verses.kjv: And every garment, and every skin, whereon is the seed of copulation, shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.modern: every garment and every skin on which the semen comes shall be washed with water and be unclean until the evening.

verses.kjv: The woman also with whom man shall lie with seed of copulation, they shall both bathe themselves in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.modern: If a man lies with a woman and has an emission of semen, both of them shall bathe themselves in water and be unclean until the evening.

verses.kjv: And if a woman have an issue, and her issue in her flesh be blood, she shall be put apart seven days: and whosoever toucheth her shall be unclean until the even.
verses.modern: When a woman has a discharge, and the discharge in her body is blood, she shall be in her menstrual impurity for seven days, and whoever touches her shall be unclean until the evening.

verses.kjv: And every thing that she lieth upon in her separation shall be unclean: every thing also that she sitteth upon shall be unclean.
verses.modern: everything on which she lies during her menstrual impurity shall be unclean. Everything also on which she sits shall be unclean.

verses.kjv: And whosoever toucheth her bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.modern: whoever touches her bed shall wash his clothes and bathe Himself in water and be unclean until the evening.

verses.kjv: And whosoever toucheth any thing that she sat upon shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.modern: whoever touches anything on which she sits shall wash His clothes and bathe Himself in water and be unclean until the evening.

verses.kjv: And if it be on her bed, or on any thing whereon she sitteth, when he toucheth it, he shall be unclean until the even.
verses.modern: Whether it is the bed or anything on which she sits, when He touches it He shall be unclean until the evening.

verses.kjv: And if any man lie with her at all, and her flowers be upon him, he shall be unclean seven days; and all the bed whereon he lieth shall be unclean.
verses.modern: if any man lies with her and her menstrual impurity comes upon Him, He shall be unclean seven days, and every bed on which He lies shall be unclean.

verses.kjv: And if a woman have an issue of her blood many days out of the time of her separation, or if it run beyond the time of her separation; all the days of the issue of her uncleanness shall be as the days of her separation: she shall be unclean.
verses.modern: If a woman has a discharge of blood for many days, not at the time of her menstrual impurity, or if she has a discharge beyond the time of her impurity, all the days of the discharge she shall continue in uncleanness. As in the days of her menstrual impurity, she shall be unclean.

verses.kjv: Every bed whereon she lieth all the days of her issue shall be unto her as the bed of her separation: and whatsoever she sitteth upon shall be unclean, as the uncleanness of her separation.
verses.modern: Every bed on which she lies during all the days of her discharge shall be treated as the bed of her menstrual impurity. And everything on which she sits shall be unclean, as in the uncleanness of her menstrual impurity.

verses.kjv: And whosoever toucheth those things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.modern: whoever touches these things shall be unclean, and shall wash His clothes and bathe Himself in water and be unclean until the evening.

verses.kjv: But if she be cleansed of her issue, then she shall number to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.
verses.modern: But if she is cleansed of her discharge, she shall count for herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.

verses.kjv: And on the eighth day she shall take unto her two turtles, or two young pigeons, and bring them unto the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.modern: on the eighth day she shall take to herself two turtledoves or two pigeons and bring them to the priest, to the entrance of the tent of meeting.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for her before the LORD for the issue of her uncleanness.
verses.modern: the priest shall offer one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering. And the priest shall make atonement for her before the LORD for her unclean discharge.

verses.kjv: Thus shall ye separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness; that they die not in their uncleanness, when they defile my tabernacle that is among them.
verses.modern: Thus You shall keep the children of Israel separate from their uncleanness, lest they die in their uncleanness by defiling my tabernacle that is in their midst.'

verses.kjv: This is the law of him that hath an issue, and of him whose seed goeth from him, and is defiled therewith;
verses.modern: This is the law for Him who has a discharge and for Him who has an emission of semen, becoming unclean thereby;

verses.kjv: And of her that is sick of her flowers, and of him that hath an issue, of the man, and of the woman, and of him that lieth with her that is unclean.
verses.modern: also for her who is unwell with her menstrual impurity, that is, for anyone, male or female, who has a discharge, and for the man who lies with a woman who is unclean.

chapters.summary: The LORD gives laws concerning bodily discharges that cause ceremonial uncleanness. Men with abnormal discharges and women during menstruation or with prolonged bleeding are unclean, and after their discharge ends they must wait seven days and bring offerings to the priest for atonement.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they offered before the LORD, and died;
verses.modern: The LORD spoke to Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they drew near before the LORD and died,

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Speak unto Aaron thy brother, that he come not at all times into the holy place within the vail before the mercy seat, which is upon the ark; that he die not: for I will appear in the cloud upon the mercy seat.
verses.modern: the LORD said to Moses, 'Tell Aaron your brother not to come at any time into the Holy Place inside the veil, before the mercy seat that is on the ark, so that He may not die. For I will appear in the cloud over the mercy seat.

verses.kjv: Thus shall Aaron come into the holy place: with a young bullock for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering.
verses.modern: But in this way Aaron shall come into the Holy Place: with a bull from the herd for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering.

verses.kjv: He shall put on the holy linen coat, and he shall have the linen breeches upon his flesh, and shall be girded with a linen girdle, and with the linen mitre shall he be attired: these are holy garments; therefore shall he wash his flesh in water, and so put them on.
verses.modern: He shall put on the holy linen coat and shall have the linen undergarment on his body, fasten the linen sash around his waist, and wear the linen turban; these are the holy garments. He shall bathe his body in water and then put them on.

verses.kjv: And he shall take of the congregation of the children of Israel two kids of the goats for a sin offering, and one ram for a burnt offering.
verses.modern: he shall take from the congregation of the children of Israel two male goats for a sin offering, and one ram for a burnt offering.

verses.kjv: And Aaron shall offer his bullock of the sin offering, which is for himself, and make an atonement for himself, and for his house.
verses.modern: Aaron shall offer the bull as a sin offering for himself and shall make atonement for himself and for his house.

verses.kjv: And he shall take the two goats, and present them before the LORD at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.modern: Then He shall take the two goats and set them before the LORD at the entrance of the tent of meeting.

verses.kjv: And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats; one lot for the LORD, and the other lot for the scapegoat.
verses.modern: Aaron shall cast lots over the two goats, one lot for the LORD and the other lot for the scapegoat.

verses.kjv: And Aaron shall bring the goat upon which the LORD's lot fell, and offer him for a sin offering.
verses.modern: Aaron shall present the goat on which the lot fell for the LORD and use it as a sin offering,

verses.kjv: But the goat, on which the lot fell to be the scapegoat, shall be presented alive before the LORD, to make an atonement with him, and to let him go for a scapegoat into the wilderness.
verses.modern: but the goat on which the lot fell for the scapegoat shall be presented alive before the LORD to make atonement over it, that it may be sent as the scapegoat into the wilderness.

verses.kjv: And Aaron shall bring the bullock of the sin offering, which is for himself, and shall make an atonement for himself, and for his house, and shall kill the bullock of the sin offering which is for himself:
verses.modern: Aaron shall present the bull as a sin offering for himself, and shall make atonement for himself and for his house. He shall kill the bull as a sin offering for himself.

verses.kjv: And he shall take a censer full of burning coals of fire from off the altar before the LORD, and his hands full of sweet incense beaten small, and bring it within the vail:
verses.modern: he shall take a censer full of coals of fire from the altar before the LORD, and two handfuls of sweet incense beaten fine. He shall bring it inside the veil

verses.kjv: And he shall put the incense upon the fire before the LORD, that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat that is upon the testimony, that he die not:
verses.modern: put the incense on the fire before the LORD, that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat that is over the testimony, so that He does not die.

verses.kjv: And he shall take of the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it with his finger upon the mercy seat eastward; and before the mercy seat shall he sprinkle of the blood with his finger seven times.
verses.modern: he shall take some of the blood of the bull and sprinkle it with His finger on the front of the mercy seat on the east side, and in front of the mercy seat He shall sprinkle some of the blood with His finger seven times.

verses.kjv: Then shall he kill the goat of the sin offering, that is for the people, and bring his blood within the vail, and do with that blood as he did with the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it upon the mercy seat, and before the mercy seat:
verses.modern: Then He shall kill the goat of the sin offering that is for the people and bring its blood inside the veil and do with its blood as He did with the blood of the bull, sprinkling it over the mercy seat and in front of the mercy seat.

verses.kjv: And he shall make an atonement for the holy place, because of the uncleanness of the children of Israel, and because of their transgressions in all their sins: and so shall he do for the tabernacle of the congregation, that remaineth among them in the midst of their uncleanness.
verses.modern: Thus He shall make atonement for the Holy Place, because of the uncleannesses of the children of Israel and because of their transgressions, all their sins. And so He shall do for the tent of meeting, which dwells with them in the midst of their uncleannesses.

verses.kjv: And there shall be no man in the tabernacle of the congregation when he goeth in to make an atonement in the holy place, until he come out, and have made an atonement for himself, and for his household, and for all the congregation of Israel.
verses.modern: No one may be in the tent of meeting from the time He enters to make atonement in the Holy Place until He comes out and has made atonement for Himself and for His house and for all the assembly of Israel.

verses.kjv: And he shall go out unto the altar that is before the LORD, and make an atonement for it; and shall take of the blood of the bullock, and of the blood of the goat, and put it upon the horns of the altar round about.
verses.modern: Then He shall go out to the altar that is before the LORD and make atonement for it, and shall take some of the blood of the bull and some of the blood of the goat, and put it on the horns of the altar all around.

verses.kjv: And he shall sprinkle of the blood upon it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and hallow it from the uncleanness of the children of Israel.
verses.modern: he shall sprinkle some of the blood on it with His finger seven times, and cleanse it and consecrate it from the uncleannesses of the children of Israel.

verses.kjv: And when he hath made an end of reconciling the holy place, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and the altar, he shall bring the live goat:
verses.modern: when He has made an end of atoning for the Holy Place and the tent of meeting and the altar, He shall present the live goat.

verses.kjv: And Aaron shall lay both his hands upon the head of the live goat, and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel, and all their transgressions in all their sins, putting them upon the head of the goat, and shall send him away by the hand of a fit man into the wilderness:
verses.modern: Aaron shall lay both his hands on the head of the live goat, and confess over it all the iniquities of the children of Israel. All their transgressions, all their sins. And he shall put them on the head of the goat and send it away into the wilderness by the hand of a man who is in readiness.

verses.kjv: And the goat shall bear upon him all their iniquities unto a land not inhabited: and he shall let go the goat in the wilderness.
verses.modern: The goat shall bear all their iniquities on itself to a remote area. He shall let the goat go free in the wilderness.

verses.kjv: And Aaron shall come into the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall put off the linen garments, which he put on when he went into the holy place, and shall leave them there:
verses.modern: Then Aaron shall come into the tent of meeting and shall take off the linen garments that he put on when he went into the Holy Place and shall leave them there.

verses.kjv: And he shall wash his flesh with water in the holy place, and put on his garments, and come forth, and offer his burnt offering, and the burnt offering of the people, and make an atonement for himself, and for the people.
verses.modern: he shall bathe his body in water in a holy place and put on his garments and come out and offer his burnt offering and the burnt offering of the people and make atonement for himself and for the people.

verses.kjv: And the fat of the sin offering shall he burn upon the altar.
verses.modern: the fat of the sin offering he shall burn on the altar.

verses.kjv: And he that let go the goat for the scapegoat shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward come into the camp.
verses.modern: he who lets the goat go to the scapegoat shall wash his clothes and bathe his body in water, and afterward he may come into the camp.

verses.kjv: And the bullock for the sin offering, and the goat for the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the holy place, shall one carry forth without the camp; and they shall burn in the fire their skins, and their flesh, and their dung.
verses.modern: the bull for the sin offering and the goat for the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the Holy Place, shall be carried outside the camp. Their skin and their flesh and their dung shall be burned up with fire.

verses.kjv: And he that burneth them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.
verses.modern: he who burns them shall wash his clothes and bathe his body in water, and afterward he may come into the camp.
