verses.kjv: And this shall be a statute for ever unto you: that in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, ye shall afflict your souls, and do no work at all, whether it be one of your own country, or a stranger that sojourneth among you:
verses.modern: it shall be a statute to you forever that in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, you shall afflict yourselves and shall do no work, either the native or the stranger who sojourns among you.

verses.kjv: For on that day shall the priest make an atonement for you, to cleanse you, that ye may be clean from all your sins before the LORD.
verses.modern: For on this day shall atonement be made for You to cleanse You. You shall be clean before the LORD from all Your sins.

verses.kjv: It shall be a sabbath of rest unto you, and ye shall afflict your souls, by a statute for ever.
verses.modern: It is a Sabbath of solemn rest to You, and You shall afflict yourselves; it is a statute forever.

verses.kjv: And the priest, whom he shall anoint, and whom he shall consecrate to minister in the priest's office in his father's stead, shall make the atonement, and shall put on the linen clothes, even the holy garments:
verses.modern: the priest who is anointed and consecrated as priest in his father's place shall make atonement, wearing the holy linen garments.

verses.kjv: And he shall make an atonement for the holy sanctuary, and he shall make an atonement for the tabernacle of the congregation, and for the altar, and he shall make an atonement for the priests, and for all the people of the congregation.
verses.modern: He shall make atonement for the holy sanctuary. He shall make atonement for the tent of meeting and for the altar. He shall make atonement for the priests and for all the people of the assembly.

verses.kjv: And this shall be an everlasting statute unto you, to make an atonement for the children of Israel for all their sins once a year. And he did as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.modern: this shall be a statute forever for You, that atonement may be made for the children of Israel once in the year because of all their sins.' And Aaron did as the LORD commanded Moses.

chapters.summary: The LORD gives instructions for the Day of Atonement, the one day each year when the high priest enters the Most Holy Place. Aaron casts lots over two goats -- one is sacrificed as a sin offering and its blood sprinkled on the mercy seat, while the other is sent into the wilderness as the scapegoat bearing the people's sins.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto Aaron, and unto his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them; This is the thing which the LORD hath commanded, saying,
verses.modern: 'Speak to Aaron and his sons and to all the children of Israel and say to them, This is the thing that the LORD has commanded.

verses.kjv: What man soever there be of the house of Israel, that killeth an ox, or lamb, or goat, in the camp, or that killeth it out of the camp,
verses.modern: If any one of the house of Israel kills an ox or a lamb or a goat in the camp, or kills it outside the camp,

verses.kjv: And bringeth it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to offer an offering unto the LORD before the tabernacle of the LORD; blood shall be imputed unto that man; he hath shed blood; and that man shall be cut off from among his people:
verses.modern: does not bring it to the entrance of the tent of meeting to offer it as an offering to the LORD in front of the tabernacle of the LORD, bloodguilt shall be imputed to that man. He has shed blood, and that man shall be cut off from among his people.

verses.kjv: To the end that the children of Israel may bring their sacrifices, which they offer in the open field, even that they may bring them unto the LORD, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, unto the priest, and offer them for peace offerings unto the LORD.
verses.modern: This is to the end that the children of Israel may bring their sacrifices that they sacrifice in the open field, that they may bring them to the LORD, to the priest at the entrance of the tent of meeting, and sacrifice them as peace offerings to the LORD.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar of the LORD at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and burn the fat for a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.modern: the priest shall throw the blood on the altar of the LORD at the entrance of the tent of meeting and burn the fat for a sweet savour unto the LORD.

verses.kjv: And they shall no more offer their sacrifices unto devils, after whom they have gone a whoring. This shall be a statute for ever unto them throughout their generations.
verses.modern: So they shall no more sacrifice their sacrifices to goat demons, after whom they whore. This shall be a statute forever for them throughout their generations.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt say unto them, Whatsoever man there be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers which sojourn among you, that offereth a burnt offering or sacrifice,
verses.modern: you shall say to them, Any one of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who stay among them, who offers a burnt offering or sacrifice

verses.kjv: And bringeth it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to offer it unto the LORD; even that man shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.modern: does not bring it to the entrance of the tent of meeting to offer it to the LORD, that man shall be cut off from his people.

verses.kjv: And whatsoever man there be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among you, that eateth any manner of blood; I will even set my face against that soul that eateth blood, and will cut him off from among his people.
verses.modern: If any one of the house of Israel or of the strangers who stay among them eats any blood, I will set my face against that person who eats blood and will cut Him off from among His people.

verses.kjv: For the life of the flesh is in the blood: and I have given it to you upon the altar to make an atonement for your souls: for it is the blood that maketh an atonement for the soul.
verses.modern: For the life of the flesh is in the blood. I have given it for You on the altar to make atonement for Your souls, for it is the blood that makes atonement for the soul.

verses.kjv: Therefore I said unto the children of Israel, No soul of you shall eat blood, neither shall any stranger that sojourneth among you eat blood.
verses.modern: Therefore I have said to the children of Israel, No person among You shall eat blood, neither shall any stranger who sojourns among You eat blood.

verses.kjv: And whatsoever man there be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among you, which hunteth and catcheth any beast or fowl that may be eaten; he shall even pour out the blood thereof, and cover it with dust.
verses.modern: Any one also of the children of Israel, or of the strangers who stay among them, who takes in hunting any beast or bird that may be eaten shall pour out its blood and cover it with earth.

verses.kjv: For it is the life of all flesh; the blood of it is for the life thereof: therefore I said unto the children of Israel, Ye shall eat the blood of no manner of flesh: for the life of all flesh is the blood thereof: whosoever eateth it shall be cut off.
verses.modern: For the life of every creature is its blood: its blood is its life. Therefore I have said to the children of Israel, You shall not eat the blood of any creature, for the life of every creature is its blood. Whoever eats it shall be cut off.

verses.kjv: And every soul that eateth that which died of itself, or that which was torn with beasts, whether it be one of your own country, or a stranger, he shall both wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even: then shall he be clean.
verses.modern: every person who eats what dies of itself or what is torn by beasts, whether He is a native or a sojourner, shall wash His clothes and bathe Himself in water and be unclean until the evening; then He shall be clean.

verses.kjv: But if he wash them not, nor bathe his flesh; then he shall bear his iniquity.
verses.modern: But if He does not wash them or bathe His flesh, He shall bear His iniquity.'

chapters.summary: The LORD commands that all sacrifices must be brought to the entrance of the tent of meeting and not offered in the open field. He strictly forbids the eating of blood, declaring that the life of the flesh is in the blood and He has given it on the altar to make atonement.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, I am the LORD your God.
verses.modern: 'Speak to the children of Israel and say to them, I am the LORD Your God.

verses.kjv: After the doings of the land of Egypt, wherein ye dwelt, shall ye not do: and after the doings of the land of Canaan, whither I bring you, shall ye not do: neither shall ye walk in their ordinances.
verses.modern: You shall not do as they do in the land of Egypt, where You lived, and You shall not do as they do in the land of Canaan, to which I am bringing You. You shall not walk in their statutes.

verses.kjv: Ye shall do my judgments, and keep mine ordinances, to walk therein: I am the LORD your God.
verses.modern: You shall follow my rules and keep my statutes and walk in them. I am the LORD Your God.

verses.kjv: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes, and my judgments: which if a man do, he shall live in them: I am the LORD.
verses.modern: You shall therefore keep my statutes and my rules; if a person does them, He shall live by them: I am the LORD.

verses.kjv: None of you shall approach to any that is near of kin to him, to uncover their nakedness: I am the LORD.
verses.modern: None of You shall approach any one of His close relatives to uncover nakedness. I am the LORD.

verses.kjv: The nakedness of thy father, or the nakedness of thy mother, shalt thou not uncover: she is thy mother; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
verses.modern: You shall not uncover the nakedness of Your father, which is the nakedness of Your mother; she is Your mother, You shall not uncover her nakedness.

verses.kjv: The nakedness of thy father's wife shalt thou not uncover: it is thy father's nakedness.
verses.modern: You shall not uncover the nakedness of Your father's wife; it is Your father's nakedness.

verses.kjv: The nakedness of thy sister, the daughter of thy father, or daughter of thy mother, whether she be born at home, or born abroad, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover.
verses.modern: You shall not uncover the nakedness of Your sister, Your father's daughter or Your mother's daughter, whether brought up in the family or in another home.

verses.kjv: The nakedness of thy son's daughter, or of thy daughter's daughter, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover: for theirs is thine own nakedness.
verses.modern: You shall not uncover the nakedness of Your son's daughter or of Your daughter's daughter, for their nakedness is Your own nakedness.

verses.kjv: The nakedness of thy father's wife's daughter, begotten of thy father, she is thy sister, thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
verses.modern: You shall not uncover the nakedness of Your father's wife's daughter, brought up by Your father, since she is Your sister.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father's sister: she is thy father's near kinswoman.
verses.modern: You shall not uncover the nakedness of Your father's sister; she is Your father's relative.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother's sister: for she is thy mother's near kinswoman.
verses.modern: You shall not uncover the nakedness of Your mother's sister, for she is Your mother's relative.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father's brother, thou shalt not approach to his wife: she is thine aunt.
verses.modern: You shall not uncover the nakedness of Your father's brother, that is, You shall not approach his wife; she is Your aunt.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy daughter in law: she is thy son's wife; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
verses.modern: You shall not uncover the nakedness of Your daughter-in-law; she is Your son's wife, You shall not uncover her nakedness.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy brother's wife: it is thy brother's nakedness.
verses.modern: You shall not uncover the nakedness of Your brother's wife; it is Your brother's nakedness.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter, neither shalt thou take her son's daughter, or her daughter's daughter, to uncover her nakedness; for they are her near kinswomen: it is wickedness.
verses.modern: You shall not uncover the nakedness of a woman and of her daughter, and you shall not take her son's daughter or her daughter's daughter to uncover her nakedness; they are relatives; it is depravity.

verses.kjv: Neither shalt thou take a wife to her sister, to vex her, to uncover her nakedness, beside the other in her life time.
verses.modern: you shall not take a woman as a rival wife to her sister, uncovering her nakedness while her sister is still alive.

verses.kjv: Also thou shalt not approach unto a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is put apart for her uncleanness.
verses.modern: You shall not approach a woman to uncover her nakedness while she is in her menstrual uncleanness.

verses.kjv: Moreover thou shalt not lie carnally with thy neighbour's wife, to defile thyself with her.
verses.modern: you shall not lie sexually with Your neighbor's wife and so make Yourself unclean with her.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt not let any of thy seed pass through the fire to Molech, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am the LORD.
verses.modern: You shall not give any of Your children to offer them to Molech, and so profane the name of Your God: I am the LORD.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not lie with mankind, as with womankind: it is abomination.
verses.modern: You shall not lie with a male as with a woman; it is an abomination.

verses.kjv: Neither shalt thou lie with any beast to defile thyself therewith: neither shall any woman stand before a beast to lie down thereto: it is confusion.
verses.modern: you shall not lie with any animal and so make Yourself unclean with it, neither shall any woman give herself to an animal to lie with it: it is perversion.

verses.kjv: Defile not ye yourselves in any of these things: for in all these the nations are defiled which I cast out before you:
verses.modern: Do not make yourselves unclean by any of these things, for by all these the nations I am driving out before you have become unclean,

verses.kjv: And the land is defiled: therefore I do visit the iniquity thereof upon it, and the land itself vomiteth out her inhabitants.
verses.modern: the land became unclean, so that I punished its iniquity, and the land vomited out its inhabitants.

verses.kjv: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes and my judgments, and shall not commit any of these abominations; neither any of your own nation, nor any stranger that sojourneth among you:
verses.modern: But You shall keep my statutes and my rules and do none of these abominations, either the native or the stranger who sojourns among You

verses.kjv: (For all these abominations have the men of the land done, which were before you, and the land is defiled;)
verses.modern: (for the people of the land, who were before you, did all of these abominations, so that the land became unclean),

verses.kjv: That the land spue not you out also, when ye defile it, as it spued out the nations that were before you.
verses.modern: lest the land vomit You out when You make it unclean, as it vomited out the nations that were before you.

verses.kjv: For whosoever shall commit any of these abominations, even the souls that commit them shall be cut off from among their people.
verses.modern: For everyone who does any of these abominations, the persons who do them shall be cut off from among their people.

verses.kjv: Therefore shall ye keep mine ordinance, that ye commit not any one of these abominable customs, which were committed before you, and that ye defile not yourselves therein: I am the LORD your God.
verses.modern: So keep my charge never to practice any of these abominable customs that were practiced before You, and never to make yourselves unclean by them: I am the LORD Your God.'

chapters.summary: The LORD forbids Israel from following the practices of Egypt and Canaan, then lists prohibited sexual relations including incest, adultery, homosexuality, and bestiality. He warns that the land will vomit out those who commit these abominations, as it did the nations before them.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, and say unto them, Ye shall be holy: for I the LORD your God am holy.
verses.modern: 'Speak to all the congregation of the children of Israel and say to them, You shall be holy, for I the LORD Your God am holy.

verses.kjv: Ye shall fear every man his mother, and his father, and keep my sabbaths: I am the LORD your God.
verses.modern: Every one of you shall revere his mother and his father, and You shall keep my Sabbaths: I am the LORD Your God.

verses.kjv: Turn ye not unto idols, nor make to yourselves molten gods: I am the LORD your God.
verses.modern: Do not turn to idols or make for yourselves any gods of cast metal: I am the LORD Your God.

verses.kjv: And if ye offer a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the LORD, ye shall offer it at your own will.
verses.modern: When You offer a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD, You shall offer it so that You may be accepted.

verses.kjv: It shall be eaten the same day ye offer it, and on the morrow: and if ought remain until the third day, it shall be burnt in the fire.
verses.modern: It shall be eaten the same day You offer it or on the day after, and anything left over until the third day shall be burned up with fire.

verses.kjv: And if it be eaten at all on the third day, it is abominable; it shall not be accepted.
verses.modern: If it is eaten at all on the third day, it is tainted; it will not be accepted,

verses.kjv: Therefore every one that eateth it shall bear his iniquity, because he hath profaned the hallowed thing of the LORD: and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.modern: everyone who eats it shall bear His iniquity, because He has profaned what is holy to the LORD, and that person shall be cut off from His people.

verses.kjv: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field, neither shalt thou gather the gleanings of thy harvest.
verses.modern: When You reap the harvest of Your land, You shall not reap Your field right up to its edge, neither shall You gather the gleanings after Your harvest.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt not glean thy vineyard, neither shalt thou gather every grape of thy vineyard; thou shalt leave them for the poor and stranger: I am the LORD your God.
verses.modern: you shall not strip Your vineyard bare, neither shall You gather the fallen grapes of Your vineyard. You shall leave them for the poor and for the sojourner: I am the LORD Your God.

verses.kjv: Ye shall not steal, neither deal falsely, neither lie one to another.
verses.modern: You shall not steal; You shall not deal falsely; You shall not lie to one another.

verses.kjv: And ye shall not swear by my name falsely, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am the LORD.
verses.modern: You shall not swear by my name falsely, and so profane the name of Your God: I am the LORD.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not defraud thy neighbour, neither rob him: the wages of him that is hired shall not abide with thee all night until the morning.
verses.modern: You shall not oppress Your neighbor or rob Him. The wages of a hired worker shall not remain with You all night until the morning.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not curse the deaf, nor put a stumblingblock before the blind, but shalt fear thy God: I am the LORD.
verses.modern: You shall not curse the deaf or put a stumbling block before the blind, but You shall fear Your God: I am the LORD.

verses.kjv: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment: thou shalt not respect the person of the poor, nor honour the person of the mighty: but in righteousness shalt thou judge thy neighbour.
verses.modern: You shall do no injustice in court. You shall not be partial to the poor or defer to the great, but in righteousness shall You judge Your neighbor.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not go up and down as a talebearer among thy people: neither shalt thou stand against the blood of thy neighbour: I am the LORD.
verses.modern: You shall not go around as a slanderer among Your people, and You shall not stand up against the life of Your neighbor: I am the LORD.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thine heart: thou shalt in any wise rebuke thy neighbour, and not suffer sin upon him.
verses.modern: You shall not hate Your brother in Your heart, but You shall reason frankly with Your neighbor, lest You incur sin because of Him.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I am the LORD.
verses.modern: You shall not take vengeance or bear a grudge against the sons of Your own people, but You shall love Your neighbor as Yourself: I am the LORD.

verses.kjv: Ye shall keep my statutes. Thou shalt not let thy cattle gender with a diverse kind: thou shalt not sow thy field with mingled seed: neither shall a garment mingled of linen and woollen come upon thee.
verses.modern: You shall keep my statutes. You shall not let Your cattle breed with a different kind. You shall not sow Your field with two kinds of seed, nor shall You wear a garment of cloth made of two kinds of material.

verses.kjv: And whosoever lieth carnally with a woman, that is a bondmaid, betrothed to an husband, and not at all redeemed, nor freedom given her; she shall be scourged; they shall not be put to death, because she was not free.
verses.modern: If a man lies sexually with a woman who is a slave, assigned to another man and not yet ransomed or given her freedom, she shall be punished. They shall not be put to death, because she was not free.

verses.kjv: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the LORD, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, even a ram for a trespass offering.
verses.modern: But He shall bring His guilt offering to the LORD, to the entrance of the tent of meeting, a ram for a guilt offering.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering before the LORD for his sin which he hath done: and the sin which he hath done shall be forgiven him.
verses.modern: the priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the guilt offering before the LORD for His sin that He has committed. He shall be forgiven for the sin that He has committed.

verses.kjv: And when ye shall come into the land, and shall have planted all manner of trees for food, then ye shall count the fruit thereof as uncircumcised: three years shall it be as uncircumcised unto you: it shall not be eaten of.
verses.modern: When You come into the land and plant any kind of tree for food, then You shall treat its fruit as forbidden. Three years it shall be forbidden to You; it must not be eaten.

verses.kjv: But in the fourth year all the fruit thereof shall be holy to praise the LORD withal.
verses.modern: in the fourth year all its fruit shall be holy, an offering of praise to the LORD.

verses.kjv: And in the fifth year shall ye eat of the fruit thereof, that it may yield unto you the increase thereof: I am the LORD your God.
verses.modern: But in the fifth year You may eat of its fruit, to increase its yield for You: I am the LORD Your God.

verses.kjv: Ye shall not eat any thing with the blood: neither shall ye use enchantment, nor observe times.
verses.modern: You shall not eat any flesh with the blood in it. You shall not practice augury or witchcraft.

verses.kjv: Ye shall not round the corners of your heads, neither shalt thou mar the corners of thy beard.
verses.modern: You shall not round off the hair on Your temples or mar the edges of Your beard.

verses.kjv: Ye shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor print any marks upon you: I am the LORD.
verses.modern: You shall not make any cuts on Your body for the dead or tattoo yourselves: I am the LORD.

verses.kjv: Do not prostitute thy daughter, to cause her to be a whore; lest the land fall to whoredom, and the land become full of wickedness.
verses.modern: Do not profane Your daughter by making her a prostitute, lest the land fall into prostitution and the land become full of depravity.

verses.kjv: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am the LORD.
verses.modern: You shall keep my Sabbaths and reverence my sanctuary: I am the LORD.

verses.kjv: Regard not them that have familiar spirits, neither seek after wizards, to be defiled by them: I am the LORD your God.
verses.modern: Do not turn to them that have familiar spirits, or to wizards; do not seek them out, and so make yourselves unclean by them: I am the LORD Your God.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt rise up before the hoary head, and honour the face of the old man, and fear thy God: I am the LORD.
verses.modern: You shall stand up before the gray head and honor the face of an old man, and You shall fear Your God: I am the LORD.

verses.kjv: And if a stranger sojourn with thee in your land, ye shall not vex him.
verses.modern: When a stranger sojourns with You in Your land, You shall not do Him wrong.

verses.kjv: But the stranger that dwelleth with you shall be unto you as one born among you, and thou shalt love him as thyself; for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.
verses.modern: You shall treat the stranger who sojourns with You as the native among You, and You shall love Him as Yourself, for You were strangers in the land of Egypt: I am the LORD Your God.

verses.kjv: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in meteyard, in weight, or in measure.
verses.modern: You shall do no wrong in judgment, in measures of length or weight or quantity.

verses.kjv: Just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin, shall ye have: I am the LORD your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt.
verses.modern: You shall have just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin: I am the LORD Your God, Who brought You out of the land of Egypt.

verses.kjv: Therefore shall ye observe all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: I am the LORD.
verses.modern: you shall observe all my statutes and all my rules, and do them: I am the LORD.'

chapters.summary: The LORD commands Israel to be holy as He is holy, giving a wide range of laws covering reverence for parents, Sabbath-keeping, honest dealings, care for the poor and the stranger, just weights, and the command to love your neighbor as yourself.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Again, thou shalt say to the children of Israel, Whosoever he be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn in Israel, that giveth any of his seed to Molech; he shall surely be put to death: the people of the land shall stone him with stones.
verses.modern: 'Say to the children of Israel, Any one of the children of Israel or of the strangers who stay in Israel who gives any of His children to Molech shall surely be put to death. The people of the land shall stone him with stones.

verses.kjv: And I will set my face against that man, and will cut him off from among his people; because he hath given of his seed to Molech, to defile my sanctuary, and to profane my holy name.
verses.modern: I myself will set my face against that man and will cut him off from among his people, because He has given one of His children to Molech, to make my sanctuary unclean and to profane my holy name.

verses.kjv: And if the people of the land do any ways hide their eyes from the man, when he giveth of his seed to Molech, and kill him not:
verses.modern: if the people of the land do at all close their eyes to that man when he gives one of his children to Molech, and do not put Him to death,

verses.kjv: Then I will set my face against that man, and against his family, and will cut him off, and all that go a whoring after him, to commit whoredom with Molech, from among their people.
verses.modern: then I will set my face against that man and against his clan and will cut them off from among their people, Him and all who follow Him in whoring after Molech.

verses.kjv: And the soul that turneth after such as have familiar spirits, and after wizards, to go a whoring after them, I will even set my face against that soul, and will cut him off from among his people.
verses.modern: If a person turns to such as have familiar spirits, and after wizards, to go whoring after them, I will set my face against that person and will cut Him off from among His people.

verses.kjv: Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be ye holy: for I am the LORD your God.
verses.modern: Consecrate yourselves, therefore, and be holy, for I am the LORD Your God.

verses.kjv: And ye shall keep my statutes, and do them: I am the LORD which sanctify you.
verses.modern: Keep my statutes and do them; I am the LORD Who sanctifies You.

verses.kjv: For every one that curseth his father or his mother shall be surely put to death: he hath cursed his father or his mother; his blood shall be upon him.
verses.modern: For anyone who curses his father or his mother shall surely be put to death; He has cursed His father or His mother; His blood is upon Him.

verses.kjv: And the man that committeth adultery with another man's wife, even he that committeth adultery with his neighbour's wife, the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.
verses.modern: If a man commits adultery with the wife of his neighbor, both the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.

verses.kjv: And the man that lieth with his father's wife hath uncovered his father's nakedness: both of them shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.
verses.modern: If a man lies with his father's wife, he has uncovered His father's nakedness; both of them shall surely be put to death; their blood is upon them.

verses.kjv: And if a man lie with his daughter in law, both of them shall surely be put to death: they have wrought confusion; their blood shall be upon them.
verses.modern: If a man lies with his daughter-in-law, both of them shall surely be put to death; they have committed perversion; their blood is upon them.

verses.kjv: If a man also lie with mankind, as he lieth with a woman, both of them have committed an abomination: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.
verses.modern: If a man lies with a male as with a woman, both of them have committed an abomination; they shall surely be put to death; their blood is upon them.

verses.kjv: And if a man take a wife and her mother, it is wickedness: they shall be burnt with fire, both he and they; that there be no wickedness among you.
verses.modern: If a man takes a woman and her mother also, it is depravity; he and they shall be burned with fire, that there may be no depravity among You.

verses.kjv: And if a man lie with a beast, he shall surely be put to death: and ye shall slay the beast.
verses.modern: If a man lies with an animal, he shall surely be put to death, and You shall kill the animal.

verses.kjv: And if a woman approach unto any beast, and lie down thereto, thou shalt kill the woman, and the beast: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.
verses.modern: If a woman approaches any animal and lies with it, you shall kill the woman and the animal; they shall surely be put to death; their blood is upon them.

verses.kjv: And if a man shall take his sister, his father's daughter, or his mother's daughter, and see her nakedness, and she see his nakedness; it is a wicked thing; and they shall be cut off in the sight of their people: he hath uncovered his sister's nakedness; he shall bear his iniquity.
verses.modern: If a man takes his sister, a daughter of his father or a daughter of his mother, and sees her nakedness, and she sees his nakedness, it is a disgrace. They shall be cut off in the sight of the children of their people. He has uncovered his sister's nakedness. He shall bear his iniquity.

verses.kjv: And if a man shall lie with a woman having her sickness, and shall uncover her nakedness; he hath discovered her fountain, and she hath uncovered the fountain of her blood: and both of them shall be cut off from among their people.
verses.modern: If a man lies with a woman during her menstrual period and uncovers her nakedness, he has made naked her fountain. She has uncovered the fountain of her blood. Both of them shall be cut off from among their people.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother's sister, nor of thy father's sister: for he uncovereth his near kin: they shall bear their iniquity.
verses.modern: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother's sister or of your father's sister, for that is to make naked one's relative; they shall bear their iniquity.

verses.kjv: And if a man shall lie with his uncle's wife, he hath uncovered his uncle's nakedness: they shall bear their sin; they shall die childless.
verses.modern: If a man lies with his uncle's wife, he has uncovered his uncle's nakedness; they shall bear their sin; they shall die childless.

verses.kjv: And if a man shall take his brother's wife, it is an unclean thing: he hath uncovered his brother's nakedness; they shall be childless.
verses.modern: If a man takes his brother's wife, it is impurity. He has uncovered his brother's nakedness; they shall be childless.

verses.kjv: Ye shall therefore keep all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: that the land, whither I bring you to dwell therein, spue you not out.
verses.modern: You shall therefore keep all my statutes and all my rules and do them, that the land where I am bringing you to live may not vomit you out.

verses.kjv: And ye shall not walk in the manners of the nation, which I cast out before you: for they committed all these things, and therefore I abhorred them.
verses.modern: you shall not walk in the customs of the nation that I am driving out before you, for they did all these things, and therefore I detested them.

verses.kjv: But I have said unto you, Ye shall inherit their land, and I will give it unto you to possess it, a land that floweth with milk and honey: I am the LORD your God, which have separated you from other people.
verses.modern: But I have said to You, You shall inherit their land. I will give it to You to possess, a land flowing with milk and honey. I am the LORD Your God, Who has separated You from the peoples.

verses.kjv: Ye shall therefore put difference between clean beasts and unclean, and between unclean fowls and clean: and ye shall not make your souls abominable by beast, or by fowl, or by any manner of living thing that creepeth on the ground, which I have separated from you as unclean.
verses.modern: You shall therefore separate the clean beast from the unclean, and the unclean bird from the clean. You shall not make yourselves detestable by beast or by bird or by anything with which the ground crawls, which I have set apart for You to hold unclean.

verses.kjv: And ye shall be holy unto me: for I the LORD am holy, and have severed you from other people, that ye should be mine.
verses.modern: You shall be holy to me, for I the LORD am holy and have separated You from the peoples, that You should be mine.

verses.kjv: A man also or woman that hath a familiar spirit, or that is a wizard, shall surely be put to death: they shall stone them with stones: their blood shall be upon them.
verses.modern: A man or a woman who is a familiar spirit, or that is a wizard shall surely be put to death. They shall be stoned with stones; their blood shall be upon them.'

chapters.summary: The LORD prescribes the death penalty for giving children to Molech, consulting familiar spirits, cursing one's parents, adultery, and various sexual sins listed in chapter 18. He calls Israel to be holy and separated from the nations.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Speak unto the priests the sons of Aaron, and say unto them, There shall none be defiled for the dead among his people:
verses.modern: the LORD said to Moses, 'Speak to the priests, the sons of Aaron, and say to them, No one shall make himself unclean for the dead among His people,

verses.kjv: But for his kin, that is near unto him, that is, for his mother, and for his father, and for his son, and for his daughter, and for his brother,
verses.modern: except for His closest relatives, His mother, His father, His son, His daughter, His brother,

verses.kjv: And for his sister a virgin, that is nigh unto him, which hath had no husband; for her may he be defiled.
verses.modern: or His virgin sister (who is near to Him because she has had no husband; for her He may make Himself unclean).

verses.kjv: But he shall not defile himself, being a chief man among his people, to profane himself.
verses.modern: He shall not make Himself unclean as a chief man among His people and so profane Himself.

verses.kjv: They shall not make baldness upon their head, neither shall they shave off the corner of their beard, nor make any cuttings in their flesh.
verses.modern: They shall not make bald patches on their heads, nor shave off the edges of their beards, nor make any cuts on their body.

verses.kjv: They shall be holy unto their God, and not profane the name of their God: for the offerings of the LORD made by fire, and the bread of their God, they do offer: therefore they shall be holy.
verses.modern: They shall be holy to their God and not profane the name of their God. For they offer the LORD's offerings made by fire, the bread of their God; therefore they shall be holy.

verses.kjv: They shall not take a wife that is a whore, or profane; neither shall they take a woman put away from her husband: for he is holy unto his God.
verses.modern: They shall not marry a prostitute or a woman who has been defiled, neither shall they marry a woman divorced from her husband, for the priest is holy to his God.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt sanctify him therefore; for he offereth the bread of thy God: he shall be holy unto thee: for I the LORD, which sanctify you, am holy.
verses.modern: You shall sanctify Him, for He offers the bread of Your God. He shall be holy to You, for I, the LORD, Who sanctify You, am holy.

verses.kjv: And the daughter of any priest, if she profane herself by playing the whore, she profaneth her father: she shall be burnt with fire.
verses.modern: the daughter of any priest, if she profanes herself by whoring, profanes her father; she shall be burned with fire.

verses.kjv: And he that is the high priest among his brethren, upon whose head the anointing oil was poured, and that is consecrated to put on the garments, shall not uncover his head, nor rend his clothes;
verses.modern: The priest who is chief among his brothers, on whose head the anointing oil is poured and who has been consecrated to wear the garments, shall not let the hair of his head hang loose nor tear his clothes.

verses.kjv: Neither shall he go in to any dead body, nor defile himself for his father, or for his mother;
verses.modern: He shall not go in to any dead bodies nor make himself unclean, even for his father or for his mother.

verses.kjv: Neither shall he go out of the sanctuary, nor profane the sanctuary of his God; for the crown of the anointing oil of his God is upon him: I am the LORD.
verses.modern: He shall not go out of the sanctuary, lest He profane the sanctuary of His God, for the consecration of the anointing oil of His God is on Him: I am the LORD.

verses.kjv: And he shall take a wife in her virginity.
verses.modern: he shall take a wife in her virginity.

verses.kjv: A widow, or a divorced woman, or profane, or an harlot, these shall he not take: but he shall take a virgin of his own people to wife.
verses.modern: A widow, or a divorced woman, or a woman who has been defiled, or a prostitute — these He shall not marry. But He shall take as his wife a virgin of His own people,

verses.kjv: Neither shall he profane his seed among his people: for I the LORD do sanctify him.
verses.modern: that He may not profane His seed among His people, for I am the LORD Who sanctifies Him.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto Aaron, saying, Whosoever he be of thy seed in their generations that hath any blemish, let him not approach to offer the bread of his God.
verses.modern: 'Speak to Aaron, saying, None of your seed throughout their generations who has a blemish may approach to offer the bread of his God.

verses.kjv: For whatsoever man he be that hath a blemish, he shall not approach: a blind man, or a lame, or he that hath a flat nose, or any thing superfluous,
verses.modern: For no one who has a blemish shall draw near, a man blind or lame, or one who has a mutilated face or a limb too long,

verses.kjv: Or a man that is brokenfooted, or brokenhanded,
verses.modern: or a man who has an injured foot or an injured hand,

verses.kjv: Or crookbackt, or a dwarf, or that hath a blemish in his eye, or be scurvy, or scabbed, or hath his stones broken:
verses.modern: or a hunchback or a dwarf or a man with a defect in his sight or an itching disease or scabs or crushed testicles.

verses.kjv: No man that hath a blemish of the seed of Aaron the priest shall come nigh to offer the offerings of the LORD made by fire: he hath a blemish; he shall not come nigh to offer the bread of his God.
verses.modern: No man of the seed of Aaron the priest who has a blemish shall come near to offer the LORD's offerings made by fire; since He has a blemish, He shall not come near to offer the bread of His God.

verses.kjv: He shall eat the bread of his God, both of the most holy, and of the holy.
verses.modern: He may eat the bread of His God, both of the most holy and of the holy things,

verses.kjv: Only he shall not go in unto the vail, nor come nigh unto the altar, because he hath a blemish; that he profane not my sanctuaries: for I the LORD do sanctify them.
verses.modern: but He shall not go through the veil or approach the altar, because He has a blemish, that He may not profane my sanctuaries, for I am the LORD Who sanctifies them.'

verses.kjv: And Moses told it unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel.
verses.modern: So Moses spoke to Aaron and to his sons and to all the children of Israel.

chapters.summary: The LORD gives laws restricting how priests may mourn and whom they may marry. The high priest must not uncover his head or tear his clothes in mourning, and no descendant of Aaron with a physical blemish may approach the altar to offer the bread of God.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, that they separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, and that they profane not my holy name in those things which they hallow unto me: I am the LORD.
verses.modern: 'Speak to Aaron and his sons so that they keep away from the holy things of the children of Israel, which they dedicate to me, so that they do not profane my holy name: I am the LORD.

verses.kjv: Say unto them, Whosoever he be of all your seed among your generations, that goeth unto the holy things, which the children of Israel hallow unto the LORD, having his uncleanness upon him, that soul shall be cut off from my presence: I am the LORD.
verses.modern: Say to them, If any one of all Your seed throughout Your generations approaches the holy things that the children of Israel dedicate to the LORD, while He has an uncleanness, that person shall be cut off from my presence: I am the LORD.

verses.kjv: What man soever of the seed of Aaron is a leper, or hath a running issue; he shall not eat of the holy things, until he be clean. And whoso toucheth any thing that is unclean by the dead, or a man whose seed goeth from him;
verses.modern: None of the seed of Aaron who has a skin disease or a discharge may eat of the holy things until he is clean. Whoever touches anything that is unclean through contact with the dead or a man who has had an emission of semen,

verses.kjv: Or whosoever toucheth any creeping thing, whereby he may be made unclean, or a man of whom he may take uncleanness, whatsoever uncleanness he hath;
verses.modern: whoever touches a swarming thing by which he may be made unclean or a person from whom he may take uncleanness, whatever his uncleanness may be —

verses.kjv: The soul which hath touched any such shall be unclean until even, and shall not eat of the holy things, unless he wash his flesh with water.
verses.modern: the person who touches any such thing shall be unclean until the evening and shall not eat of the holy things unless he has bathed his body in water.

verses.kjv: And when the sun is down, he shall be clean, and shall afterward eat of the holy things; because it is his food.
verses.modern: When the sun goes down he shall be clean, and afterward he may eat of the holy things, because they are his food.

verses.kjv: That which dieth of itself, or is torn with beasts, he shall not eat to defile himself therewith: I am the LORD.
verses.modern: He shall not eat what dies of itself or is torn by beasts, and so make Himself unclean by it: I am the LORD.

verses.kjv: They shall therefore keep mine ordinance, lest they bear sin for it, and die therefore, if they profane it: I the LORD do sanctify them.
verses.modern: They shall therefore keep my charge, lest they bear sin for it and die thereby when they profane it: I am the LORD Who sanctifies them.

verses.kjv: There shall no stranger eat of the holy thing: a sojourner of the priest, or an hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing.
verses.modern: A lay person shall not eat of a holy thing; no foreign guest of the priest or hired worker shall eat of a holy thing.

verses.kjv: But if the priest buy any soul with his money, he shall eat of it, and he that is born in his house: they shall eat of his meat.
verses.modern: But if a priest buys a slave as his property for money, the slave may eat of it, and anyone born in his house may eat of his food.

verses.kjv: If the priest's daughter also be married unto a stranger, she may not eat of an offering of the holy things.
verses.modern: If a priest's daughter marries a layman, she shall not eat of the contribution of the holy things.

verses.kjv: But if the priest's daughter be a widow, or divorced, and have no child, and is returned unto her father's house, as in her youth, she shall eat of her father's meat: but there shall no stranger eat thereof.
verses.modern: But if a priest's daughter is widowed or divorced and has no children and returns to her father's house, as in her youth, she may eat of her father's food; yet no lay person shall eat of it.

verses.kjv: And if a man eat of the holy thing unwittingly, then he shall put the fifth part thereof unto it, and shall give it unto the priest with the holy thing.
verses.modern: if anyone eats of a holy thing unintentionally, he shall add the fifth of its value to it and give the holy thing to the priest.

verses.kjv: And they shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, which they offer unto the LORD;
verses.modern: They shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, which they contribute to the LORD,

verses.kjv: Or suffer them to bear the iniquity of trespass, when they eat their holy things: for I the LORD do sanctify them.
verses.modern: so cause them to bear iniquity and guilt, by eating their holy things: for I am the LORD Who sanctifies them.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them, Whatsoever he be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers in Israel, that will offer his oblation for all his vows, and for all his freewill offerings, which they will offer unto the LORD for a burnt offering;
verses.modern: 'Speak to Aaron and his sons and all the children of Israel and say to them, When any one of the house of Israel or of the sojourners in Israel presents a burnt offering as His offering, for any of their vows or freewill offerings that they offer to the LORD,

verses.kjv: Ye shall offer at your own will a male without blemish, of the beeves, of the sheep, or of the goats.
verses.modern: if it is to be accepted for You it shall be a male without blemish, of the bulls or the sheep or the goats.

verses.kjv: But whatsoever hath a blemish, that shall ye not offer: for it shall not be acceptable for you.
verses.modern: You shall not offer anything that has a blemish, for it will not be acceptable for You.

verses.kjv: And whosoever offereth a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the LORD to accomplish his vow, or a freewill offering in beeves or sheep, it shall be perfect to be accepted; there shall be no blemish therein.
verses.modern: when anyone offers a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD to fulfill a vow or as a freewill offering from the herd or flock, to be accepted it must be perfect; there shall be no blemish in it.

verses.kjv: Blind, or broken, or maimed, or having a wen, or scurvy, or scabbed, ye shall not offer these unto the LORD, nor make an offering by fire of them upon the altar unto the LORD.
verses.modern: Animals blind or disabled or mutilated or having a discharge or an itch or scabs You shall not offer to the LORD or give them to the LORD as a offering made by fire on the altar.

verses.kjv: Either a bullock or a lamb that hath any thing superfluous or lacking in his parts, that mayest thou offer for a freewill offering; but for a vow it shall not be accepted.
verses.modern: You may present a bull or a lamb that has a part too long or too short for a freewill offering, but for a vow offering it cannot be accepted.

verses.kjv: Ye shall not offer unto the LORD that which is bruised, or crushed, or broken, or cut; neither shall ye make any offering thereof in your land.
verses.modern: Any animal that has its testicles bruised or crushed or torn or cut You shall not offer to the LORD; You shall not do it within Your land.

verses.kjv: Neither from a stranger's hand shall ye offer the bread of your God of any of these; because their corruption is in them, and blemishes be in them: they shall not be accepted for you.
verses.modern: Neither shall You offer as the bread of Your God any such animals gotten from a foreigner. Since there is a blemish in them, because of their mutilation, they will not be accepted for You.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: When a bullock, or a sheep, or a goat, is brought forth, then it shall be seven days under the dam; and from the eighth day and thenceforth it shall be accepted for an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.modern: When an ox or sheep or goat is born, it shall remain seven days with its mother, and from the eighth day on it shall be acceptable as a offering made by fire to the LORD.

verses.kjv: And whether it be cow or ewe, ye shall not kill it and her young both in one day.
verses.modern: But You shall not kill an ox or a sheep and her young in the same day.

verses.kjv: And when ye will offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving unto the LORD, offer it at your own will.
verses.modern: when You sacrifice a sacrifice of thanksgiving to the LORD, You shall sacrifice it so that You may be accepted.

verses.kjv: On the same day it shall be eaten up; ye shall leave none of it until the morrow: I am the LORD.
verses.modern: It shall be eaten on the same day; You shall leave none of it until morning: I am the LORD.

verses.kjv: Therefore shall ye keep my commandments, and do them: I am the LORD.
verses.modern: So You shall keep my commandments and do them: I am the LORD.

verses.kjv: Neither shall ye profane my holy name; but I will be hallowed among the children of Israel: I am the LORD which hallow you,
verses.modern: you shall not profane my holy name, that I may be sanctified among the children of Israel. I am the LORD Who sanctifies You,

verses.kjv: That brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am the LORD.
verses.modern: who brought You out of the land of Egypt to be Your God: I am the LORD.'

chapters.summary: The LORD gives laws requiring priests to avoid uncleanness when handling holy things, and specifying who in a priest's household may eat the holy food. Sacrificial animals must be without blemish, and no animal may be offered before it is eight days old.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, Concerning the feasts of the LORD, which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my feasts.
verses.modern: 'Speak to the children of Israel and say to them, These are the appointed feasts of the LORD that You shall proclaim as holy convocations; they are my appointed feasts.

verses.kjv: Six days shall work be done: but the seventh day is the sabbath of rest, an holy convocation; ye shall do no work therein: it is the sabbath of the LORD in all your dwellings.
verses.modern: Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day is a Sabbath of solemn rest, a holy convocation. You shall do no work. It is a Sabbath to the LORD in all Your dwelling places.

verses.kjv: These are the feasts of the LORD, even holy convocations, which ye shall proclaim in their seasons.
verses.modern: These are the appointed feasts of the LORD, the holy convocations, which You shall proclaim at the time appointed for them.

verses.kjv: In the fourteenth day of the first month at even is the LORD's passover.
verses.modern: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month at twilight, is the LORD's Passover.

verses.kjv: And on the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread unto the LORD: seven days ye must eat unleavened bread.
verses.modern: on the fifteenth day of the same month is the Feast of Unleavened Bread to the LORD; for seven days You shall eat unleavened bread.

verses.kjv: In the first day ye shall have an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work therein.
verses.modern: On the first day You shall have a holy convocation; You shall not do any ordinary work.

verses.kjv: But ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD seven days: in the seventh day is an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work therein.
verses.modern: But You shall present a offering made by fire to the LORD for seven days. On the seventh day is a holy convocation; You shall not do any ordinary work.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come into the land which I give unto you, and shall reap the harvest thereof, then ye shall bring a sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest unto the priest:
verses.modern: 'Speak to the children of Israel and say to them, When you come into the land that I give you and reap its harvest, you shall bring the sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest to the priest,

verses.kjv: And he shall wave the sheaf before the LORD, to be accepted for you: on the morrow after the sabbath the priest shall wave it.
verses.modern: he shall wave the sheaf before the LORD, so that You may be accepted. On the day after the Sabbath the priest shall wave it.

verses.kjv: And ye shall offer that day when ye wave the sheaf an he lamb without blemish of the first year for a burnt offering unto the LORD.
verses.modern: on the day when You wave the sheaf, You shall offer a male lamb a year old without blemish as a burnt offering to the LORD.

verses.kjv: And the meat offering thereof shall be two tenth deals of fine flour mingled with oil, an offering made by fire unto the LORD for a sweet savour: and the drink offering thereof shall be of wine, the fourth part of an hin.
verses.modern: the grain offering with it shall be two tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil, a offering made by fire to the LORD with a sweet savour, and the drink offering with it shall be of wine, a fourth of a hin.

verses.kjv: And ye shall eat neither bread, nor parched corn, nor green ears, until the selfsame day that ye have brought an offering unto your God: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
verses.modern: you shall eat neither bread nor grain parched or fresh until this same day, until You have brought the offering of Your God: it is a statute forever throughout Your generations in all Your dwelling places.

verses.kjv: And ye shall count unto you from the morrow after the sabbath, from the day that ye brought the sheaf of the wave offering; seven sabbaths shall be complete:
verses.modern: You shall count seven full weeks from the day after the Sabbath, from the day that You brought the sheaf of the wave offering.

verses.kjv: Even unto the morrow after the seventh sabbath shall ye number fifty days; and ye shall offer a new meat offering unto the LORD.
verses.modern: You shall count fifty days to the day after the seventh Sabbath. Then You shall present a grain offering of new grain to the LORD.

verses.kjv: Ye shall bring out of your habitations two wave loaves of two tenth deals: they shall be of fine flour; they shall be baken with leaven; they are the firstfruits unto the LORD.
verses.modern: You shall bring from Your dwelling places two loaves of bread to be waved, made of two tenths of an ephah. They shall be of fine flour. They shall be baked with leaven, as firstfruits to the LORD.

verses.kjv: And ye shall offer with the bread seven lambs without blemish of the first year, and one young bullock, and two rams: they shall be for a burnt offering unto the LORD, with their meat offering, and their drink offerings, even an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.modern: you shall present with the bread seven lambs a year old without blemish, and one bull from the herd and two rams. They shall be a burnt offering to the LORD, with their grain offering and their drink offerings, a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto the LORD.

verses.kjv: Then ye shall sacrifice one kid of the goats for a sin offering, and two lambs of the first year for a sacrifice of peace offerings.
verses.modern: you shall offer one male goat for a sin offering, and two male lambs a year old as a sacrifice of peace offerings.

verses.kjv: And the priest shall wave them with the bread of the firstfruits for a wave offering before the LORD, with the two lambs: they shall be holy to the LORD for the priest.
verses.modern: the priest shall wave them with the bread of the firstfruits as a wave offering before the LORD, with the two lambs. They shall be holy to the LORD for the priest.

verses.kjv: And ye shall proclaim on the selfsame day, that it may be an holy convocation unto you: ye shall do no servile work therein: it shall be a statute for ever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.
verses.modern: you shall make a proclamation on the same day. You shall hold a holy convocation. You shall not do any ordinary work. It is a statute forever in all Your dwelling places throughout Your generations.

verses.kjv: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not make clean riddance of the corners of thy field when thou reapest, neither shalt thou gather any gleaning of thy harvest: thou shalt leave them unto the poor, and to the stranger: I am the LORD your God.
verses.modern: when You reap the harvest of Your land, You shall not reap Your field right up to its edge, nor shall You gather the gleanings after Your harvest. You shall leave them for the poor and for the sojourner: I am the LORD Your God.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, In the seventh month, in the first day of the month, shall ye have a sabbath, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, an holy convocation.
verses.modern: 'Speak to the children of Israel, saying, In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, You shall observe a day of solemn rest, a memorial proclaimed with the blast of trumpets, a holy convocation.

verses.kjv: Ye shall do no servile work therein: but ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.modern: You shall not do any ordinary work, and You shall present a offering made by fire to the LORD.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Also on the tenth day of this seventh month there shall be a day of atonement: it shall be an holy convocation unto you; and ye shall afflict your souls, and offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.modern: 'Now on the tenth day of this seventh month is the Day of Atonement. It shall be for You a time of holy convocation, and You shall afflict yourselves and present a offering made by fire to the LORD.

verses.kjv: And ye shall do no work in that same day: for it is a day of atonement, to make an atonement for you before the LORD your God.
verses.modern: you shall not do any work on that very day, for it is a Day of Atonement, to make atonement for You before the LORD Your God.

verses.kjv: For whatsoever soul it be that shall not be afflicted in that same day, he shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.modern: For whoever is not afflicted on that very day shall be cut off from His people.

verses.kjv: And whatsoever soul it be that doeth any work in that same day, the same soul will I destroy from among his people.
verses.modern: whoever does any work on that very day, that person I will destroy from among His people.

verses.kjv: Ye shall do no manner of work: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
verses.modern: You shall not do any work. It is a statute forever throughout Your generations in all Your dwelling places.

verses.kjv: It shall be unto you a sabbath of rest, and ye shall afflict your souls: in the ninth day of the month at even, from even unto even, shall ye celebrate your sabbath.
verses.modern: It shall be to You a Sabbath of solemn rest, and You shall afflict yourselves. On the ninth day of the month beginning at evening, from evening to evening shall You keep Your Sabbath.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, The fifteenth day of this seventh month shall be the feast of tabernacles for seven days unto the LORD.
verses.modern: 'Speak to the children of Israel, saying, On the fifteenth day of this seventh month and for seven days is the Feast of Booths to the LORD.

verses.kjv: On the first day shall be an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work therein.
verses.modern: On the first day shall be a holy convocation; You shall not do any ordinary work.

verses.kjv: Seven days ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD: on the eighth day shall be an holy convocation unto you; and ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD: it is a solemn assembly; and ye shall do no servile work therein.
verses.modern: For seven days You shall present offerings made by fire to the LORD. On the eighth day You shall hold a holy convocation and present a offering made by fire to the LORD. It is a solemn assembly; You shall not do any ordinary work.

verses.kjv: These are the feasts of the LORD, which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations, to offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD, a burnt offering, and a meat offering, a sacrifice, and drink offerings, every thing upon his day:
verses.modern: These are the appointed feasts of the LORD, which You shall proclaim as times of holy convocation, for presenting to the LORD offerings made by fire, burnt offerings and grain offerings, sacrifices and drink offerings, each on its proper day,

verses.kjv: Beside the sabbaths of the LORD, and beside your gifts, and beside all your vows, and beside all your freewill offerings, which ye give unto the LORD.
verses.modern: besides the LORD's Sabbaths and besides Your gifts and besides all Your vow offerings and besides all Your freewill offerings, which You give to the LORD.

verses.kjv: Also in the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when ye have gathered in the fruit of the land, ye shall keep a feast unto the LORD seven days: on the first day shall be a sabbath, and on the eighth day shall be a sabbath.
verses.modern: On the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when You have gathered in the produce of the land, You shall celebrate the feast of the LORD seven days. On the first day shall be a solemn rest, and on the eighth day shall be a solemn rest.

verses.kjv: And ye shall take you on the first day the boughs of goodly trees, branches of palm trees, and the boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook; and ye shall rejoice before the LORD your God seven days.
verses.modern: you shall take on the first day the fruit of splendid trees, branches of palm trees and boughs of leafy trees and willows of the brook, and You shall rejoice before the LORD Your God seven days.

verses.kjv: And ye shall keep it a feast unto the LORD seven days in the year. It shall be a statute for ever in your generations: ye shall celebrate it in the seventh month.
verses.modern: You shall celebrate it as a feast to the LORD for seven days in the year. It is a statute forever throughout Your generations; You shall celebrate it in the seventh month.

verses.kjv: Ye shall dwell in booths seven days; all that are Israelites born shall dwell in booths:
verses.modern: You shall dwell in booths for seven days. All native Israelites shall dwell in booths,

verses.kjv: That your generations may know that I made the children of Israel to dwell in booths, when I brought them out of the land of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.
verses.modern: that Your generations may know that I made the children of Israel dwell in booths when I brought them out of the land of Egypt: I am the LORD Your God.'

verses.kjv: And Moses declared unto the children of Israel the feasts of the LORD.
verses.modern: Thus Moses declared to the children of Israel the appointed feasts of the LORD.

chapters.summary: The LORD establishes Israel's appointed feasts: the weekly Sabbath, Passover and Unleavened Bread, Firstfruits, the Feast of Weeks, the Feast of Trumpets, the Day of Atonement, and the Feast of Tabernacles. Each feast has specific dates, offerings, and observances.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Command the children of Israel, that they bring unto thee pure oil olive beaten for the light, to cause the lamps to burn continually.
verses.modern: 'Command the children of Israel to bring You pure oil from beaten olives for the lamp, that a light may be kept burning regularly.

verses.kjv: Without the vail of the testimony, in the tabernacle of the congregation, shall Aaron order it from the evening unto the morning before the LORD continually: it shall be a statute for ever in your generations.
verses.modern: Outside the veil of the testimony, in the tent of meeting, Aaron shall tend it from evening to morning before the LORD regularly. It shall be a statute forever throughout Your generations.

verses.kjv: He shall order the lamps upon the pure candlestick before the LORD continually.
verses.modern: He shall tend the lamps on the lampstand of pure gold before the LORD regularly.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes thereof: two tenth deals shall be in one cake.
verses.modern: You shall take fine flour and bake twelve loaves from it; two tenths of an ephah shall be in each loaf.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt set them in two rows, six on a row, upon the pure table before the LORD.
verses.modern: you shall set them in two piles, six in a pile, on the table of pure gold before the LORD.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt put pure frankincense upon each row, that it may be on the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.modern: you shall put pure frankincense on each pile, that it may go with the bread as a memorial portion as a offering made by fire to the LORD.

verses.kjv: Every sabbath he shall set it in order before the LORD continually, being taken from the children of Israel by an everlasting covenant.
verses.modern: Every Sabbath day Aaron shall arrange it before the LORD regularly; it is from the children of Israel as a covenant forever.

verses.kjv: And it shall be Aaron's and his sons'; and they shall eat it in the holy place: for it is most holy unto him of the offerings of the LORD made by fire by a perpetual statute.
verses.modern: it shall be for Aaron and his sons. They shall eat it in a holy place, since it is for Him a most holy portion out of the LORD's offerings made by fire, a perpetual due.'

verses.kjv: And the son of an Israelitish woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel: and this Israelitish woman's son and a man of Israel strove together in the camp;
verses.modern: Now an Israelite woman's son, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel. And the Israelite woman's son and a man of Israel fought in the camp,

verses.kjv: And the Israelitish woman's son blasphemed the name of the LORD, and cursed. And they brought him unto Moses: (and his mother's name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan:)
verses.modern: the Israelite woman's son blasphemed the Name, and cursed. Then they brought him to Moses. His mother's name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.

verses.kjv: And they put him in ward, that the mind of the LORD might be shewed them.
verses.modern: they put Him in custody, till the will of the LORD should be clear to them.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Bring forth him that hath cursed without the camp; and let all that heard him lay their hands upon his head, and let all the congregation stone him.
verses.modern: 'Bring out of the camp the one who cursed, and let all who heard him lay their hands on His head, and let all the congregation stone Him.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Whosoever curseth his God shall bear his sin.
verses.modern: speak to the children of Israel, saying, Whoever curses his God shall bear His sin.

verses.kjv: And he that blasphemeth the name of the LORD, he shall surely be put to death, and all the congregation shall certainly stone him: as well the stranger, as he that is born in the land, when he blasphemeth the name of the LORD, shall be put to death.
verses.modern: Whoever blasphemes the name of the LORD shall surely be put to death. All the congregation shall stone Him. The sojourner as well as the native, when He blasphemes the Name, shall be put to death.

verses.kjv: And he that killeth any man shall surely be put to death.
verses.modern: Whoever takes a human life shall surely be put to death.

verses.kjv: And he that killeth a beast shall make it good; beast for beast.
verses.modern: Whoever takes an animal's life shall make it good, life for life.

verses.kjv: And if a man cause a blemish in his neighbour; as he hath done, so shall it be done to him;
verses.modern: If anyone injures his neighbor, as he has done it shall be done to Him,

verses.kjv: Breach for breach, eye for eye, tooth for tooth: as he hath caused a blemish in a man, so shall it be done to him again.
verses.modern: fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth; whatever injury He has given a person shall be given to Him.

verses.kjv: And he that killeth a beast, he shall restore it: and he that killeth a man, he shall be put to death.
verses.modern: Whoever kills an animal shall make it good, and whoever kills a person shall be put to death.

verses.kjv: Ye shall have one manner of law, as well for the stranger, as for one of your own country: for I am the LORD your God.
verses.modern: You shall have the same rule for the sojourner and for the native, for I am the LORD Your God.'

verses.kjv: And Moses spake to the children of Israel, that they should bring forth him that had cursed out of the camp, and stone him with stones. And the children of Israel did as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.modern: So Moses spoke to the children of Israel. They brought out of the camp the one who had cursed and stoned him with stones. Thus the children of Israel did as the LORD commanded Moses.

chapters.summary: The LORD commands pure olive oil to be kept burning continually in the lampstand and showbread to be set before Him every Sabbath. A man who blasphemed the name of the LORD was brought to Moses, and the LORD commanded that he be stoned; He then restates the law of eye for eye and tooth for tooth.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses in mount Sinai, saying,
verses.modern: The LORD spoke to Moses on Mount Sinai, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land which I give you, then shall the land keep a sabbath unto the LORD.
verses.modern: 'Speak to the children of Israel and say to them, When You come into the land that I give You, the land shall keep a Sabbath to the LORD.

verses.kjv: Six years thou shalt sow thy field, and six years thou shalt prune thy vineyard, and gather in the fruit thereof;
verses.modern: For six years You shall sow Your field, and for six years You shall prune Your vineyard and gather in its fruits,

verses.kjv: But in the seventh year shall be a sabbath of rest unto the land, a sabbath for the LORD: thou shalt neither sow thy field, nor prune thy vineyard.
verses.modern: but in the seventh year there shall be a Sabbath of solemn rest for the land, a Sabbath to the LORD. You shall not sow Your field or prune Your vineyard.

verses.kjv: That which groweth of its own accord of thy harvest thou shalt not reap, neither gather the grapes of thy vine undressed: for it is a year of rest unto the land.
verses.modern: What grows of itself in Your harvest You shall not reap, and the grapes of Your undressed vine You shall not gather, for it is a year of solemn rest for the land.

verses.kjv: And the sabbath of the land shall be meat for you; for thee, and for thy servant, and for thy maid, and for thy hired servant, and for thy stranger that sojourneth with thee,
verses.modern: The Sabbath of the land shall provide food for You, for Yourself and for Your male and female slaves and for Your hired worker and the sojourner who lives with You,

verses.kjv: And for thy cattle, and for the beast that are in thy land, shall all the increase thereof be meat.
verses.modern: for Your cattle and for the wild animals that are in Your land: all its yield shall be for food.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt number seven sabbaths of years unto thee, seven times seven years; and the space of the seven sabbaths of years shall be unto thee forty and nine years.
verses.modern: You shall count seven weeks of years, seven times seven years, so that the time of the seven weeks of years shall give You forty-nine years.

verses.kjv: Then shalt thou cause the trumpet of the jubile to sound on the tenth day of the seventh month, in the day of atonement shall ye make the trumpet sound throughout all your land.
verses.modern: Then You shall sound the loud trumpet on the tenth day of the seventh month. On the Day of Atonement You shall sound the trumpet throughout all Your land.

verses.kjv: And ye shall hallow the fiftieth year, and proclaim liberty throughout all the land unto all the inhabitants thereof: it shall be a jubile unto you; and ye shall return every man unto his possession, and ye shall return every man unto his family.
verses.modern: you shall consecrate the fiftieth year, and proclaim liberty throughout the land to all its inhabitants. It shall be a jubilee for You, when each of You shall return to His property and each of You shall return to His clan.

verses.kjv: A jubile shall that fiftieth year be unto you: ye shall not sow, neither reap that which groweth of itself in it, nor gather the grapes in it of thy vine undressed.
verses.modern: That fiftieth year shall be a jubilee for You; in it You shall neither sow nor reap what grows of itself nor gather the grapes from the undressed vines.

verses.kjv: For it is the jubile; it shall be holy unto you: ye shall eat the increase thereof out of the field.
verses.modern: For it is a jubilee. It shall be holy to You. You may eat the produce of the field.

verses.kjv: In the year of this jubile ye shall return every man unto his possession.
verses.modern: In this year of jubilee each of You shall return to His property.

verses.kjv: And if thou sell ought unto thy neighbour, or buyest ought of thy neighbour's hand, ye shall not oppress one another:
verses.modern: if You make a sale to Your neighbor or buy from Your neighbor, You shall not wrong one another.

verses.kjv: According to the number of years after the jubile thou shalt buy of thy neighbour, and according unto the number of years of the fruits he shall sell unto thee:
verses.modern: You shall pay Your neighbor according to the number of years after the jubilee. He shall sell to You according to the number of years for crops.

verses.kjv: According to the multitude of years thou shalt increase the price thereof, and according to the fewness of years thou shalt diminish the price of it: for according to the number of the years of the fruits doth he sell unto thee.
verses.modern: If the years are many, You shall increase the price, and if the years are few, You shall reduce the price, for it is the number of the crops that He is selling to You.

verses.kjv: Ye shall not therefore oppress one another; but thou shalt fear thy God: for I am the LORD your God.
verses.modern: You shall not wrong one another, but You shall fear Your God, for I am the LORD Your God.

verses.kjv: Wherefore ye shall do my statutes, and keep my judgments, and do them; and ye shall dwell in the land in safety.
verses.modern: Therefore You shall do my statutes and keep my rules and perform them, and then You will dwell in the land securely.

verses.kjv: And the land shall yield her fruit, and ye shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety.
verses.modern: The land will yield its fruit, and You will eat Your fill and dwell in it securely.
