verses.kjv: And if ye shall say, What shall we eat the seventh year? behold, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase:
verses.modern: if You say, What shall we eat in the seventh year, if we may not sow or gather in our crop?

verses.kjv: Then I will command my blessing upon you in the sixth year, and it shall bring forth fruit for three years.
verses.modern: I will command my blessing on You in the sixth year, so that it will produce a crop sufficient for three years.

verses.kjv: And ye shall sow the eighth year, and eat yet of old fruit until the ninth year; until her fruits come in ye shall eat of the old store.
verses.modern: When You sow in the eighth year, You will be eating some of the old crop; You shall eat the old until the ninth year, when its crop arrives.

verses.kjv: The land shall not be sold for ever: for the land is mine; for ye are strangers and sojourners with me.
verses.modern: The land shall not be sold in perpetuity, for the land is mine. For You are strangers and sojourners with me.

verses.kjv: And in all the land of your possession ye shall grant a redemption for the land.
verses.modern: in all the country You possess, You shall allow a redemption of the land.

verses.kjv: If thy brother be waxen poor, and hath sold away some of his possession, and if any of his kin come to redeem it, then shall he redeem that which his brother sold.
verses.modern: If Your brother becomes poor and sells part of His property, then His nearest redeemer shall come and redeem what His brother has sold.

verses.kjv: And if the man have none to redeem it, and himself be able to redeem it;
verses.modern: If a man has no one to redeem it and then himself becomes prosperous and finds sufficient means to redeem it,

verses.kjv: Then let him count the years of the sale thereof, and restore the overplus unto the man to whom he sold it; that he may return unto his possession.
verses.modern: let him calculate the years since he sold it and pay back the balance to the man to whom he sold it, and then return to his property.

verses.kjv: But if he be not able to restore it to him, then that which is sold shall remain in the hand of him that hath bought it until the year of jubile: and in the jubile it shall go out, and he shall return unto his possession.
verses.modern: But if he does not have sufficient means to recover it, then what he sold shall remain in the hand of the buyer until the year of jubilee. In the jubilee it shall be released. He shall return to his property.

verses.kjv: And if a man sell a dwelling house in a walled city, then he may redeem it within a whole year after it is sold; within a full year may he redeem it.
verses.modern: If a man sells a dwelling house in a walled city, he may redeem it within a year of its sale. For a full year he shall have the right of redemption.

verses.kjv: And if it be not redeemed within the space of a full year, then the house that is in the walled city shall be established for ever to him that bought it throughout his generations: it shall not go out in the jubile.
verses.modern: If it is not redeemed within a full year, then the house in the walled city shall belong in perpetuity to the buyer, throughout his generations; it shall not be released in the jubilee.

verses.kjv: But the houses of the villages which have no wall round about them shall be counted as the fields of the country: they may be redeemed, and they shall go out in the jubile.
verses.modern: But the houses of the villages that have no wall around them shall be classified with the fields of the land. They may be redeemed. They shall be released in the jubilee.

verses.kjv: Notwithstanding the cities of the Levites, and the houses of the cities of their possession, may the Levites redeem at any time.
verses.modern: As for the cities of the Levites, the Levites may redeem at any time the houses in the cities they possess.

verses.kjv: And if a man purchase of the Levites, then the house that was sold, and the city of his possession, shall go out in the year of jubile: for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel.
verses.modern: if one of the Levites exercises his right of redemption, then the house that was sold in a city they possess shall be released in the jubilee. For the houses in the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel.

verses.kjv: But the field of the suburbs of their cities may not be sold; for it is their perpetual possession.
verses.modern: But the fields of pastureland belonging to their cities may not be sold, for that is their permanent possession.

verses.kjv: And if thy brother be waxen poor, and fallen in decay with thee; then thou shalt relieve him: yea, though he be a stranger, or a sojourner; that he may live with thee.
verses.modern: If your brother becomes poor and cannot maintain himself with you, you shall support him as though he were a stranger and a sojourner. He shall live with you.

verses.kjv: Take thou no usury of him, or increase: but fear thy God; that thy brother may live with thee.
verses.modern: Take no interest from him or profit, but fear your God, that your brother may live beside you.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not give him thy money upon usury, nor lend him thy victuals for increase.
verses.modern: You shall not lend him your money at interest, nor give him your food for profit.

verses.kjv: I am the LORD your God, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, and to be your God.
verses.modern: I am the LORD Your God, Who brought You out of the land of Egypt to give You the land of Canaan, and to be Your God.

verses.kjv: And if thy brother that dwelleth by thee be waxen poor, and be sold unto thee; thou shalt not compel him to serve as a bondservant:
verses.modern: If Your brother becomes poor beside You and sells Himself to You, You shall not make Him serve as a slave.

verses.kjv: But as an hired servant, and as a sojourner, he shall be with thee, and shall serve thee unto the year of jubile:
verses.modern: He shall be with You as a hired worker and as a sojourner. He shall serve with You until the year of the jubilee.

verses.kjv: And then shall he depart from him, and his children with him, and shall return unto his own family, and unto the possession of his fathers shall he return.
verses.modern: Then He shall go out from You, He and His children with Him, and go back to His own clan and return to the possession of His fathers.

verses.kjv: For they are my servants, which I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: they shall not be sold as bondmen.
verses.modern: For they are my servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt; they shall not be sold as slaves.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not rule over him with rigour; but shalt fear thy God.
verses.modern: You shall not rule over Him ruthlessly but shall fear Your God.

verses.kjv: Both thy bondmen, and thy bondmaids, which thou shalt have, shall be of the heathen that are round about you; of them shall ye buy bondmen and bondmaids.
verses.modern: As for Your male and female slaves whom You may have: You may buy male and female slaves from among the nations that are around you.

verses.kjv: Moreover of the children of the strangers that do sojourn among you, of them shall ye buy, and of their families that are with you, which they begat in your land: and they shall be your possession.
verses.modern: You may also buy from among the strangers who stay with You and their clans that are with You, who have been born in Your land. They may be Your property.

verses.kjv: And ye shall take them as an inheritance for your children after you, to inherit them for a possession; they shall be your bondmen for ever: but over your brethren the children of Israel, ye shall not rule one over another with rigour.
verses.modern: You may bequeath them to Your sons after You to inherit as a possession forever. You may make slaves of them, but over Your brothers the children of Israel You shall not rule, one over another ruthlessly.

verses.kjv: And if a sojourner or stranger wax rich by thee, and thy brother that dwelleth by him wax poor, and sell himself unto the stranger or sojourner by thee, or to the stock of the stranger's family:
verses.modern: If a stranger or sojourner with You becomes rich, and Your brother beside Him becomes poor and sells Himself to the stranger or sojourner with You or to a member of the stranger's clan,

verses.kjv: After that he is sold he may be redeemed again; one of his brethren may redeem him:
verses.modern: then after He is sold He may be redeemed. One of His brothers may redeem Him,

verses.kjv: Either his uncle, or his uncle's son, may redeem him, or any that is nigh of kin unto him of his family may redeem him; or if he be able, he may redeem himself.
verses.modern: or his uncle or his cousin may redeem Him, or a close relative from His clan may redeem Him. Or if He grows rich He may redeem Himself.

verses.kjv: And he shall reckon with him that bought him from the year that he was sold to him unto the year of jubile: and the price of his sale shall be according unto the number of years, according to the time of an hired servant shall it be with him.
verses.modern: He shall calculate with His buyer from the year when He sold Himself to Him until the year of jubilee, and the price of His sale shall vary with the number of years. The time He was with His owner shall be rated as the time of a hired worker.

verses.kjv: If there be yet many years behind, according unto them he shall give again the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.
verses.modern: If there are still many years left, He shall pay proportionally for His redemption some of His sale price.

verses.kjv: And if there remain but few years unto the year of jubile, then he shall count with him, and according unto his years shall he give him again the price of his redemption.
verses.modern: If there remain but a few years until the year of jubilee, He shall calculate and pay for His redemption in proportion to His years of service.

verses.kjv: And as a yearly hired servant shall he be with him: and the other shall not rule with rigour over him in thy sight.
verses.modern: He shall treat Him as a worker hired year by year. He shall not rule ruthlessly over Him in Your sight.

verses.kjv: And if he be not redeemed in these years, then he shall go out in the year of jubile, both he, and his children with him.
verses.modern: if He is not redeemed by these means, then He and His children with Him shall be released in the year of jubilee.

verses.kjv: For unto me the children of Israel are servants; they are my servants whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.
verses.modern: For it is to me that the children of Israel are servants. They are my servants whom I brought out of the land of Egypt: I am the LORD Your God.'

chapters.summary: The LORD commands the land to rest every seventh year as a Sabbath, and every fiftieth year to be a jubilee when all land returns to its original owner and Hebrew slaves go free. He provides for the redemption of property and persons, declaring that the land is His and the Israelites are His servants.

verses.kjv: Ye shall make you no idols nor graven image, neither rear you up a standing image, neither shall ye set up any image of stone in your land, to bow down unto it: for I am the LORD your God.
verses.modern: 'You shall not make idols for yourselves or erect an image or pillar, and You shall not set up a figured stone in Your land to bow down to it, for I am the LORD Your God.

verses.kjv: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am the LORD.
verses.modern: You shall keep my Sabbaths and reverence my sanctuary: I am the LORD.

verses.kjv: If ye walk in my statutes, and keep my commandments, and do them;
verses.modern: If You walk in my statutes and observe my commandments and do them,

verses.kjv: Then I will give you rain in due season, and the land shall yield her increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.
verses.modern: then I will give You Your rains in their season, and the land shall yield its increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.

verses.kjv: And your threshing shall reach unto the vintage, and the vintage shall reach unto the sowing time: and ye shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.
verses.modern: Your threshing shall last to the time of the grape harvest, and the grape harvest shall last to the time for sowing. And You shall eat Your bread to the full and dwell in Your land securely.

verses.kjv: And I will give peace in the land, and ye shall lie down, and none shall make you afraid: and I will rid evil beasts out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.
verses.modern: I will give peace in the land, and You shall lie down, and none shall make You afraid. And I will remove harmful beasts from the land, and the sword shall not go through Your land.

verses.kjv: And ye shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.
verses.modern: You shall chase Your enemies. They shall fall before You by the sword.

verses.kjv: And five of you shall chase an hundred, and an hundred of you shall put ten thousand to flight: and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.
verses.modern: Five of You shall chase a hundred, and a hundred of You shall chase ten thousand, and Your enemies shall fall before You by the sword.

verses.kjv: For I will have respect unto you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, and establish my covenant with you.
verses.modern: I will turn to You and make You fruitful and multiply You and will confirm my covenant with You.

verses.kjv: And ye shall eat old store, and bring forth the old because of the new.
verses.modern: You shall eat old grain long kept, and You shall clear out the old to make way for the new.

verses.kjv: And I will set my tabernacle among you: and my soul shall not abhor you.
verses.modern: I will make my dwelling among You, and my soul shall not abhor You.

verses.kjv: And I will walk among you, and will be your God, and ye shall be my people.
verses.modern: I will walk among You and will be Your God, and You shall be my people.

verses.kjv: I am the LORD your God, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, that ye should not be their bondmen; and I have broken the bands of your yoke, and made you go upright.
verses.modern: I am the LORD Your God, Who brought You out of the land of Egypt, that You should not be their slaves. And I have broken the bars of Your yoke and made You walk upright.

verses.kjv: But if ye will not hearken unto me, and will not do all these commandments;
verses.modern: But if You will not listen to me and will not do all these commandments,

verses.kjv: And if ye shall despise my statutes, or if your soul abhor my judgments, so that ye will not do all my commandments, but that ye break my covenant:
verses.modern: if You spurn my statutes, and if Your soul abhors my rules, so that You will not do all my commandments, but break my covenant,

verses.kjv: I also will do this unto you; I will even appoint over you terror, consumption, and the burning ague, that shall consume the eyes, and cause sorrow of heart: and ye shall sow your seed in vain, for your enemies shall eat it.
verses.modern: then I will do this to You: I will visit You with panic, with wasting disease and fever that consume the eyes and make the heart ache. And You shall sow Your seed in vain, for Your enemies shall eat it.

verses.kjv: And I will set my face against you, and ye shall be slain before your enemies: they that hate you shall reign over you; and ye shall flee when none pursueth you.
verses.modern: I will set my face against You, and You shall be struck down before Your enemies. Those who hate You shall rule over You, and You shall flee when none pursues You.

verses.kjv: And if ye will not yet for all this hearken unto me, then I will punish you seven times more for your sins.
verses.modern: if in spite of this You will not listen to me, then I will discipline You again sevenfold for Your sins,

verses.kjv: And I will break the pride of your power; and I will make your heaven as iron, and your earth as brass:
verses.modern: I will break the pride of Your power. I will make Your heavens like iron and Your earth like bronze.

verses.kjv: And your strength shall be spent in vain: for your land shall not yield her increase, neither shall the trees of the land yield their fruits.
verses.modern: your strength shall be spent in vain, for Your land shall not yield its increase, and the trees of the land shall not yield their fruit.

verses.kjv: And if ye walk contrary unto me, and will not hearken unto me; I will bring seven times more plagues upon you according to your sins.
verses.modern: Then if You walk contrary to me and will not listen to me, I will continue striking You, sevenfold for Your sins.

verses.kjv: I will also send wild beasts among you, which shall rob you of your children, and destroy your cattle, and make you few in number; and your high ways shall be desolate.
verses.modern: I will let loose the wild beasts against You, which shall bereave You of Your children and destroy Your livestock and make You few in number, so that Your roads shall be deserted.

verses.kjv: And if ye will not be reformed by me by these things, but will walk contrary unto me;
verses.modern: if by this discipline You are not turned to me but walk contrary to me,

verses.kjv: Then will I also walk contrary unto you, and will punish you yet seven times for your sins.
verses.modern: then I also will walk contrary to You. I myself will strike You sevenfold for Your sins.

verses.kjv: And I will bring a sword upon you, that shall avenge the quarrel of my covenant: and when ye are gathered together within your cities, I will send the pestilence among you; and ye shall be delivered into the hand of the enemy.
verses.modern: I will bring a sword upon You, that shall execute vengeance for the covenant. And if You gather within Your cities, I will send pestilence among You, and You shall be delivered into the hand of the enemy.

verses.kjv: And when I have broken the staff of your bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver you your bread again by weight: and ye shall eat, and not be satisfied.
verses.modern: When I break Your supply of bread, ten women shall bake Your bread in a single oven and shall dole out Your bread again by weight, and You shall eat and not be satisfied.

verses.kjv: And if ye will not for all this hearken unto me, but walk contrary unto me;
verses.modern: But if in spite of this You will not listen to me, but walk contrary to me,

verses.kjv: Then I will walk contrary unto you also in fury; and I, even I, will chastise you seven times for your sins.
verses.modern: then I will walk contrary to You in fury. I myself will discipline You sevenfold for Your sins.

verses.kjv: And ye shall eat the flesh of your sons, and the flesh of your daughters shall ye eat.
verses.modern: You shall eat the flesh of Your sons, and You shall eat the flesh of Your daughters.

verses.kjv: And I will destroy your high places, and cut down your images, and cast your carcases upon the carcases of your idols, and my soul shall abhor you.
verses.modern: I will destroy Your high places and cut down Your incense altars and cast Your dead bodies upon the dead bodies of Your idols, and my soul will abhor You.

verses.kjv: And I will make your cities waste, and bring your sanctuaries unto desolation, and I will not smell the savour of your sweet odours.
verses.modern: I will lay Your cities waste and will make Your sanctuaries desolate. I will not smell Your sweet savours.

verses.kjv: And I will bring the land into desolation: and your enemies which dwell therein shall be astonished at it.
verses.modern: I myself will devastate the land, so that Your enemies who settle in it shall be appalled at it.

verses.kjv: And I will scatter you among the heathen, and will draw out a sword after you: and your land shall be desolate, and your cities waste.
verses.modern: I will scatter You among the nations. I will unsheathe the sword after you, and Your land shall be a desolation, and Your cities shall be a waste.

verses.kjv: Then shall the land enjoy her sabbaths, as long as it lieth desolate, and ye be in your enemies' land; even then shall the land rest, and enjoy her sabbaths.
verses.modern: Then the land shall enjoy its Sabbaths as long as it lies desolate, while You are in Your enemies' land; then the land shall rest, and enjoy its Sabbaths.

verses.kjv: As long as it lieth desolate it shall rest; because it did not rest in your sabbaths, when ye dwelt upon it.
verses.modern: As long as it lies desolate it shall have rest, the rest that it did not have on Your Sabbaths when You were dwelling in it.

verses.kjv: And upon them that are left alive of you I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies; and the sound of a shaken leaf shall chase them; and they shall flee, as fleeing from a sword; and they shall fall when none pursueth.
verses.modern: as for those of You who are left, I will send faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies. The sound of a driven leaf shall put them to flight. They shall flee as one flees from the sword. They shall fall when none pursues.

verses.kjv: And they shall fall one upon another, as it were before a sword, when none pursueth: and ye shall have no power to stand before your enemies.
verses.modern: They shall stumble over one another, as if to escape a sword, though none pursues. And You shall have no power to stand before Your enemies.

verses.kjv: And ye shall perish among the heathen, and the land of your enemies shall eat you up.
verses.modern: you shall perish among the nations, and the land of your enemies shall eat You up.

verses.kjv: And they that are left of you shall pine away in their iniquity in your enemies' lands; and also in the iniquities of their fathers shall they pine away with them.
verses.modern: those of You who are left shall rot away in Your enemies' lands because of their iniquity, and also because of the iniquities of their fathers they shall rot away like them.

verses.kjv: If they shall confess their iniquity, and the iniquity of their fathers, with their trespass which they trespassed against me, and that also they have walked contrary unto me;
verses.modern: But if they confess their iniquity and the iniquity of their fathers in their treachery that they committed against me, and also in walking contrary to me,

verses.kjv: And that I also have walked contrary unto them, and have brought them into the land of their enemies; if then their uncircumcised hearts be humbled, and they then accept of the punishment of their iniquity:
verses.modern: so that I walked contrary to them and brought them into the land of their enemies — if then their uncircumcised heart is humbled and they make amends for their iniquity,

verses.kjv: Then will I remember my covenant with Jacob, and also my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham will I remember; and I will remember the land.
verses.modern: then I will remember my covenant with Jacob. I will remember my covenant with Isaac and my covenant with Abraham. I will remember the land.

verses.kjv: The land also shall be left of them, and shall enjoy her sabbaths, while she lieth desolate without them: and they shall accept of the punishment of their iniquity: because, even because they despised my judgments, and because their soul abhorred my statutes.
verses.modern: But the land shall be abandoned by them and enjoy its Sabbaths while it lies desolate without them. They shall make amends for their iniquity, because they spurned my rules and their soul abhorred my statutes.

verses.kjv: And yet for all that, when they be in the land of their enemies, I will not cast them away, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly, and to break my covenant with them: for I am the LORD their God.
verses.modern: Yet for all that, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not spurn them, neither will I abhor them so as to destroy them utterly and break my covenant with them, for I am the LORD their God.

verses.kjv: But I will for their sakes remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the heathen, that I might be their God: I am the LORD.
verses.modern: But I will for their sake remember the covenant with their forefathers, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the nations, that I might be their God: I am the LORD.'

verses.kjv: These are the statutes and judgments and laws, which the LORD made between him and the children of Israel in mount Sinai by the hand of Moses.
verses.modern: These are the statutes and rules and laws that the LORD made between Himself and the children of Israel through Moses on Mount Sinai.

chapters.summary: The LORD promises blessings for obedience -- rain, abundant harvests, peace, and His presence among His people. He warns of escalating punishments for disobedience -- disease, defeat, famine, and exile -- but promises that if they confess their sin, He will remember His covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When a man shall make a singular vow, the persons shall be for the LORD by thy estimation.
verses.modern: 'Speak to the children of Israel and say to them, If anyone makes a special vow to the LORD involving the valuation of persons,

verses.kjv: And thy estimation shall be of the male from twenty years old even unto sixty years old, even thy estimation shall be fifty shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary.
verses.modern: then the valuation of a male from twenty years old up to sixty years old shall be fifty shekels of silver, according to the shekel of the sanctuary.

verses.kjv: And if it be a female, then thy estimation shall be thirty shekels.
verses.modern: If the person is a female, the valuation shall be thirty shekels.

verses.kjv: And if it be from five years old even unto twenty years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male twenty shekels, and for the female ten shekels.
verses.modern: If the person is from five to twenty years of age, the valuation shall be for a male twenty shekels, and for a female ten shekels.

verses.kjv: And if it be from a month old even unto five years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male five shekels of silver, and for the female thy estimation shall be three shekels of silver.
verses.modern: If the person is from a month old up to five years of age, the valuation shall be for a male five shekels of silver, and for a female the valuation shall be three shekels of silver.

verses.kjv: And if it be from sixty years old and above; if it be a male, then thy estimation shall be fifteen shekels, and for the female ten shekels.
verses.modern: if the person is sixty years old or over, then the valuation for a male shall be fifteen shekels, and for a female ten shekels.

verses.kjv: But if he be poorer than thy estimation, then he shall present himself before the priest, and the priest shall value him; according to his ability that vowed shall the priest value him.
verses.modern: if someone is too poor to pay the valuation, then he shall be made to stand before the priest, and the priest shall value him; the priest shall value him according to what the vowing person can afford.

verses.kjv: And if it be a beast, whereof men bring an offering unto the LORD, all that any man giveth of such unto the LORD shall be holy.
verses.modern: If the vow is an animal that may be offered as an offering to the LORD, all of it that He gives to the LORD is holy.

verses.kjv: He shall not alter it, nor change it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good: and if he shall at all change beast for beast, then it and the exchange thereof shall be holy.
verses.modern: He shall not exchange it or make a substitute for it, good for bad, or bad for good. If He does in fact substitute one animal for another, then both it and the substitute shall be holy.

verses.kjv: And if it be any unclean beast, of which they do not offer a sacrifice unto the LORD, then he shall present the beast before the priest:
verses.modern: if it is any unclean animal that may not be offered as an offering to the LORD, then He shall stand the animal before the priest,

verses.kjv: And the priest shall value it, whether it be good or bad: as thou valuest it, who art the priest, so shall it be.
verses.modern: the priest shall value it as either good or bad; as the priest values it, so it shall be.

verses.kjv: But if he will at all redeem it, then he shall add a fifth part thereof unto thy estimation.
verses.modern: But if he wishes to redeem it, he shall add a fifth to the valuation.

verses.kjv: And when a man shall sanctify his house to be holy unto the LORD, then the priest shall estimate it, whether it be good or bad: as the priest shall estimate it, so shall it stand.
verses.modern: When a man dedicates his house as a holy gift to the LORD, the priest shall value it as either good or bad; as the priest values it, so it shall stand.

verses.kjv: And if he that sanctified it will redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be his.
verses.modern: if the donor wishes to redeem His house, He shall add a fifth to the valuation price. It shall be His.

verses.kjv: And if a man shall sanctify unto the LORD some part of a field of his possession, then thy estimation shall be according to the seed thereof: an homer of barley seed shall be valued at fifty shekels of silver.
verses.modern: If a man dedicates to the LORD part of the land that is His possession, then the valuation shall be in proportion to its seed. A homer of barley seed shall be valued at fifty shekels of silver.

verses.kjv: If he sanctify his field from the year of jubile, according to thy estimation it shall stand.
verses.modern: If He dedicates His field from the year of jubilee, the valuation shall stand.

verses.kjv: But if he sanctify his field after the jubile, then the priest shall reckon unto him the money according to the years that remain, even unto the year of the jubile, and it shall be abated from thy estimation.
verses.modern: But if he dedicates his field after the jubilee, then the priest shall calculate the price according to the years that remain until the year of jubilee, and a deduction shall be made from the valuation.

verses.kjv: And if he that sanctified the field will in any wise redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be assured to him.
verses.modern: if he who dedicates the field wishes to redeem it, then he shall add a fifth to its valuation price. It shall remain his.

verses.kjv: And if he will not redeem the field, or if he have sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more.
verses.modern: But if he does not wish to redeem the field, or if he has sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed anymore.

verses.kjv: But the field, when it goeth out in the jubile, shall be holy unto the LORD, as a field devoted; the possession thereof shall be the priest's.
verses.modern: But the field, when it is released in the jubilee, shall be a holy gift to the LORD, like a field that has been devoted. The priest shall be in possession of it.

verses.kjv: And if a man sanctify unto the LORD a field which he hath bought, which is not of the fields of his possession;
verses.modern: If He dedicates to the LORD a field that He has bought, which is not a part of His possession,

verses.kjv: Then the priest shall reckon unto him the worth of thy estimation, even unto the year of the jubile: and he shall give thine estimation in that day, as a holy thing unto the LORD.
verses.modern: then the priest shall calculate the amount of the valuation for it up to the year of jubilee, and the man shall give the valuation on that day as a holy gift to the LORD.

verses.kjv: In the year of the jubile the field shall return unto him of whom it was bought, even to him to whom the possession of the land did belong.
verses.modern: In the year of jubilee the field shall return to Him from whom it was bought, to whom the land belongs as a possession.

verses.kjv: And all thy estimations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs shall be the shekel.
verses.modern: Every valuation shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs shall make a shekel.

verses.kjv: Only the firstling of the beasts, which should be the LORD's firstling, no man shall sanctify it; whether it be ox, or sheep: it is the LORD's.
verses.modern: But a firstborn of animals, which as a firstborn belongs to the LORD, no man may dedicate; whether ox or sheep, it is the LORD's.

verses.kjv: And if it be of an unclean beast, then he shall redeem it according to thine estimation, and shall add a fifth part of it thereto: or if it be not redeemed, then it shall be sold according to thy estimation.
verses.modern: if it is an unclean animal, then He shall buy it back at the valuation, and add a fifth to it; or, if it is not redeemed, it shall be sold at the valuation.

verses.kjv: Notwithstanding no devoted thing, that a man shall devote unto the LORD of all that he hath, both of man and beast, and of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed: every devoted thing is most holy unto the LORD.
verses.modern: But no devoted thing that a man devotes to the LORD, of anything that He has, whether man or beast, or of His inherited field, shall be sold or redeemed; every devoted thing is most holy to the LORD.

verses.kjv: None devoted, which shall be devoted of men, shall be redeemed; but shall surely be put to death.
verses.modern: No one devoted, who is to be devoted for destruction from mankind, shall be ransomed; He shall surely be put to death.

verses.kjv: And all the tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land, or of the fruit of the tree, is the LORD's: it is holy unto the LORD.
verses.modern: Every tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land or of the fruit of the trees, is the LORD's; it is holy to the LORD.

verses.kjv: And if a man will at all redeem ought of his tithes, he shall add thereto the fifth part thereof.
verses.modern: If a man wishes to redeem some of his tithe, he shall add a fifth to it.

verses.kjv: And concerning the tithe of the herd, or of the flock, even of whatsoever passeth under the rod, the tenth shall be holy unto the LORD.
verses.modern: every tithe of herds and flocks, every tenth animal of all that pass under the herdsman's staff, shall be holy to the LORD.

verses.kjv: He shall not search whether it be good or bad, neither shall he change it: and if he change it at all, then both it and the change thereof shall be holy; it shall not be redeemed.
verses.modern: One shall not differentiate between good or bad, neither shall He make a substitute for it. If He does substitute for it, then both it and the substitute shall be holy; it shall not be redeemed.'

verses.kjv: These are the commandments, which the LORD commanded Moses for the children of Israel in mount Sinai.
verses.modern: These are the commandments that the LORD commanded Moses for the children of Israel on Mount Sinai.

chapters.summary: The LORD gives laws for the valuation of persons, animals, houses, and fields dedicated to Him by special vows. Valuations are set according to age and sex, and anything devoted may be redeemed by adding a fifth to its value; every tithe of the land and herds is holy to the LORD.
